{#
  Thin Semantic Layer wrapper over analytics.daily_rev_tahoe.
  Grain: one row per approved commerce line (transaction_id, order_id, variation_id).
  Business revenue day: order_approved_time in America/Los_Angeles (order_approved_day).
  Partition dt is the Hive load batch key — filter for pruning, not business dating alone.
#}

select
    concat(rev.transaction_id, '|', rev.order_id, '|', rev.variation_id) as daily_rev_line_id,

    rev.transaction_id,
    rev.order_id,
    rev.variation_id,
    rev.user_id,
    rev.product_id,
    rev.merchant_id,
    rev.payment_id,
    rev.refund_transaction_id,

    cast(
        date_format(from_unixtime(rev.order_approved_time, 'America/Los_Angeles'), '%Y-%m-%d')
        as date
    ) as order_approved_day,
    cast(rev.dt as date) as dt,
    cast(rev.confirmed_date as date) as confirmed_ship_day,
    cast(
        date_format(from_unixtime(rev.transaction_time, 'America/Los_Angeles'), '%Y-%m-%d')
        as date
    ) as transaction_day,

    cast(from_unixtime(rev.transaction_time) as timestamp) as transaction_ts,
    cast(from_unixtime(rev.shipped_date) as timestamp) as shipped_ts,
    cast(from_unixtime(rev.merchant_payment_time) as timestamp) as merchant_payment_ts,
    cast(from_unixtime(rev.refunded_time) as timestamp) as refunded_ts,
    rev.transaction_time,
    rev.order_approved_time,
    rev.shipped_date,
    rev.merchant_payment_time,
    rev.refunded_time,

    rev.country_code,
    rev.country_state,
    rev.shipping_country,
    rev.shipping_state,
    rev.merchant_country,
    rev.currency,
    rev.merchant_source_currency,
    rev.conversion_rate,

    rev.payment_method,
    rev.transaction_state,
    case rev.transaction_state
        when 0 then 'Pending'
        when 1 then 'Approved'
        when 2 then 'Acknowledged'
        when 3 then 'Shipped'
        when 4 then 'Declined'
        when 5 then 'Refunded'
        when 6 then 'C2C On Delivery'
        when 7 then 'C2C Delivered'
        when 8 then 'C2C Accepted'
        when 10 then 'Exception'
        when 11 then 'Gift Waiting For Accept'
        when 12 then 'Require Review'
        when 13 then 'Delaying'
        when 14 then 'Label Generated'
        when 15 then 'Label Downloaded'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as transaction_state_name,
    rev.order_state,
    case rev.order_state
        when 0 then 'Pending'
        when 1 then 'Approved'
        when 2 then 'Acknowledged'
        when 3 then 'Shipped'
        when 4 then 'Declined'
        when 5 then 'Refunded'
        when 6 then 'C2C On Delivery'
        when 7 then 'C2C Delivered'
        when 8 then 'C2C Accepted'
        when 10 then 'Exception'
        when 11 then 'Gift Waiting For Accept'
        when 12 then 'Require Review'
        when 13 then 'Delaying'
        when 14 then 'Label Generated'
        when 15 then 'Label Downloaded'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as order_state_name,

    rev.is_cancelled,
    rev.is_wish_owned,
    rev.is_wish_express,
    rev.is_free_gift,
    rev.is_bnpl,
    rev.original_category,
    rev.updated_category,
    rev.cancelretry_ind,
    rev.fbs_purchase,
    rev.fbs_sale,
    rev.shopify_none,
    rev.is_eea,
    rev.is_fusion_resale,
    rev.is_unity_order,
    rev.is_unity_order_and_payment_enabled,

    rev.quantity,
    rev.price_before_promotions,
    rev.shipping_before_promotions,
    rev.price_before_promotions + rev.shipping_before_promotions as gmv,
    rev.flat_rate_shipping,
    rev.giftcard_amount,
    rev.discount_amount,
    rev.tax_amount,
    rev.tax_fee,
    rev.net_amount,
    rev.wishcash_usage,
    rev.retail_delivery_fee_amount,

    rev.merchant_price,
    rev.merchant_shipping,
    rev.localized_paid_merchant,
    rev.paid_merchant_usd,
    rev.merchant_shipping_cost,
    rev.localized_merchant_shipping_cost,
    rev.merchant_cost,
    rev.localized_merchant_cost,
    rev.localized_merchant_eat_cost_amount,
    rev.merchant_eat_cost_amo

approved_cards.usage: Filter metric_time / dt first for partition pruning. Use order_approved_day for LA revenue recognition; transaction_day for checkout analysis. GMV = price_before_promotions + shipping_before_promotions; net GMV = net_amount. Commission = net − paid_merchant − MEC − tax components. Dedupe on grain keys before summing when append duplicates are suspected.
approved_cards.description: Order-item (variation) grain daily revenue fact for approved Wish marketplace commerce lines. Grain is one row per (transaction_id, order_id, variation_id) sourced from wish.fact_trans_detail with USD-normalized financials and cart-level amounts prorated to merchant-order lines. Excludes PENDING, DECLINED, and EXCEPTION item states at load time. Business revenue day is America/Los_Angeles date from order_approved_time (order_approved_day); Hive partition dt is the load batch end date — filter dt for pruning and order_approved_day for reporting. Duplicate rows can exist across append loads; dedupe before aggregates when sums must reconcile. Source: analytics.daily_rev_tahoe (Airflow DAG DailyRevTahoeNew).
approved_cards.selection_notes: Order-item (variation) grain daily revenue fact for Wish marketplace; GMV column is USD-normalized and matches the exp.gmv glossary aggregation. Source physical table analytics.daily_rev_tahoe (sourced from wish.fact_trans_detail). Will filter Wish platform rows only (this dbt model is already Wish-scoped).

approved_cards.description: Order-item (variation) grain daily revenue fact for approved Wish marketplace commerce lines. Grain is one row per (transaction_id, order_id, variation_id) sourced from wish.fact_trans_detail with USD-normalized financials and cart-level amounts prorated to merchant-order lines. Excludes PENDING, DECLINED, and EXCEPTION item states at load time. Business revenue day is America/Los_Angeles date from order_approved_time (order_approved_day); Hive partition dt is the load batch end date — filter dt for pruning and order_approved_day for reporting. approved_cards.selection_notes: Order-item (variation) grain daily revenue fact for Wish marketplace; GMV column is USD-normalized and matches the exp.gmv glossary aggregation. Source physical table analytics.daily_rev_tahoe (sourced from wish.fact_trans_detail). Will filter Wish platform rows only (this dbt model is already Wish-scoped).

approved_sql:
-- Wish channel daily GMV (last 3 calendar months, ending yesterday)
WITH bounds AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(date_trunc('month', current_date - interval '3' month) AS varchar) AS window_start,
    CAST(current_date - interval '1' day AS varchar) AS last_complete_day
),
daily AS (
  SELECT
    dt AS partition_date,
    SUM(price_before_promotions + shipping_before_promotions) AS gmv_usd,
    COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS orders,
    COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS active_users
  FROM analytics.daily_rev_tahoe
  WHERE dt >= (SELECT window_start FROM bounds)
    AND dt <= (SELECT last_complete_day FROM bounds)
    AND is_cancelled = 'false'
  GROUP BY dt
)
SELECT
  partition_date,
  gmv_usd,
  orders,
  active_users
FROM daily
ORDER BY partition_date

{#
  Thin Semantic Layer wrapper over analytics.daily_rev_tahoe.
  Grain: one row per approved commerce line (transaction_id, order_id, variation_id).
  Business revenue day: order_approved_time in America/Los_Angeles (order_approved_day).

#}

select
    concat(rev.transaction_id, '|', rev.order_id, '|', rev.variation_id) as daily_rev_line_id,

    rev.transaction_id,
    rev.order_id,
    rev.variation_id,
    rev.user_id,
    rev.product_id,
    rev.merchant_id,
    rev.payment_id,
    rev.refund_transaction_id,

    cast(
        date_format(from_unixtime(rev.order_approved_time, 'America/Los_Angeles'), '%Y-%m-%d')
        as date
    ) as order_approved_day,
    cast(rev.dt as date) as dt,
    cast(rev.confirmed_date as date) as confirmed_ship_day,
    cast(
        date_format(from_unixtime(rev.transaction_time, 'America/Los_Angeles'), '%Y-%m-%d')
        as date
    ) as transaction_day,

    cast(from_unixtime(rev.transaction_time) as timestamp) as transaction_ts,
    cast(from_unixtime(rev.shipped_date) as timestamp) as shipped_ts,
    cast(from_unixtime(rev.merchant_payment_time) as timestamp) as merchant_payment_ts,
    cast(from_unixtime(rev.refunded_time) as timestamp) as refunded_ts,
    rev.transaction_time,
    rev.order_approved_time,
    rev.shipped_date,
    rev.merchant_payment_time,
    rev.refunded_time,

    rev.country_code,
    rev.country_state,
    rev.shipping_country,
    rev.shipping_state,
    rev.merchant_country,
    rev.currency,
    rev.merchant_source_currency,
    rev.conversion_rate,

    rev.payment_method,
    rev.transaction_state,
    case rev.transaction_state
        when 0 then 'Pending'
        when 1 then 'Approved'
        when 2 then 'Acknowledged'
        when 3 then 'Shipped'
        when 4 then 'Declined'
        when 5 then 'Refunded'
        when 6 then 'C2C On Delivery'
        when 7 then 'C2C Delivered'
        when 8 then 'C2C Accepted'

    rev.order_state,
    case rev.order_state
        when 0 then 'Pending'

        when 2 then 'Acknowledged'
        when 3 then 'Shipped'
        when 4 then 'Declined'
        when 5 then 'Refunded'
        when 6 then 'C2C On Delivery'
        when 7 then 'C2C Delivered'
        when 8 then 'C2C Accepted'
        when 10 then 'Exception'
        when 11 then 'Gift Waiting For Accept'
        when 12 then 'Require Review'
        when 13 then 'Delaying'
        when 14 then 'Label Generated'
        when 15 then 'Label Downloaded'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as order_state_name,

    rev.is_cancelled,
    rev.is_wish_owned,
    rev.is_wish_express,
    rev.is_free_gift,
    rev.is_bnpl,
    rev.original_category,
    rev.updated_category,
    rev.cancelretry_ind,
    rev.fbs_purchase,
    rev.fbs_sale,
    rev.shopify_none,
    rev.is_eea,
    rev.is_fusion_resale,
    rev.is_unity_order,
    rev.is_unity_order_and_payment_enabled,

    rev.quantity,
    rev.price_before_promotions,
    rev.shipping_before_promotions,
    rev.price_before_promotions + rev.shipping_before_promotions as gmv,
    rev.flat_rate_shipping,
    rev.giftcard_amount,
    rev.discount_amount,
    rev.tax_amount,
    rev.tax_fee,
    rev.net_amount,
    rev.wishcash_usage,
    rev.retail_delivery_fee_amount,

    rev.merchant_price,
    rev.merchant_shipping,
    rev.localized_paid_merchant,
    rev.paid_merchant_usd,
    rev.merchant_shipping_cost,
    rev.localized_merchant_shipping_cost,
    rev.merchant_cost,
    rev.localized_merchant_cost,
    rev.localized_merchant_eat_cost_amount,
    rev.merchant_eat_cost_amo

approved_cards.usage: Filter metric_time / dt first for partition pruning. Use order_approved_day for LA revenue recognition; transaction_day for checkout analysis. GMV = price_before_promotions + shipping_before_promotions; net GMV = net_amount. Commission = net − paid_merchant − MEC − tax components. Dedupe on grain keys before summing when append duplicates are suspected.
approved_cards.description: Order-item (variation) grain daily revenue fact for approved Wish marketplace commerce lines. Grain is one row per (transaction_id, order_id, variation_id) sourced from wish.fact_trans_detail with USD-normalized financials and cart-level amounts prorated to merchant-order lines. Excludes PENDING, DECLINED, and EXCEPTION item states at load time. Business revenue day is America/Los_Angeles date from order_approved_time (order_approved_day); Hive partition dt is the load batch end date — filter dt for pruning and order_approved_day for reporting. Duplicate rows can exist across append loads; dedupe before aggregates when sums must reconcile. Source: analytics.daily_rev_tahoe (Airflow DAG DailyRevTahoeNew).
approved_cards.selection_notes: Wish-only daily revenue fact at (transaction, order, variation) grain; gmv column is USD-normalized and the model is already Wish-scoped, so no platform filter is needed.

approved_cards.cte:
{{ config(
    materialized='view'
) }}

{#
  Thin Semantic Layer wrapper over bi.order_level.
  Grain: one row per merchant order (m_transaction_id) within partition dt.
  Source: Airflow DAG bi_order_level (daily 06:00 America/Los_Angeles).
#}

select
    concat(ol.m_transaction_id, '|', ol.dt) as order_level_id,

    ol.m_transaction_id,
    ol.transaction_id,
    ol.variation_id,
    ol.user_id,
    ol.merchant_id,
    ol.product_id,
    ol.tracking_id,

    ol.client,
    case ol.client
        when 'web' then 'Web'
        when 'iosapp' then 'iOS App'
        when 'androidapp' then 'Android App'
        when 'mobileweb' then 'Mobile Web'
        when 'Other' then 'Other'
        else ol.client
    end as client_name,

    ol.payment_method,

    ol.fulfilled,
    case ol.fulfilled
        when 1 then 'Confirmed shipped'
        when 0 then 'Not confirmed shipped'
        else cast(ol.fulfilled as varchar)
    end as fulfilled_name,

    ol.order_flat_rate_eligible,
    case ol.order_flat_rate_eligible
        when 1 then 'Eligible'
        when 0 then 'Not eligible'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as order_flat_rate_eligible_name,

    ol.order_flat_rate_qualified,
    case ol.order_flat_rate_qualified
        when 1 then 'Qualified'
        when 0 then 'Not qualified'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as order_flat_rate_qualified_name,

    ol.delivery_program,

    ol.wishpost_data_mature,
    case ol.wishpost_data_mature
        when 1 then 'Mature'
        when 0 then 'Immature'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as wishpost_data_mature_name,

    ol.refund_data_mature,
    case ol.refund_data_mature
        when 1 then 'Mature'
        when 0 then 'Immature'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as refund_data_mature_name,

    ol.is_pb,
    case ol.is_pb
        when 1 then 'Product Boost'
        when 0 then 'Not Product Boost'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as is_pb_name,

    ol.is_currently_bd_managed,
    case ol.is_currently_bd_managed
        when 1 then 'BD managed'
        when 0 then 'General support'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as is_currently_bd_managed_name,

    cast(ol.dt as date) as dt,
    cast(ol.transaction_dt as date) as transaction_dt,
    cast(ol.order_approved_dt as date) as order_approved_dt,
    cast(ol.refund_dt as date) as refund_dt,

    ol.buyer_lifecycle,
    ol.touch_event,
    ol.channel,
    ol.wss_tier,
    ol.shipping_country,
    ol.region,
    case upper(ol.region)
        when 'APAC' then 'Asia-Pacific'
        when 'LATAM' then 'Latin America'
        when 'MEA' then 'Middle East & Africa'
        when 'NWE' then 'Northern/Western Europe'
        when 'SEE' then 'Southern/Eastern Europe'
        when 'USCAN' then 'United States and Canada'
        else ol.region
    end as region_name,
    ol.country_name,
    ol.merchant_country,
    ol.merchant_country_group,
    ol.most_recent_bd_rep,

    ol.refund_reason_category,
    ol.md_refund_reason,
    ol.refund_type,

    ol.item_price,
    ol.gmv,
    ol.mkpl_revenue,
    ol.quantity,
    ol.discount_amount,
    ol.gross_gmv,
    ol.net_gmv,
    ol.total_shipping_paid_by_consumer,
    ol.refund_amount,
    ol.wishpost_sales_usd,
    ol.wishpost_costs_usd
from {{ source('bi', 'order_level') }} as ol

approved_cards.usage: Filter metric_time / dt first for partition pruning. Use payment_received_time (same calendar date as dt) for revenue recognition; transaction_time for checkout / user-behavior analysis.
approved_cards.description: Variation-level transaction fact for Wish GMV, revenue, tax, and buyer analysis. Grain is one row per commerce transaction and product variation within payment-received partition dt (America/Los_Angeles). Financial metrics are proportionally allocated by (paid_price + paid_shipping) / (subtotal + total_shipping). Excludes Wish Cash and BNPL special variation IDs, pending/declined/exception states, and refunds that precede payment received. Source: core_data.fct_transaction_variations (Airflow DAG FctTransactionVariations).
approved_cards.selection_notes: core_data.fct_transaction_variations 是 Wish GMV 的核心事实表（variation 粒度）。dt 是 partition_date，gmv 是 USD 已成交金额（排除 LTD 可由 is_ltd_product=false 控制，与 glossary exp.gmv 口径一致）。无显式 platform 字段，但表本身只覆盖 Wish 交易。

reasons.approve: approve — fct_transaction_variations 已含 gmv/orders/quantity 与 dt，按 client_name='Wish' 过滤后按月聚合即可命中你的口径，无需再扩展模型。
reasons.deny-comments: deny-comments — 若你希望严格按 platform='Wish' 字段过滤，或需要退款/净额 GMV，请回退并补一个含 platform 字段或 net_gmv 的事实表。
reasons.deny-halt: deny-halt — 仅当你的口径必须包含退货冲销或非美元结算且本模型无法近似时，才应停止生成 SQL。
reasons.dryrun: dryrun — 若你只是想先确认月度 GMV/订单量是否合理、暂不固化模型配置，可先 dryrun 跑一次验证。

{{ config(
    materialized='view'

{#
  Thin Semantic Layer wrapper over core_data.fct_transaction_variations.
  Grain: one row per (transaction_id, variation_id) within partition dt.
#}

select
    concat(txn.transaction_id, '|', txn.variation_id) as transaction_variation_id,

    txn.transaction_id,
    txn.variation_id,
    txn.order_id,
    txn.user_id,
    txn.merchant_id,
    txn.product_id,
    txn.visitor_id,
    txn.seed_visitor_id,

    txn.payment_received_time,
    txn.transaction_time,
    cast(txn.dt as date) as dt,
    cast(from_unixtime(txn.transaction_timestamp) as timestamp) as transaction_ts,
    cast(from_unixtime(txn.time) as timestamp) as payment_received_ts,
    txn.transaction_timestamp,
    txn.time,
    datediff(txn.payment_received_time, txn.transaction_time) as payment_lag_days,

    txn.shipping_country,
    txn.client,
    case txn.client
        when 0 then 'Web'
        when 1 then 'iPhone'
        when 2 then 'iPad'
        when 3 then 'Android'
        when 4 then 'Mobile Web'
        when 5 then 'Windows Desktop'
        when 6 then 'Windows Phone'
        when 7 then 'Android Instant App'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as client_name,
    txn.payment_type,
    case txn.payment_type
        when -1 then 'None'
        when 0 then 'PayPal'
        when 1 then 'Braintree'
        when 2 then 'Braintree Facebook Autofill'
        when 3 then 'Stripe'
        when 4 then 'Braintree Google Wallet'
        when 5 then 'Stripe Google Wallet'
        when 6 then 'Boleto'
        when 7 then 'Stripe Apple Pay'
        when 8 then 'Klarna'
        when 9 then 'Adyen'
        when 10 then 'Ebanx'
        when 11 then 'OXXO'
        when 12 then 'Unknown'
        when 13 then 'Twitter Buy Now'
        when 14 then 'Boku'
        when 15 then 'Affirm'
        when 16 then 'Braintree PayPal'
        when 17 then 'Stripe iDEAL'
        when 18 then 'PayNearMe'
        when 19 then 'Braintree Venmo'
        when 20 then 'Stripe Samsung Pay'
        when 21 then 'Buy Now Pay Later'
        when 22 then 'Paytm'
        when 23 then 'Xendit Invoice'
        when 24 then 'Facebook Checkout'
        when 25 then 'Adyen Banking'
        when 26 then 'Offline Cash'
        when 27 then 'Braintree ACH'
        when 28 then 'Shopify Checkout'
        when 29 then 'Pix'
        when 30 then 'Afterpay'
        when 31 then 'Klarna Paylater'
        when 32 then 'Cash App Pay'
        else 'Other'
    end as payment_type_name,
    txn.installments,
    coalesce(txn.installments, 1) > 1 as is_installment,
    txn.is_ltd_product,
    txn.is_temporary_user,

    txn.quantity,
    txn.total,
    txn.gmv_variation,
    txn.raw_revenue_variation,
    txn.raw_total_tax,
    txn.wish_cash_variation
from {{ source('core_data', 'fct_transaction_variations') }} as txn

approved_cards.selection_notes: core_data.fct_transaction_variations 是 Wish GMV 的核心事实表（variation 粒度）。dt 是 partition_date，gmv 是 USD 已成交金额；is_ltd_product='false' 与 glossary exp.gmv 口径一致。该表只覆盖 Wish 交易，无 platform 字段。

approved_sql:
-- Wish 最近 3 个月月度 GMV 与订单量（按 partition_date 归属，USD）
WITH bounds AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(date_trunc('month', current_date - interval '3' month) AS varchar) AS month_start
),
monthly AS (
  SELECT
    date_trunc('month', CAST(dt AS date)) AS month,
    SUM(gmv) AS gmv_usd,
    SUM(orders) AS orders
  FROM core_data.fct_transaction_variations
  WHERE dt >= (SELECT month_start FROM bounds)
    AND dt <= CAST(current_date - interval '1' day AS varchar)
    AND is_ltd_product = 'false'
  GROUP BY date_trunc('month', CAST(dt AS date))
)
SELECT
  month,
  gmv_usd,
  orders
FROM monthly
ORDER BY month

approved_cards.cte:
{{ config(
    materialized='view'
) }}

{#
  Thin Semantic Layer wrapper over core_data.fct_transaction_variations.
  Grain: one row per (transaction_id, variation_id) within partition dt.
#}

select
    concat(txn.transaction_id, '|', txn.variation_id) as transaction_variation_id,

    txn.transaction_id,
    txn.variation_id,
    txn.order_id,
    txn.user_id,
    txn.merchant_id,
    txn.product_id,
    txn.visitor_id,
    txn.seed_visitor_id,

    txn.payment_received_time,
    txn.transaction_time,
    cast(txn.dt as date) as dt,
    cast(from_unixtime(txn.transaction_timestamp) as timestamp) as transaction_ts,
    cast(from_unixtime(txn.time) as timestamp) as payment_received_ts,
    txn.transaction_timestamp,
    txn.time,
    datediff(txn.payment_received_time, txn.transaction_time) as payment_lag_days,

    txn.shipping_country,
    txn.client,
    case txn.client
        when 0 then 'Web'
        when 1 then 'iPhone'
        when 2 then 'iPad'
        when 3 then 'Android'
        when 4 then 'Mobile Web'
        when 5 then 'Windows Desktop'
        when 6 then 'Windows Phone'
        when 7 then 'Android Instant App'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as client_name,
    txn.payment_type,
    case txn.payment_type
        when -1 then 'None'
        when 0 then 'PayPal'
        when 1 then 'Braintree'
        when 2 then 'Braintree Facebook Autofill'
        when 3 then 'Stripe'
        when 4 then 'Braintree Google Wallet'
        when 5 then 'Stripe Google Wallet'
        when 6 then 'Boleto'
        when 7 then 'Stripe Apple Pay'
        when 8 then 'Klarna'
        when 9 then 'Adyen'
        when 10 then 'Ebanx'
        when 11 then 'OXXO'
        when 12 then 'Unknown'
        when 13 then 'Twitter Buy Now'
        when 14 then 'Boku'
        when 15 then 'Affirm'
        when 16 then 'Braintree PayPal'
        when 17 then 'Stripe iDEAL'
        when 18 then 'PayNearMe'
        when 19 then 'Braintree Venmo'
        when 20 then 'Stripe Samsung Pay'
        when 21 then 'Buy Now Pay Later'
        when 22 then 'Paytm'
        when 23 then 'Xendit Invoice'
        when 24 then 'Facebook Checkout'
        when 25 then 'Adyen Banking'
        when 26 then 'Offline Cash'
        when 27 then 'Braintree ACH'
        when 28 then 'Shopify Checkout'
        when 29 then 'Pix'
        when 30 then 'Afterpay'
        when 31 then 'Klarna Paylater'
        when 32 then 'Cash App Pay'
        else 'Other'
    end as payment_type_name,
    txn.installments,
    coalesce(txn.installments, 1) > 1 as is_installment,
    txn.is_ltd_product,
    txn.is_temporary_user,

    txn.quantity,
    txn.total,
    txn.gmv_variation,
    txn.raw_revenue_variation,
    txn.raw_total_tax,
    txn.wish_cash_variation
from {{ source('core_data', 'fct_transaction_variations') }} as txn

approved_sql:
-- Wish 最近 3 个月月度 GMV / 订单量（按 partition_date 归属，USD）
WITH bounds AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(date_trunc('month', current_date - interval '3' month) AS varchar) AS month_start
),
monthly AS (
  SELECT
    date_trunc('month', CAST(dt AS date)) AS month,
    SUM(gmv) AS gmv_usd,
    SUM(orders) AS orders
  FROM core_data.fct_transaction_variations
  WHERE dt >= (SELECT month_start FROM bounds)
    AND dt <= CAST(current_date - interval '1' day AS varchar)
    AND is_ltd_product = 'false'
  GROUP BY date_trunc('month', CAST(dt AS date))
)
SELECT
  month,
  gmv_usd,
  orders
FROM monthly
ORDER BY month

approved_cards.name: daily_rev_tahoe
approved_cards.cte:
{{ config(
    materialized='view'
) }}

{#
  Thin Semantic Layer wrapper over analytics.daily_rev_tahoe.
  Grain: one row per approved commerce line (transaction_id, order_id, variation_id).
  Business revenue day: order_approved_time in America/Los_Angeles (order_approved_day).
  Partition dt is the Hive load batch key — filter for pruning, not business dating alone.
#}

select
    concat(rev.transaction_id, '|', rev.order_id, '|', rev.variation_id) as daily_rev_line_id,

    rev.transaction_id,
    rev.order_id,
    rev.variation_id,
    rev.user_id,
    rev.product_id,
    rev.merchant_id,
    rev.payment_id,
    rev.refund_transaction_id,

    cast(
        date_format(from_unixtime(rev.order_approved_time, 'America/Los_Angeles'), '%Y-%m-%d')
        as date
    ) as order_approved_day,
    cast(rev.dt as date) as dt,
    cast(rev.confirmed_date as date) as confirmed_ship_day,
    cast(
        date_format(from_unixtime(rev.transaction_time, 'America/Los_Angeles'), '%Y-%m-%d')
        as date
    ) as transaction_day,

    cast(from_unixtime(rev.transaction_time) as timestamp) as transaction_ts,
    cast(from_unixtime(rev.shipped_date) as timestamp) as shipped_ts,
    cast(from_unixtime(rev.merchant_payment_time) as timestamp) as merchant_payment_ts,
    cast(from_unixtime(rev.refunded_time) as timestamp) as refunded_ts,
    rev.transaction_time,
    rev.order_approved_time,
    rev.shipped_date,
    rev.merchant_payment_time,
    rev.refunded_time,

    rev.country_code,
    rev.country_state,
    rev.shipping_country,
    rev.shipping_state,
    rev.merchant_country,
    rev.currency,
    rev.merchant_source_currency,
    rev.conversion_rate,

    rev.payment_method,
    rev.transaction_state,
    case rev.transaction_state
        when 0 then 'Pending'
        when 1 then 'Approved'
        when 2 then 'Acknowledged'
        when 3 then 'Shipped'
        when 4 then 'Declined'
        when 5 then 'Refunded'
        when 6 then 'C2C On Delivery'
        when 7 then 'C2C Delivered'
        when 8 then 'C2C Accepted'
        when 10 then 'Exception'
        when 11 then 'Gift Waiting For Accept'
        when 12 then 'Require Review'
        when 13 then 'Delaying'
        when 14 then 'Label Generated'
        when 15 then 'Label Downloaded'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as transaction_state_name,
    rev.order_state,
    case rev.order_state
        when 0 then 'Pending'
        when 1 then 'Approved'
        when 2 then 'Acknowledged'
        when 3 then 'Shipped'
        when 4 then 'Declined'
        when 5 then 'Refunded'
        when 6 then 'C2C On Delivery'
        when 7 then 'C2C Delivered'
        when 8 then 'C2C Accepted'
        when 10 then 'Exception'
        when 11 then 'Gift Waiting For Accept'
        when 12 then 'Require Review'
        when 13 then 'Delaying'
        when 14 then 'Label Generated'
        when 15 then 'Label Downloaded'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as order_state_name,

    rev.is_cancelled,
    rev.is_wish_owned,
    rev.is_wish_express,
    rev.is_free_gift,
    rev.is_bnpl,
    rev.original_category,
    rev.updated_category,
    rev.cancelretry_ind,
    rev.fbs_purchase,
    rev.fbs_sale,
    rev.shopify_none,
    rev.is_eea,
    rev.is_fusion_resale,
    rev.is_unity_order,
    rev.is_unity_order_and_payment_enabled,

    rev.quantity,
    rev.price_before_promotions,
    rev.shipping_before_promotions,
    rev.price_before_promotions + rev.shipping_before_promotions as gmv,
    rev.flat_rate_shipping,
    rev.giftcard_amount,
    rev.discount_amount,
    rev.tax_amount,
    rev.tax_fee,
    rev.net_amount,
    rev.wishcash_usage,
    rev.retail_delivery_fee_amount,

    rev.merchant_price,
    rev.merchant_shipping,
    rev.localized_paid_merchant,
    rev.paid_merchant_usd,
    rev.merchant_shipping_cost,
    rev.localized_merchant_shipping_cost,
    rev.merchant_cost,
    rev.localized_merchant_cost,
    rev.localized_merchant_eat_cost_amount,
    rev.merchant_eat_cost_amount_usd,
    rev.tax_cost,
    rev.merchant_tax_paid_usd,
    rev.merchant_tax_merch_eat_usd,
    rev.merchant_tax_amount_usd,
    rev.localized_merchant_tax_amount,
    rev.localized_merchant_tax_paid,
    rev.localized_merchant_tax_merch_eat,
    rev.tbd_remit_amount,

    rev.refund_amount,
    rev.localized_refund_amount,

    rev.original_full_cost_no_rebate_usd,
    rev.localized_original_full_cost_no_rebate,
    rev.localized_unity_wishpost_shipping,
    rev.unity_wishpost_shipping,
    rev.localized_initial_wishpost_shipping_amount,
    rev.initial_wishpost_shipping_amount,
    rev.localized_wishpost_shipping,
    rev.wishpost_shipping,
    rev.localized_wishpost_shipping_cost,
    rev.wishpost_shipping_cost,
    rev.localized_total_cost,
    rev.total_cost,
    rev.localized_full_cost_no_rebate_for_aplus,
    rev.full_cost_no_rebate_for_aplus_usd,
    rev.localized_full_cost_for_aplus,
    rev.full_cost_for_aplus,

    rev.original_rev_share,
    rev.updated_rev_share,

    rev.net_amount
        - rev.paid_merchant_usd
        - rev.merchant_eat_cost_amount_usd
        - rev.tax_cost
        - rev.merchant_tax_paid_usd
        - rev.merchant_tax_merch_eat_usd as commission_revenue
from {{ source('analytics', 'daily_rev_tahoe') }} as rev

approved_cards.usage: Filter metric_time / dt first for partition pruning. Use order_approved_day for LA revenue recognition; transaction_day for checkout analysis. GMV = price_before_promotions + shipping_before_promotions; net GMV = net_amount. Commission = net − paid_merchant − MEC − tax components. Dedupe on grain keys before summing when append duplicates are suspected.
approved_cards.description: Order-item (variation) grain daily revenue fact for approved Wish marketplace commerce lines. Grain is one row per (transaction_id, order_id, variation_id) sourced from wish.fact_trans_detail with USD-normalized financials and cart-level amounts prorated to merchant-order lines. Excludes PENDING, DECLINED, and EXCEPTION item states at load time. Business revenue day is America/Los_Angeles date from order_approved_time (order_approved_day); Hive partition dt is the load batch end date — filter dt for pruning and order_approved_day for reporting. Duplicate rows can exist across append loads; dedupe before aggregates when sums must reconcile. Source: analytics.daily_rev_tahoe (Airflow DAG DailyRevTahoeNew).
approved_cards.selection_notes: analytics.daily_rev_tahoe 是 Wish marketplace dws 层日级事实，order-item (variation) 粒度，gmv / net_gmv 字段为 USD。该模型本身只覆盖 Wish 交易（无 platform 字段），is_cancelled='false' 用于排除取消订单。dt 为 partition_date。glossary exp.gmv 的口径以 fct_transaction_variations 为准但本模型与之一致（按 variation 粒度 + USD 归一）。

approved_cards.usage: Filter metric_time / dt first. Pre-aggregated merchant-day grain — sum stored measures for rollups. Full outer joins upstream can leave null measure groups (orders vs engagement vs PB vs fines). Join wish.dim_all_merchants / MQS on merchant_id in Tableau models, not here. ttd_sum / we_ttd_sum are duration sums in seconds, not timestamps. gmv_eu / we_gmv_eu / fbw_gmv_eu use legacy region= 'Europe' and may under-count vs live NWE+SEE. Do not confuse with wishpost_dev.daily_commerce_merchant_metrics.
approved_cards.description: Merchant-day commerce performance fact for Supply / BD / WBR reporting. Each row aggregates a merchant's daily GMV (overall, Wish Express, Streamline / secondary warehouse, FBW / FBW v2), merchant-priced GMV and cost, engagement (impressions, clicks, add-to-carts), order and quantity counts, refund amounts and refund order counts (overall / quality / logistics, with Wish Express slices), delivery and late-fulfillment measures (including time-to-deliver duration sums), geo GMV (US / EU and FBW US / EU), L1 category GMV (all and Wish Express), ProductBoost spend and paid impressions (including Intense Boost), and Darwin fine counts by fine type. Grain is one row per merchant_id × dt. Order measures exclude LTD products and pending/declined/exception/require-review states upstream. Unpartitioned Parquet; always filter dt. Not the wishpost_dev sibling table (different schema). Source: supply.daily_commerce_merchant_metrics (daily_merchant_metrics.py / dailymerchant02).
approved_cards.selection_notes: supply.daily_commerce_merchant_metrics 是 merchant-day 粒度的 commerce 事实，gmv / num_orders_m 可直接按月聚合；用作 dws 备选（无 platform 字段，仅 Wish）。

reasons.approve: 两个 Wish dws 模型都含 gmv/net_gmv 字段，可继续到 SQL 阶段起草草稿查询。
reasons.deny-comments: 步骤 2（catalog 检索 gmv 表）和 Wish 标识写法验证未完成，请补查后再提交。
reasons.deny-halt: 若 glossary 中 GMV 口径仍指向 fct_transaction_variations 而无 GMV 模型，停在此步避免口径错配。
reasons.dryrun: 用户只要调研与草稿 SQL，dryrun 预览模型与字段映射即可，无需落库持久化。

approved_cards.name: daily_rev_tahoe
approved_cards.cte:
{{ config(
    materialized='view'
) }}

{#
  Thin Semantic Layer wrapper over analytics.daily_rev_tahoe.
  Grain: one row per approved commerce line (transaction_id, order_id, variation_id).
  Business revenue day: order_approved_time in America/Los_Angeles (order_approved_day).
  Partition dt is the Hive load batch key — filter for pruning, not business dating alone.
#}

select
    concat(rev.transaction_id, '|', rev.order_id, '|', rev.variation_id) as daily_rev_line_id,

    rev.transaction_id,
    rev.order_id,
    rev.variation_id,
    rev.user_id,
    rev.product_id,
    rev.merchant_id,
    rev.payment_id,
    rev.refund_transaction_id,

    cast(
        date_format(from_unixtime(rev.order_approved_time, 'America/Los_Angeles'), '%Y-%m-%d')
        as date
    ) as order_approved_day,
    cast(rev.dt as date) as dt,
    cast(rev.confirmed_date as date) as confirmed_ship_day,
    cast(
        date_format(from_unixtime(rev.transaction_time, 'America/Los_Angeles'), '%Y-%m-%d')
        as date
    ) as transaction_day,

    cast(from_unixtime(rev.transaction_time) as timestamp) as transaction_ts,
    cast(from_unixtime(rev.shipped_date) as timestamp) as shipped_ts,
    cast(from_unixtime(rev.merchant_payment_time) as timestamp) as merchant_payment_ts,
    cast(from_unixtime(rev.refunded_time) as timestamp) as refunded_ts,
    rev.transaction_time,
    rev.order_approved_time,
    rev.shipped_date,
    rev.merchant_payment_time,
    rev.refunded_time,

    rev.country_code,
    rev.country_state,
    rev.shipping_country,
    rev.shipping_state,
    rev.merchant_country,
    rev.currency,
    rev.merchant_source_currency,
    rev.conversion_rate,

    rev.payment_method,
    rev.transaction_state,
    case rev.transaction_state
        when 0 then 'Pending'
        when 1 then 'Approved'
        when 2 then 'Acknowledged'
        when 3 then 'Shipped'
        when 4 then 'Declined'
        when 5 then 'Refunded'
        when 6 then 'C2C On Delivery'
        when 7 then 'C2C Delivered'
        when 8 then 'C2C Accepted'
        when 10 then 'Exception'
        when 11 then 'Gift Waiting For Accept'
        when 12 then 'Require Review'
        when 13 then 'Delaying'
        when 14 then 'Label Generated'
        when 15 then 'Label Downloaded'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as transaction_state_name,
    rev.order_state,
    case rev.order_state
        when 0 then 'Pending'
        when 1 then 'Approved'
        when 2 then 'Acknowledged'
        when 3 then 'Shipped'
        when 4 then 'Declined'
        when 5 then 'Refunded'
        when 6 then 'C2C On Delivery'
        when 7 then 'C2C Delivered'
        when 8 then 'C2C Accepted'
        when 10 then 'Exception'
        when 11 then 'Gift Waiting For Accept'
        when 12 then 'Require Review'
        when 13 then 'Delaying'
        when 14 then 'Label Generated'
        when 15 then 'Label Downloaded'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as order_state_name,

    rev.is_cancelled,
    rev.is_wish_owned,
    rev.is_wish_express,
    rev.is_free_gift,
    rev.is_bnpl,
    rev.original_category,
    rev.updated_category,
    rev.cancelretry_ind,
    rev.fbs_purchase,
    rev.fbs_sale,
    rev.shopify_none,
    rev.is_eea,
    rev.is_fusion_resale,
    rev.is_unity_order,
    rev.is_unity_order_and_payment_enabled,

    rev.quantity,
    rev.price_before_promotions,
    rev.shipping_before_promotions,
    rev.price_before_promotions + rev.shipping_before_promotions as gmv,
    rev.flat_rate_shipping,
    rev.giftcard_amount,
    rev.discount_amount,
    rev.tax_amount,
    rev.tax_fee,
    rev.net_amount,
    rev.wishcash_usage,
    rev.retail_delivery_fee_amount,

    rev.merchant_price,
    rev.merchant_shipping,
    rev.localized_paid_merchant,
    rev.paid_merchant_usd,
    rev.merchant_shipping_cost,
    rev.localized_merchant_shipping_cost,
    rev.merchant_cost,
    rev.localized_merchant_cost,
    rev.localized_merchant_eat_cost_amount,
    rev.merchant_eat_cost_amount_usd,
    rev.tax_cost,
    rev.merchant_tax_paid_usd,
    rev.merchant_tax_merch_eat_usd,
    rev.merchant_tax_amount_usd,
    rev.localized_merchant_tax_amount,
    rev.localized_merchant_tax_paid,
    rev.localized_merchant_tax_merch_eat,
    rev.tbd_remit_amount,

    rev.refund_amount,
    rev.localized_refund_amount,

    rev.original_full_cost_no_rebate_usd,
    rev.localized_original_full_cost_no_rebate,
    rev.localized_unity_wishpost_shipping,
    rev.unity_wishpost_shipping,
    rev.localized_initial_wishpost_shipping_amount,
    rev.initial_wishpost_shipping_amount,
    rev.localized_wishpost_shipping,
    rev.wishpost_shipping,
    rev.localized_wishpost_shipping_cost,
    rev.wishpost_shipping_cost,
    rev.localized_total_cost,
    rev.total_cost,
    rev.localized_full_cost_no_rebate_for_aplus,
    rev.full_cost_no_rebate_for_aplus_usd,
    rev.localized_full_cost_for_aplus,
    rev.full_cost_for_aplus,

    rev.original_rev_share,
    rev.updated_rev_share,

    rev.net_amount
        - rev.paid_merchant_usd
        - rev.merchant_eat_cost_amount_usd
        - rev.tax_cost
        - rev.merchant_tax_paid_usd
        - rev.merchant_tax_merch_eat_usd as commission_revenue
from {{ source('analytics', 'daily_rev_tahoe') }} as rev

approved_cards.usage: Filter metric_time / dt first for partition pruning. Use order_approved_day for LA revenue recognition; transaction_day for checkout analysis. GMV = price_before_promotions + shipping_before_promotions; net GMV = net_amount. Commission = net − paid_merchant − MEC − tax components. Dedupe on grain keys before summing when append duplicates are suspected.
approved_cards.description: Order-item (variation) grain daily revenue fact for approved Wish marketplace commerce lines. Grain is one row per (transaction_id, order_id, variation_id) sourced from wish.fact_trans_detail with USD-normalized financials and cart-level amounts prorated to merchant-order lines. Excludes PENDING, DECLINED, and EXCEPTION item states at load time. Business revenue day is America/Los_Angeles date from order_approved_time (order_approved_day); Hive partition dt is the load batch end date — filter dt for pruning and order_approved_day for reporting. Duplicate rows can exist across append loads; dedupe before aggregates when sums must reconcile. Source: analytics.daily_rev_tahoe (Airflow DAG DailyRevTahoeNew).
approved_cards.selection_notes: analytics.daily_rev_tahoe 是 Wish marketplace dws 层日级事实，order-item (variation) 粒度，gmv / net_gmv 字段为 USD。该模型本身只覆盖 Wish 交易（无 platform 字段），is_cancelled='false' 用于排除取消订单。dt 为 partition_date。glossary exp.gmv 的口径以 fct_transaction_variations 为准但本模型与之一致（按 variation 粒度 + USD 归一）。

approved_cards.usage: Filter metric_time / dt first. Pre-aggregated merchant-day grain — sum stored measures for rollups. Full outer joins upstream can leave null measure groups (orders vs engagement vs PB vs fines). Join wish.dim_all_merchants / MQS on merchant_id in Tableau models, not here. ttd_sum / we_ttd_sum are duration sums in seconds, not timestamps. gmv_eu / we_gmv_eu / fbw_gmv_eu use legacy region= 'Europe' and may under-count vs live NWE+SEE. Do not confuse with wishpost_dev.daily_commerce_merchant_metrics.
approved_cards.description: Merchant-day commerce performance fact for Supply / BD / WBR reporting. Each row aggregates a merchant's daily GMV (overall, Wish Express, Streamline / secondary warehouse, FBW / FBW v2), merchant-priced GMV and cost, engagement (impressions, clicks, add-to-carts), order and quantity counts, refund amounts and refund order counts (overall / quality / logistics, with Wish Express slices), delivery and late-fulfillment measures (including time-to-deliver duration sums), geo GMV (US / EU and FBW US / EU), L1 category GMV (all and Wish Express), ProductBoost spend and paid impressions (including Intense Boost), and Darwin fine counts by fine type. Grain is one row per merchant_id × dt. Order measures exclude LTD products and pending/declined/exception/require-review states upstream. Unpartitioned Parquet; always filter dt. Not the wishpost_dev sibling table (different schema). Source: supply.daily_commerce_merchant_metrics (daily_merchant_metrics.py / dailymerchant02).
approved_cards.selection_notes: supply.daily_commerce_merchant_metrics 是 merchant-day 粒度的 commerce 事实，gmv / num_orders_m 可直接按月聚合；用作 dws 备选（无 platform 字段，仅 Wish）。

approved_cards.name: daily_rev_tahoe
approved_cards.cte:
{{ config(
    materialized='view'
) }}

{#
  Thin Semantic Layer wrapper over analytics.daily_rev_tahoe.
  Grain: one row per approved commerce line (transaction_id, order_id, variation_id).
  Business revenue day: order_approved_time in America/Los_Angeles (order_approved_day).
  Partition dt is the Hive load batch key — filter for pruning, not business dating alone.
#}

select
    concat(rev.transaction_id, '|', rev.order_id, '|', rev.variation_id) as daily_rev_line_id,

    rev.transaction_id,
    rev.order_id,
    rev.variation_id,
    rev.user_id,
    rev.product_id,
    rev.merchant_id,
    rev.payment_id,
    rev.refund_transaction_id,

    cast(
        date_format(from_unixtime(rev.order_approved_time, 'America/Los_Angeles'), '%Y-%m-%d')
        as date
    ) as order_approved_day,
    cast(rev.dt as date) as dt,
    cast(rev.confirmed_date as date) as confirmed_ship_day,
    cast(
        date_format(from_unixtime(rev.transaction_time, 'America/Los_Angeles'), '%Y-%m-%d')
        as date
    ) as transaction_day,

    cast(from_unixtime(rev.transaction_time) as timestamp) as transaction_ts,
    cast(from_unixtime(rev.shipped_date) as timestamp) as shipped_ts,
    cast(from_unixtime(rev.merchant_payment_time) as timestamp) as merchant_payment_ts,
    cast(from_unixtime(rev.refunded_time) as timestamp) as refunded_ts,
    rev.transaction_time,
    rev.order_approved_time,
    rev.shipped_date,
    rev.merchant_payment_time,
    rev.refunded_time,

    rev.country_code,
    rev.country_state,
    rev.shipping_country,
    rev.shipping_state,
    rev.merchant_country,
    rev.currency,
    rev.merchant_source_currency,
    rev.conversion_rate,

    rev.payment_method,
    rev.transaction_state,
    case rev.transaction_state
        when 0 then 'Pending'
        when 1 then 'Approved'
        when 2 then 'Acknowledged'
        when 3 then 'Shipped'
        when 4 then 'Declined'
        when 5 then 'Refunded'
        when 6 then 'C2C On Delivery'
        when 7 then 'C2C Delivered'
        when 8 then 'C2C Accepted'
        when 10 then 'Exception'
        when 11 then 'Gift Waiting For Accept'
        when 12 then 'Require Review'
        when 13 then 'Delaying'
        when 14 then 'Label Generated'
        when 15 then 'Label Downloaded'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as transaction_state_name,
    rev.order_state,
    case rev.order_state
        when 0 then 'Pending'
        when 1 then 'Approved'
        when 2 then 'Acknowledged'
        when 3 then 'Shipped'
        when 4 then 'Declined'
        when 5 then 'Refunded'
        when 6 then 'C2C On Delivery'
        when 7 then 'C2C Delivered'
        when 8 then 'C2C Accepted'
        when 10 then 'Exception'
        when 11 then 'Gift Waiting For Accept'
        when 12 then 'Require Review'
        when 13 then 'Delaying'
        when 14 then 'Label Generated'
        when 15 then 'Label Downloaded'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as order_state_name,

    rev.is_cancelled,
    rev.is_wish_owned,
    rev.is_wish_express,
    rev.is_free_gift,
    rev.is_bnpl,
    rev.original_category,
    rev.updated_category,
    rev.cancelretry_ind,
    rev.fbs_purchase,
    rev.fbs_sale,
    rev.shopify_none,
    rev.is_eea,
    rev.is_fusion_resale,
    rev.is_unity_order,
    rev.is_unity_order_and_payment_enabled,

    rev.quantity,
    rev.price_before_promotions,
    rev.shipping_before_promotions,
    rev.price_before_promotions + rev.shipping_before_promotions as gmv,
    rev.flat_rate_shipping,
    rev.giftcard_amount,
    rev.discount_amount,
    rev.tax_amount,
    rev.tax_fee,
    rev.net_amount,
    rev.wishcash_usage,
    rev.retail_delivery_fee_amount,

    rev.merchant_price,
    rev.merchant_shipping,
    rev.localized_paid_merchant,
    rev.paid_merchant_usd,
    rev.merchant_shipping_cost,
    rev.localized_merchant_shipping_cost,
    rev.merchant_cost,
    rev.localized_merchant_cost,
    rev.localized_merchant_eat_cost_amount,
    rev.merchant_eat_cost_amount_usd,
    rev.tax_cost,
    rev.merchant_tax_paid_usd,
    rev.merchant_tax_merch_eat_usd,
    rev.merchant_tax_amount_usd,
    rev.localized_merchant_tax_amount,
    rev.localized_merchant_tax_paid,
    rev.localized_merchant_tax_merch_eat,
    rev.tbd_remit_amount,

    rev.refund_amount,
    rev.localized_refund_amount,

    rev.original_full_cost_no_rebate_usd,
    rev.localized_original_full_cost_no_rebate,
    rev.localized_unity_wishpost_shipping,
    rev.unity_wishpost_shipping,
    rev.localized_initial_wishpost_shipping_amount,
    rev.initial_wishpost_shipping_amount,
    rev.localized_wishpost_shipping,
    rev.wishpost_shipping,
    rev.localized_wishpost_shipping_cost,
    rev.wishpost_shipping_cost,
    rev.localized_total_cost,
    rev.total_cost,
    rev.localized_full_cost_no_rebate_for_aplus,
    rev.full_cost_no_rebate_for_aplus_usd,
    rev.localized_full_cost_for_aplus,
    rev.full_cost_for_aplus,

    rev.original_rev_share,
    rev.updated_rev_share,

    rev.net_amount
        - rev.paid_merchant_usd
        - rev.merchant_eat_cost_amount_usd
        - rev.tax_cost
        - rev.merchant_tax_paid_usd
        - rev.merchant_tax_merch_eat_usd as commission_revenue
from {{ source('analytics', 'daily_rev_tahoe') }} as rev

    materialized='view'

{#
  Thin Semantic Layer wrapper over bi.order_level.
  Grain: one row per merchant order (m_transaction_id) within partition dt.
  Source: Airflow DAG bi_order_level (daily 06:00 America/Los_Angeles).
#}

select
    concat(ol.m_transaction_id, '|', ol.dt) as order_level_id,

    ol.m_transaction_id,
    ol.transaction_id,
    ol.variation_id,
    ol.user_id,
    ol.merchant_id,
    ol.product_id,
    ol.tracking_id,

    ol.client,
    case ol.client
        when 'web' then 'Web'
        when 'iosapp' then 'iOS App'
        when 'androidapp' then 'Android App'
        when 'mobileweb' then 'Mobile Web'
        when 'Other' then 'Other'
        else ol.client
    end as client_name,

    ol.payment_method,

    ol.fulfilled,
    case ol.fulfilled
        when 1 then 'Confirmed shipped'
        when 0 then 'Not confirmed shipped'
        else cast(ol.fulfilled as varchar)
    end as fulfilled_name,

    ol.order_flat_rate_eligible,
    case ol.order_flat_rate_eligible
        when 1 then 'Eligible'
        when 0 then 'Not eligible'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as order_flat_rate_eligible_name,

    ol.order_flat_rate_qualified,
    case ol.order_flat_rate_qualified
        when 1 then 'Qualified'
        when 0 then 'Not qualified'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as order_flat_rate_qualified_name,

    ol.delivery_program,

    ol.wishpost_data_mature,
    case ol.wishpost_data_mature
        when 1 then 'Mature'
        when 0 then 'Immature'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as wishpost_data_mature_name,

    ol.refund_data_mature,
    case ol.refund_data_mature
        when 1 then 'Mature'
        when 0 then 'Immature'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as refund_data_mature_name,

    ol.is_pb,
    case ol.is_pb
        when 1 then 'Product Boost'
        when 0 then 'Not Product Boost'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as is_pb_name,

    ol.is_currently_bd_managed,
    case ol.is_currently_bd_managed
        when 1 then 'BD managed'
        when 0 then 'General support'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as is_currently_bd_managed_name,

    cast(ol.dt as date) as dt,
    cast(ol.transaction_dt as date) as transaction_dt,
    cast(ol.order_approved_dt as date) as order_approved_dt,
    cast(ol.refund_dt as date) as refund_dt,

    ol.buyer_lifecycle,
    ol.touch_event,
    ol.channel,
    ol.wss_tier,
    ol.shipping_country,
    ol.region,
    case upper(ol.region)
        when 'APAC' then 'Asia-Pacific'
        when 'LATAM' then 'Latin America'
        when 'MEA' then 'Middle East & Africa'
        when 'NWE' then 'Northern/Western Europe'
        when 'SEE' then 'Southern/Eastern Europe'
        when 'USCAN' then 'United States and Canada'
        else ol.region
    end as region_name,
    ol.country_name,
    ol.merchant_country,
    ol.merchant_country_group,
    ol.most_recent_bd_rep,

    ol.refund_reason_category,
    ol.md_refund_reason,
    ol.refund_type,

    ol.item_price,
    ol.gmv,
    ol.mkpl_revenue,
    ol.quantity,
    ol.discount_amount,
    ol.gross_gmv,
    ol.net_gmv,
    ol.total_shipping_paid_by_consumer,
    ol.refund_amount,
    ol.wishpost_sales_usd,
    ol.wishpost_costs_usd
from {{ source('bi', 'order_level') }} as ol

approved_cards.usage: Filter metric_time / dt first for partition pruning. Commerce GMV on dt uses payment-received day from fct_transaction_variations; finance gross_gmv / net_gmv align with order_approved_dt (LA). WishPost logistics in daily_finance_metrics groups by order_approved_dt, not dt. Use refund_data_mature = 1 for stable refund rates; wishpost_data_mature = 1 for stable logistics P&L. gmv ≠ gross_gmv — different definitions.
approved_cards.description: BI source-of-truth order fact at merchant-transaction grain (m_transaction_id). Each row is one merchant order enriched with fulfillment, flat-rate shipping flags, WishPost logistics P&L, refund reason labels, buyer lifecycle / marketing attribution, Wish Standards (WSS) tier, buyer geo, merchant BD mapping, finance GMV components, and Product Boost attribution. Deduplicated from variation-level commerce to one row per m_transaction_id within partition dt (payment-received day, America/Los_Angeles). Daily refresh overwrites last 100 calendar days. LTD products excluded upstream. gmv is variation commerce GMV; gross_gmv and net_gmv are finance-spine definitions from daily_rev_tahoe. Source: bi.order_level (Airflow DAG bi_order_level).
approved_cards.selection_notes: BI source-of-truth m_transaction_id grain with gmv/net_gmv/gross_gmv/mature_gmv and refund_amount; useful for cross-checking the daily_rev_tahoe totals.

approved_sql:
-- Wish last calendar month GMV (USD-normalized) from m_transaction_id grain
SELECT
  SUM(net_gmv)    AS total_net_gmv_usd,
  SUM(gross_gmv)  AS total_gross_gmv_usd
FROM bi.order_level
WHERE dt >= date_format(date_trunc('month', current_date - interval '1' month), '%Y-%m-%d')
  AND dt <  date_format(date_trunc('month', current_date), '%Y-%m-%d')

reasons.approve: the two committed models (daily_rev_tahoe item-grain + order_level order-grain) give you complementary USD-normalized GMV fields with refund/cancel filters, enough to answer the glossary questions.
reasons.deny-comments: send this back if you need a Wish-only channel/site_id filter model or an ads-layer GMV table, since the current two cards don't expose platform/site_id dimensions for confirming the Wish filter.
reasons.deny-halt: stop here if the user truly wants no SQL at all and only a written glossary confirmation, since proceeding to SQL generation contradicts their explicit '只做术语表检索' request.
reasons.dryrun: preview the lookup without saving, since the user asked for terminology confirmation only and you may want to verify card coverage before committing a profile.

reasons.approve: Single read-only SUM on bi.order_level using the prior month partition (dt) — simple, low-risk and matches the approved card.
reasons.deny-comments: Use this if the reviewer wants the order-item grain from analytics.daily_rev_tahoe or a different status filter (e.g. exclude cancelled / only paid).
reasons.deny-halt: Use this if 'last month' should be defined differently (trailing 30 days, fiscal month, or a different platform filter).
reasons.dryrun: Preview only — no query execution or profile artifact will be saved.

        when 'androidapp' then 'Android App'
        when 'mobileweb' then 'Mobile Web'
        when 'Other' then 'Other'
        else ol.client
    end as client_name,

    ol.payment_method,

    ol.fulfilled,
    case ol.fulfilled
        when 1 then 'Confirmed shipped'
        when 0 then 'Not confirmed shipped'
        else cast(ol.fulfilled as varchar)
    end as fulfilled_name,

    ol.order_flat_rate_eligible,
    case ol.order_flat_rate_eligible
        when 1 then 'Eligible'
        when 0 then 'Not eligible'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as order_flat_rate_eligible_name,

    ol.order_flat_rate_qualified,
    case ol.order_flat_rate_qualified
        when 1 then 'Qualified'
        when 0 then 'Not qualified'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as order_flat_rate_qualified_name,

    ol.delivery_program,

    ol.wishpost_data_mature,
    case ol.wishpost_data_mature
        when 1 then 'Mature'
        when 0 then 'Immature'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as wishpost_data_mature_name,

    ol.refund_data_mature,
    case ol.refund_data_mature
        when 1 then 'Mature'
        when 0 then 'Immature'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as refund_data_mature_name,

    ol.is_pb,
    case ol.is_pb
        when 1 then 'Product Boost'
        when 0 then 'Not Product Boost'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as is_pb_name,

    ol.is_currently_bd_managed,
    case ol.is_currently_bd_managed
        when 1 then 'BD managed'
        when 0 then 'General support'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as is_currently_bd_managed_name,

    cast(ol.dt as date) as dt,
    cast(ol.transaction_dt as date) as transaction_dt,
    cast(ol.order_approved_dt as date) as order_approved_dt,
    cast(ol.refund_dt as date) as refund_dt,

    ol.buyer_lifecycle,
    ol.touch_event,
    ol.channel,
    ol.wss_tier,
    ol.shipping_country,
    ol.region,
    case upper(ol.region)
        when 'APAC' then 'Asia-Pacific'
        when 'LATAM' then 'Latin America'
        when 'MEA' then 'Middle East & Africa'
        when 'NWE' then 'Northern/Western Europe'
        when 'SEE' then 'Southern/Eastern Europe'
        when 'USCAN' then 'United States and Canada'
        else ol.region
    end as region_name,
    ol.country_name,
    ol.merchant_country,
    ol.merchant_country_group,
    ol.most_recent_bd_rep,

    ol.refund_reason_category,
    ol.md_refund_reason,
    ol.refund_type,

    ol.item_price,
    ol.gmv,
    ol.mkpl_revenue,
    ol.quantity,
    ol.discount_amount,
    ol.gross_gmv,
    ol.net_gmv,
    ol.total_shipping_paid_by_consumer,
    ol.refund_amount,
    ol.wishpost_sales_usd,

approved_cards.usage: Filter metric_time / dt first for partition pruning. Commerce GMV on dt uses payment-received day from fct_transaction_variations; finance gross_gmv / net_gmv align with order_approved_dt (LA). WishPost logistics in daily_finance_metrics groups by order_approved_dt, not dt. Use refund_data_mature = 1 for stable refund rates; wishpost_data_mature = 1 for stable logistics P&L. gmv ≠ gross_gmv — different definitions.
approved_cards.description: BI source-of-truth order fact at merchant-transaction grain (m_transaction_id). Each row is one merchant order enriched with fulfillment, flat-rate shipping flags, WishPost logistics P&L, refund reason labels, buyer lifecycle / marketing attribution, Wish Standards (WSS) tier, buyer geo, merchant BD mapping, finance GMV components, and Product Boost attribution. Deduplicated from variation-level commerce to one row per m_transaction_id within partition dt (payment-received day, America/Los_Angeles). Daily refresh overwrites last 100 calendar days. LTD products excluded upstream. gmv is variation commerce GMV; gross_gmv and net_gmv are finance-spine definitions from daily_rev_tahoe. Source: bi.order_level (Airflow DAG bi_order_level).
approved_cards.selection_notes: BI source-of-truth m_transaction_id grain, USD-normalized gmv / net_gmv / gross_gmv / mature_gmv plus refund_amount; dt is the partition key.

{{ config(
    materialized='view'
) }}

{#
  Thin Semantic Layer wrapper over core_data.fct_transaction_variations.
  Grain: one row per (transaction_id, variation_id) within partition dt.
#}

select
    concat(txn.transaction_id, '|', txn.variation_id) as transaction_variation_id,

    txn.transaction_id,
    txn.variation_id,
    txn.order_id,
    txn.user_id,
    txn.merchant_id,
    txn.product_id,
    txn.visitor_id,
    txn.seed_visitor_id,

    txn.payment_received_time,
    txn.transaction_time,
    cast(txn.dt as date) as dt,
    cast(from_unixtime(txn.transaction_timestamp) as timestamp) as transaction_ts,
    cast(from_unixtime(txn.time) as timestamp) as payment_received_ts,
    txn.transaction_timestamp,
    txn.time,
    datediff(txn.payment_received_time, txn.transaction_time) as payment_lag_days,

    txn.shipping_country,
    txn.client,
    case txn.client
        when 0 then 'Web'
        when 1 then 'iPhone'
        when 2 then 'iPad'
        when 3 then 'Android'
        when 4 then 'Mobile Web'
        when 5 then 'Windows Desktop'
        when 6 then 'Windows Phone'
        when 7 then 'Android Instant App'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as client_name,
    txn.payment_type,
    case txn.payment_type
        when -1 then 'None'
        when 0 then 'PayPal'
        when 1 then 'Braintree'
        when 2 then 'Braintree Facebook Autofill'
        when 3 then 'Stripe'
        when 4 then 'Braintree Google Wallet'
        when 5 then 'Stripe Google Wallet'
        when 6 then 'Boleto'
        when 7 then 'Stripe Apple Pay'
        when 8 then 'Klarna'
        when 9 then 'Adyen'
        when 10 then 'Ebanx'
        when 11 then 'OXXO'
        when 12 then 'Unknown'
        when 13 then 'Twitter Buy Now'
        when 14 then 'Boku'
        when 15 then 'Affirm'
        when 16 then 'Braintree PayPal'
        when 17 then 'Stripe iDEAL'
        when 18 then 'PayNearMe'
        when 19 then 'Braintree Venmo'
        when 20 then 'Stripe Samsung Pay'
        when 21 then 'Buy Now Pay Later'
        when 22 then 'Paytm'
        when 23 then 'Xendit Invoice'
        when 24 then 'Facebook Checkout'
        when 25 then 'Adyen Banking'
        when 26 then 'Offline Cash'
        when 27 then 'Braintree ACH'
        when 28 then 'Shopify Checkout'
        when 29 then 'Pix'
        when 30 then 'Afterpay'
        when 31 then 'Klarna Paylater'
        when 32 then 'Cash App Pay'
        else 'Other'
    end as payment_type_name,
    txn.installments,
    coalesce(txn.installments, 1) > 1 as is_installment,
    txn.is_ltd_product,
    txn.is_temporary_user,

    txn.quantity,
    txn.total,
    txn.gmv_variation,
    txn.raw_revenue_variation,
    txn.raw_total_tax,
    txn.wish_cash_variation

approved_cards.cte:
{{ config(
    materialized='view'
) }}

{#
  Thin Semantic Layer wrapper over analytics.daily_rev_tahoe.
  Grain: one row per approved commerce line (transaction_id, order_id, variation_id).
  Business revenue day: order_approved_time in America/Los_Angeles (order_approved_day).
  Partition dt is the Hive load batch key — filter for pruning, not business dating alone.
#}

select
    concat(rev.transaction_id, '|', rev.order_id, '|', rev.variation_id) as daily_rev_line_id,

    rev.transaction_id,
    rev.order_id,
    rev.variation_id,
    rev.user_id,
    rev.product_id,
    rev.merchant_id,
    rev.payment_id,
    rev.refund_transaction_id,

    cast(
        date_format(from_unixtime(rev.order_approved_time, 'America/Los_Angeles'), '%Y-%m-%d')
        as date
    ) as order_approved_day,
    cast(rev.dt as date) as dt,
    cast(rev.confirmed_date as date) as confirmed_ship_day,
    cast(
        date_format(from_unixtime(rev.transaction_time, 'America/Los_Angeles'), '%Y-%m-%d')
        as date
    ) as transaction_day,

    cast(from_unixtime(rev.transaction_time) as timestamp) as transaction_ts,
    cast(from_unixtime(rev.shipped_date) as timestamp) as shipped_ts,
    cast(from_unixtime(rev.merchant_payment_time) as timestamp) as merchant_payment_ts,
    cast(from_unixtime(rev.refunded_time) as timestamp) as refunded_ts,
    rev.transaction_time,
    rev.order_approved_time,
    rev.shipped_date,
    rev.merchant_payment_time,
    rev.refunded_time,

    rev.country_code,
    rev.country_state,
    rev.shipping_country,
    rev.shipping_state,
    rev.merchant_country,
    rev.currency,
    rev.merchant_source_currency,
    rev.conversion_rate,

    rev.payment_method,
    rev.transaction_state,
    case rev.transaction_state
        when 0 then 'Pending'
        when 1 then 'Approved'
        when 2 then 'Acknowledged'
        when 3 then 'Shipped'
        when 4 then 'Declined'
        when 5 then 'Refunded'
        when 6 then 'C2C On Delivery'
        when 7 then 'C2C Delivered'
        when 8 then 'C2C Accepted'
        when 10 then 'Exception'
        when 11 then 'Gift Waiting For Accept'
        when 12 then 'Require Review'
        when 13 then 'Delaying'
        when 14 then 'Label Generated'
        when 15 then 'Label Downloaded'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as transaction_state_name,
    rev.order_state,
    case rev.order_state
        when 0 then 'Pending'
        when 1 then 'Approved'
        when 2 then 'Acknowledged'
        when 3 then 'Shipped'
        when 4 then 'Declined'
        when 5 then 'Refunded'
        when 6 then 'C2C On Delivery'
        when 7 then 'C2C Delivered'
        when 8 then 'C2C Accepted'
        when 10 then 'Exception'
        when 11 then 'Gift Waiting For Accept'
        when 12 then 'Require Review'
        when 13 then 'Delaying'
        when 14 then 'Label Generated'
        when 15 then 'Label Downloaded'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as order_state_name,

    rev.is_cancelled,
    rev.is_wish_owned,
    rev.is_wish_express,
    rev.is_free_gift,
    rev.is_bnpl,
    rev.original_category,
    rev.updated_category,
    rev.cancelretry_ind,
    rev.fbs_purchase,
    rev.fbs_sale,
    rev.shopify_none,
    rev.is_eea,
    rev.is_fusion_resale,
    rev.is_unity_order,
    rev.is_unity_order_and_payment_enabled,

    rev.quantity,
    rev.price_before_promotions,
    rev.shipping_before_promotions,
    rev.price_before_promotions + rev.shipping_before_promotions as gmv,
    rev.flat_rate_shipping,
    rev.giftcard_amount,
    rev.discount_amount,
    rev.tax_amount,
    rev.tax_fee,
    rev.net_amount,
    rev.wishcash_usage,
    rev.retail_delivery_fee_amount,

    rev.merchant_price,
    rev.merchant_shipping,
    rev.localized_paid_merchant,
    rev.paid_merchant_usd,
    rev.merchant_shipping_cost,
    rev.localized_merchant_shipping_cost,
    rev.merchant_cost,
    rev.localized_merchant_cost,
    rev.localized_merchant_eat_cost_amount,
    rev.merchant_eat_cost_amount_usd,
    rev.tax_cost,
    rev.merchant_tax_paid_usd,
    rev.merchant_tax_merch_eat_usd,
    rev.merchant_tax_amount_usd,
    rev.localized_merchant_tax_amount,
    rev.localized_merchant_tax_paid,
    rev.localized_merchant_tax_merch_eat,
    rev.tbd_remit_amount,

    rev.refund_amount,
    rev.localized_refund_amount,

    rev.original_full_cost_no_rebate_usd,
    rev.localized_original_full_cost_no_rebate,
    rev.localized_unity_wishpost_shipping,
    rev.unity_wishpost_shipping,
    rev.localized_initial_wishpost_shipping_amount,
    rev.initial_wishpost_shipping_amount,
    rev.localized_wishpost_shipping,
    rev.wishpost_shipping,
    rev.localized_wishpost_shipping_cost,
    rev.wishpost_shipping_cost,
    rev.localized_total_cost,
    rev.total_cost,
    rev.localized_full_cost_no_rebate_for_aplus,
    rev.full_cost_no_rebate_for_aplus_usd,
    rev.localized_full_cost_for_aplus,
    rev.full_cost_for_aplus,

    rev.original_rev_share,
    rev.updated_rev_share,

    rev.net_amount
        - rev.paid_merchant_usd
        - rev.merchant_eat_cost_amount_usd
        - rev.tax_cost
        - rev.merchant_tax_paid_usd
        - rev.merchant_tax_merch_eat_usd as commission_revenue
from {{ source('analytics', 'daily_rev_tahoe') }} as rev

approved_cards.usage: Filter metric_time / dt first for partition pruning. Use order_approved_day for LA revenue recognition; transaction_day for checkout analysis. GMV = price_before_promotions + shipping_before_promotions; net GMV = net_amount. Commission = net − paid_merchant − MEC − tax components. Dedupe on grain keys before summing when append duplicates are suspected.
approved_cards.description: Order-item (variation) grain daily revenue fact for approved Wish marketplace commerce lines. Grain is one row per (transaction_id, order_id, variation_id) sourced from wish.fact_trans_detail with USD-normalized financials and cart-level amounts prorated to merchant-order lines. Excludes PENDING, DECLINED, and EXCEPTION item states at load time. Business revenue day is America/Los_Angeles date from order_approved_time (order_approved_day); Hive partition dt is the load batch end date — filter dt for pruning and order_approved_day for reporting. Duplicate rows can exist across append loads; dedupe before aggregates when sums must reconcile. Source: analytics.daily_rev_tahoe (Airflow DAG DailyRevTahoeNew).

gate_decisions.comments: 请提交具体模型卡片后再继续，优先 fct_transaction_variations 或 order_level，卡片上要能看到模型名。

reasons.approve: Approve and proceed to SQL — the confirmed dimensions (partition date, USD) are enough to run the Wish GMV query directly.
reasons.deny-comments: Send back for revision — with no committed models yet, you should request specific dws/ads GMV layers be selected before proceeding.
reasons.deny-halt: Halt without SQL — multiple GMV definitions remain unresolved and shipping a value would risk returning the wrong metric.
reasons.dryrun: Run in dryrun first — preview the dws vs ads GMV results side by side so you can decide which definition to commit.

reasons.approve: Approve here if you accept fct_transaction_variations and order_level with partition-dated USD GMV as sufficient and want to move directly into SQL drafting.
reasons.deny-comments: Deny-comments so you can revise the cards with concrete metric and dimension picks (e.g. gmv vs net_gmv vs gross_gmv) and a clear refund-handling policy before we proceed.
reasons.deny-halt: Deny-halt if the dws-vs-ads caliber ambiguity, refund treatment, and data-lag caveats make posting a single GMV number unsafe at this stage.
reasons.dryrun: Dryrun if you want a preview query against fct_transaction_variations or order_level for September 2025 without committing a card profile yet.

approved_cards.name: order_level
approved_cards.cte:
{{ config(
    materialized='view'
) }}

{#
  Thin Semantic Layer wrapper over bi.order_level.
  Grain: one row per merchant order (m_transaction_id) within partition dt.
  Source: Airflow DAG bi_order_level (daily 06:00 America/Los_Angeles).
#}

select
    concat(ol.m_transaction_id, '|', ol.dt) as order_level_id,

    ol.m_transaction_id,
    ol.transaction_id,
    ol.variation_id,
    ol.user_id,
    ol.merchant_id,
    ol.product_id,
    ol.tracking_id,

    ol.client,
    case ol.client
        when 'web' then 'Web'
        when 'iosapp' then 'iOS App'
        when 'androidapp' then 'Android App'
        when 'mobileweb' then 'Mobile Web'
        when 'Other' then 'Other'
        else ol.client
    end as client_name,

    ol.payment_method,

    ol.fulfilled,
    case ol.fulfilled
        when 1 then 'Confirmed shipped'
        when 0 then 'Not confirmed shipped'
        else cast(ol.fulfilled as varchar)
    end as fulfilled_name,

    ol.order_flat_rate_eligible,
    case ol.order_flat_rate_eligible
        when 1 then 'Eligible'
        when 0 then 'Not eligible'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as order_flat_rate_eligible_name,

    ol.order_flat_rate_qualified,
    case ol.order_flat_rate_qualified
        when 1 then 'Qualified'
        when 0 then 'Not qualified'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as order_flat_rate_qualified_name,

    ol.delivery_program,

    ol.wishpost_data_mature,
    case ol.wishpost_data_mature
        when 1 then 'Mature'
        when 0 then 'Immature'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as wishpost_data_mature_name,

    ol.refund_data_mature,
    case ol.refund_data_mature
        when 1 then 'Mature'
        when 0 then 'Immature'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as refund_data_mature_name,

    ol.is_pb,
    case ol.is_pb
        when 1 then 'Product Boost'
        when 0 then 'Not Product Boost'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as is_pb_name,

    ol.is_currently_bd_managed,
    case ol.is_currently_bd_managed
        when 1 then 'BD managed'
        when 0 then 'General support'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as is_currently_bd_managed_name,

    cast(ol.dt as date) as dt,
    cast(ol.transaction_dt as date) as transaction_dt,
    cast(ol.order_approved_dt as date) as order_approved_dt,
    cast(ol.refund_dt as date) as refund_dt,

    ol.buyer_lifecycle,
    ol.touch_event,
    ol.channel,
    ol.wss_tier,
    ol.shipping_country,
    ol.region,
    case upper(ol.region)
        when 'APAC' then 'Asia-Pacific'
        when 'LATAM' then 'Latin America'
        when 'MEA' then 'Middle East & Africa'
        when 'NWE' then 'Northern/Western Europe'
        when 'SEE' then 'Southern/Eastern Europe'
        when 'USCAN' then 'United States and Canada'
        else ol.region
    end as region_name,
    ol.country_name,
    ol.merchant_country,
    ol.merchant_country_group,
    ol.most_recent_bd_rep,

    ol.refund_reason_category,
    ol.md_refund_reason,
    ol.refund_type,

    ol.item_price,
    ol.gmv,
    ol.mkpl_revenue,
    ol.quantity,
    ol.discount_amount,
    ol.gross_gmv,
    ol.net_gmv,
    ol.total_shipping_paid_by_consumer,
    ol.refund_amount,
    ol.wishpost_sales_usd,
    ol.wishpost_costs_usd
from {{ source('bi', 'order_level') }} as ol

Commerce GMV on dt uses payment-received day from fct_transaction_variations; finance gross_gmv / net_gmv align with order_approved_dt (LA). WishPost logistics in daily_finance_metrics groups by order_approved_dt, not dt. Use refund_data_mature = 1 for stable refund rates; wishpost_data_mature = 1 for stable logistics P&L. gmv ≠ gross_gmv — different definitions.
approved_cards.description: BI source-of-truth order fact at merchant-transaction grain (m_transaction_id). Each row is one merchant order enriched with fulfillment, flat-rate shipping flags, WishPost logistics P&L, refund reason labels, buyer lifecycle / marketing attribution, Wish Standards (WSS) tier, buyer geo, merchant BD mapping, finance GMV components, and Product Boost attribution. Deduplicated from variation-level commerce to one row per m_transaction_id within partition dt (payment-received day, America/Los_Angeles). Daily refresh overwrites last 100 calendar days. LTD products excluded upstream. gmv is variation commerce GMV; gross_gmv and net_gmv are finance-spine definitions from daily_rev_tahoe. Source: bi.order_level (Airflow DAG bi_order_level).
approved_cards.selection_notes: BI source-of-truth m_transaction_id grain, USD-normalized gmv / net_gmv / gross_gmv / mature_gmv plus refund_amount; dt is the partition key.

{#
  Thin Semantic Layer wrapper over core_data.fct_transaction_variations.
  Grain: one row per (transaction_id, variation_id) within partition dt.
#}

select
    concat(txn.transaction_id, '|', txn.variation_id) as transaction_variation_id,

    txn.transaction_id,
    txn.variation_id,
    txn.order_id,
    txn.user_id,
    txn.merchant_id,
    txn.product_id,
    txn.visitor_id,
    txn.seed_visitor_id,

    txn.payment_received_time,
    txn.transaction_time,
    cast(txn.dt as date) as dt,
    cast(from_unixtime(txn.transaction_timestamp) as timestamp) as transaction_ts,
    cast(from_unixtime(txn.time) as timestamp) as payment_received_ts,
    txn.transaction_timestamp,
    txn.time,
    datediff(txn.payment_received_time, txn.transaction_time) as payment_lag_days,

    txn.shipping_country,
    txn.client,
    case txn.client
        when 0 then 'Web'

        when 5 then 'Windows Desktop'
        when 6 then 'Windows Phone'
        when 7 then 'Android Instant App'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as client_name,
    txn.payment_type,
    case txn.payment_type
        when -1 then 'None'
        when 0 then 'PayPal'
        when 1 then 'Braintree'
        when 2 then 'Braintree Facebook Autofill'
        when 3 then 'Stripe'
        when 4 then 'Braintree Google Wallet'

        when 17 then 'Stripe iDEAL'
        when 18 then 'PayNearMe'
        when 19 then 'Braintree Venmo'
        when 20 then 'Stripe Samsung Pay'
        when 21 then 'Buy Now Pay Later'

{#
  Thin Semantic Layer wrapper over analytics.daily_rev_tahoe.
  Grain: one row per approved commerce line (transaction_id, order_id, variation_id).
  Business revenue day: order_approved_time in America/Los_Angeles (order_approved_day).
  Partition dt is the Hive load batch key — filter for pruning, not business dating alone.
#}

select
    concat(rev.transaction_id, '|', rev.order_id, '|', rev.variation_id) as daily_rev_line_id,

    rev.transaction_id,
    rev.order_id,
    rev.variation_id,
    rev.user_id,
    rev.product_id,
    rev.merchant_id,
    rev.payment_id,
    rev.refund_transaction_id,

    cast(
        date_format(from_unixtime(rev.order_approved_time, 'America/Los_Angeles'), '%Y-%m-%d')
        as date
    ) as order_approved_day,
    cast(rev.dt as date) as dt,
    cast(rev.confirmed_date as date) as confirmed_ship_day,
    cast(
        date_format(from_unixtime(rev.transaction_time, 'America/Los_Angeles'), '%Y-%m-%d')
        as date
    ) as transaction_day,

    cast(from_unixtime(rev.transaction_time) as timestamp) as transaction_ts,
    cast(from_unixtime(rev.shipped_date) as timestamp) as shipped_ts,
    cast(from_unixtime(rev.merchant_payment_time) as timestamp) as merchant_payment_ts,
    cast(from_unixtime(rev.refunded_time) as timestamp) as refunded_ts,
    rev.transaction_time,
    rev.order_approved_time,
    rev.shipped_date,
    rev.merchant_payment_time,
    rev.refunded_time,

    rev.country_code,
    rev.country_state,
    rev.shipping_country,
    rev.shipping_state,
    rev.merchant_country,
    rev.currency,
    rev.merchant_source_currency,
    rev.conversion_rate,

    rev.payment_method,
    rev.transaction_state,
    case rev.transaction_state
        when 0 then 'Pending'
        when 1 then 'Approved'
        when 2 then 'Acknowledged'
        when 3 then 'Shipped'
        when 4 then 'Declined'
        when 5 then 'Refunded'
        when 6 then 'C2C On Delivery'

        when 3 then 'Shipped'

        else 'Unknown'

    rev.is_cancelled,
    rev.is_wish_owned,
    rev.is_wish_express,
    rev.is_free_gift,
    rev.is_bnpl,
    rev.original_category,

    rev.is_unity_order,
    rev.is_unity_order_and_payment_enabled,

    rev.quantity,
    rev.price_before_promotions,
    rev.shipping_before_promotions,
    rev.price_before_promotions + rev.shipping_before_promotions as gmv,
    rev.flat_rate_shipping,

approved_cards.usage: Filter metric_time / dt first for partition pruning. Use order_approved_day for LA revenue recognition; transaction_day for checkout analysis. GMV = price_before_promotions + shipping_before_promotions; net GMV = net_amount. Commission = net − paid_merchant − MEC − tax components. Dedupe on grain keys before summing when append duplicates are suspected.
approved_cards.description: Order-item (variation) grain daily revenue fact for approved Wish marketplace commerce lines. Grain is one row per (transaction_id, order_id, variation_id) sourced from wish.fact_trans_detail with USD-normalized financials and cart-level amounts prorated to merchant-order lines. Excludes PENDING, DECLINED, and EXCEPTION item states at load time. Business revenue day is America/Los_Angeles date from order_approved_time (order_approved_day); Hive partition dt is the load batch end date — filter dt for pruning and order_approved_day for reporting. Duplicate rows can exist across append loads; dedupe before aggregates when sums must reconcile. Source: analytics.daily_rev_tahoe (Airflow DAG DailyRevTahoeNew).

approved_cards.name: order_level
approved_cards.cte:
{{ config(
    materialized='view'
) }}

{#
  Thin Semantic Layer wrapper over bi.order_level.
  Grain: one row per merchant order (m_transaction_id) within partition dt.
  Source: Airflow DAG bi_order_level (daily 06:00 America/Los_Angeles).
#}

select
    concat(ol.m_transaction_id, '|', ol.dt) as order_level_id,

    ol.m_transaction_id,
    ol.transaction_id,
    ol.variation_id,
    ol.user_id,
    ol.merchant_id,
    ol.product_id,
    ol.tracking_id,

    ol.client,
    case ol.client
        when 'web' then 'Web'
        when 'iosapp' then 'iOS App'
        when 'androidapp' then 'Android App'
        when 'mobileweb' then 'Mobile Web'
        when 'Other' then 'Other'
        else ol.client
    end as client_name,

    ol.payment_method,

    ol.fulfilled,
    case ol.fulfilled
        when 1 then 'Confirmed shipped'
        when 0 then 'Not confirmed shipped'
        else cast(ol.fulfilled as varchar)
    end as fulfilled_name,

    ol.order_flat_rate_eligible,
    case ol.order_flat_rate_eligible
        when 1 then 'Eligible'
        when 0 then 'Not eligible'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as order_flat_rate_eligible_name,

    ol.order_flat_rate_qualified,
    case ol.order_flat_rate_qualified
        when 1 then 'Qualified'
        when 0 then 'Not qualified'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as order_flat_rate_qualified_name,

    ol.delivery_program,

    ol.wishpost_data_mature,
    case ol.wishpost_data_mature
        when 1 then 'Mature'
        when 0 then 'Immature'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as wishpost_data_mature_name,

    ol.refund_data_mature,
    case ol.refund_data_mature
        when 1 then 'Mature'
        when 0 then 'Immature'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as refund_data_mature_name,

    ol.is_pb,
    case ol.is_pb
        when 1 then 'Product Boost'
        when 0 then 'Not Product Boost'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as is_pb_name,

    ol.is_currently_bd_managed,
    case ol.is_currently_bd_managed
        when 1 then 'BD managed'
        when 0 then 'General support'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as is_currently_bd_managed_name,

    cast(ol.dt as date) as dt,
    cast(ol.transaction_dt as date) as transaction_dt,
    cast(ol.order_approved_dt as date) as order_approved_dt,
    cast(ol.refund_dt as date) as refund_dt,

    ol.buyer_lifecycle,
    ol.touch_event,
    ol.channel,
    ol.wss_tier,
    ol.shipping_country,
    ol.region,
    case upper(ol.region)
        when 'APAC' then 'Asia-Pacific'
        when 'LATAM' then 'Latin America'
        when 'MEA' then 'Middle East & Africa'
        when 'NWE' then 'Northern/Western Europe'
        when 'SEE' then 'Southern/Eastern Europe'
        when 'USCAN' then 'United States and Canada'
        else ol.region
    end as region_name,
    ol.country_name,
    ol.merchant_country,
    ol.merchant_country_group,
    ol.most_recent_bd_rep,

    ol.refund_reason_category,
    ol.md_refund_reason,
    ol.refund_type,

    ol.item_price,
    ol.gmv,
    ol.mkpl_revenue,
    ol.quantity,
    ol.discount_amount,
    ol.gross_gmv,
    ol.net_gmv,
    ol.total_shipping_paid_by_consumer,
    ol.refund_amount,
    ol.wishpost_sales_usd,
    ol.wishpost_costs_usd
from {{ source('bi', 'order_level') }} as ol
