approved_cards.usage: Filter metric_time / dt first for partition pruning. Commerce GMV on dt uses payment-received day from fct_transaction_variations; finance gross_gmv / net_gmv align with order_approved_dt (LA). WishPost logistics in daily_finance_metrics groups by order_approved_dt, not dt. Use refund_data_mature = 1 for stable refund rates; wishpost_data_mature = 1 for stable logistics P&L. gmv ≠ gross_gmv — different definitions.
approved_cards.description: BI source-of-truth order fact at merchant-transaction grain (m_transaction_id). Each row is one merchant order enriched with fulfillment, flat-rate shipping flags, WishPost logistics P&L, refund reason labels, buyer lifecycle / marketing attribution, Wish Standards (WSS) tier, buyer geo, merchant BD mapping, finance GMV components, and Product Boost attribution. Deduplicated from variation-level commerce to one row per m_transaction_id within partition dt (payment-received day, America/Los_Angeles). Daily refresh overwrites last 100 calendar days. LTD products excluded upstream. gmv is variation commerce GMV; gross_gmv and net_gmv are finance-spine definitions from daily_rev_tahoe. Source: bi.order_level (Airflow DAG bi_order_level).
approved_cards.selection_notes: BI source-of-truth m_transaction_id grain; dt partition; net_gmv - refund_amount approximates paid GMV after refunds.

approved_cards.name: daily_rev_tahoe
approved_cards.cte:
{{ config(
    materialized='view'
) }}

{#
  Thin Semantic Layer wrapper over analytics.daily_rev_tahoe.
  Grain: one row per approved commerce line (transaction_id, order_id, variation_id).
  Business revenue day: order_approved_time in America/Los_Angeles (order_approved_day).
  Partition dt is the Hive load batch key — filter for pruning, not business dating alone.
#}

select
    concat(rev.transaction_id, '|', rev.order_id, '|', rev.variation_id) as daily_rev_line_id,

    rev.transaction_id,
    rev.order_id,
    rev.variation_id,
    rev.user_id,
    rev.product_id,
    rev.merchant_id,
    rev.payment_id,
    rev.refund_transaction_id,

    cast(
        date_format(from_unixtime(rev.order_approved_time, 'America/Los_Angeles'), '%Y-%m-%d')
        as date
    ) as order_approved_day,
    cast(rev.dt as date) as dt,
    cast(rev.confirmed_date as date) as confirmed_ship_day,
    cast(
        date_format(from_unixtime(rev.transaction_time, 'America/Los_Angeles'), '%Y-%m-%d')
        as date
    ) as transaction_day,

    cast(from_unixtime(rev.transaction_time) as timestamp) as transaction_ts,
    cast(from_unixtime(rev.shipped_date) as timestamp) as shipped_ts,
    cast(from_unixtime(rev.merchant_payment_time) as timestamp) as merchant_payment_ts,
    cast(from_unixtime(rev.refunded_time) as timestamp) as refunded_ts,
    rev.transaction_time,
    rev.order_approved_time,
    rev.shipped_date,
    rev.merchant_payment_time,
    rev.refunded_time,

    rev.country_code,
    rev.country_state,
    rev.shipping_country,
    rev.shipping_state,
    rev.merchant_country,
    rev.currency,
    rev.merchant_source_currency,
    rev.conversion_rate,

    rev.payment_method,
    rev.transaction_state,
    case rev.transaction_state
        when 0 then 'Pending'
        when 1 then 'Approved'
        when 2 then 'Acknowledged'
        when 3 then 'Shipped'
        when 4 then 'Declined'
        when 5 then 'Refunded'
        when 6 then 'C2C On Delivery'
        when 7 then 'C2C Delivered'
        when 8 then 'C2C Accepted'
        when 10 then 'Exception'
        when 11 then 'Gift Waiting For Accept'
        when 12 then 'Require Review'
        when 13 then 'Delaying'
        when 14 then 'Label Generated'
        when 15 then 'Label Downloaded'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as transaction_state_name,
    rev.order_state,
    case rev.order_state
        when 0 then 'Pending'
        when 1 then 'Approved'
        when 2 then 'Acknowledged'
        when 3 then 'Shipped'
        when 4 then 'Declined'
        when 5 then 'Refunded'
        when 6 then 'C2C On Delivery'
        when 7 then 'C2C Delivered'
        when 8 then 'C2C Accepted'
        when 10 then 'Exception'
        when 11 then 'Gift Waiting For Accept'
        when 12 then 'Require Review'
        when 13 then 'Delaying'
        when 14 then 'Label Generated'
        when 15 then 'Label Downloaded'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as order_state_name,

    rev.is_cancelled,
    rev.is_wish_owned,
    rev.is_wish_express,
    rev.is_free_gift,
    rev.is_bnpl,
    rev.original_category,
    rev.updated_category,
    rev.cancelretry_ind,
    rev.fbs_purchase,
    rev.fbs_sale,
    rev.shopify_none,
    rev.is_eea,
    rev.is_fusion_resale,
    rev.is_unity_order,
    rev.is_unity_order_and_payment_enabled,

    rev.quantity,
    rev.price_before_promotions,
    rev.shipping_before_promotions,
    rev.price_before_promotions + rev.shipping_before_promotions as gmv,
    rev.flat_rate_shipping,
    rev.giftcard_amount,
    rev.discount_amount,
    rev.tax_amount,
    rev.tax_fee,
    rev.net_amount,
    rev.wishcash_usage,
    rev.retail_delivery_fee_amount,

    rev.merchant_price,
    rev.merchant_shipping,
    rev.localized_paid_merchant,
    rev.paid_merchant_usd,
    rev.merchant_shipping_cost,
    rev.localized_merchant_shipping_cost,
    rev.merchant_cost,
    rev.localized_merchant_cost,
    rev.localized_merchant_eat_cost_amount,
    rev.merchant_eat_cost_amount_usd,
    rev.tax_cost,
    rev.merchant_tax_paid_usd,
    rev.merchant_tax_merch_eat_usd,
    rev.merchant_tax_amount_usd,
    rev.localized_merchant_tax_amount,
    rev.localized_merchant_tax_paid,
    rev.localized_merchant_tax_merch_eat,
    rev.tbd_remit_amount,

    rev.refund_amount,
    rev.localized_refund_amount,

    rev.original_full_cost_no_rebate_usd,
    rev.localized_original_full_cost_no_rebate,
    rev.localized_unity_wishpost_shipping,
    rev.unity_wishpost_shipping,
    rev.localized_initial_wishpost_shipping_amount,
    rev.initial_wishpost_shipping_amount,
    rev.localized_wishpost_shipping,
    rev.wishpost_shipping,
    rev.localized_wishpost_shipping_cost,
    rev.wishpost_shipping_cost,
    rev.localized_total_cost,
    rev.total_cost,
    rev.localized_full_cost_no_rebate_for_aplus,
    rev.full_cost_no_rebate_for_aplus_usd,
    rev.localized_full_cost_for_aplus,
    rev.full_cost_for_aplus,

    rev.original_rev_share,
    rev.updated_rev_share,

    rev.net_amount
        - rev.paid_merchant_usd
        - rev.merchant_eat_cost_amount_usd
        - rev.tax_cost
        - rev.merchant_tax_paid_usd
        - rev.merchant_tax_merch_eat_usd as commission_revenue
from {{ source('analytics', 'daily_rev_tahoe') }} as rev

GMV = price_before_promotions + shipping_before_promotions; net GMV = net_amount. Commission = net − paid_merchant − MEC − tax components. Dedupe on grain keys before summing when append duplicates are suspected.
approved_cards.description: Order-item (variation) grain daily revenue fact for approved Wish marketplace commerce lines. Grain is one row per (transaction_id, order_id, variation_id) sourced from wish.fact_trans_detail with USD-normalized financials and cart-level amounts prorated to merchant-order lines. Excludes PENDING, DECLINED, and EXCEPTION item states at load time. Business revenue day is America/Los_Angeles date from order_approved_time (order_approved_day); Hive partition dt is the load batch end date — filter dt for pruning and order_approved_day for reporting. Duplicate rows can exist across append loads; dedupe before aggregates when sums must reconcile. Source: analytics.daily_rev_tahoe (Airflow DAG DailyRevTahoeNew).
approved_cards.selection_notes: Order-item (transaction_id, order_id, variation_id) grain; dt partition; gmv / net_gmv / refund_amount available; supports site filter via client=4 and status filter via transaction_state / is_cancelled.

reasons.approve: Both order_level and daily_rev_tahoe cover Wish GMV with dt partitioning, net_gmv minus refund_amount, and site/status filters — ready to proceed to SQL.
reasons.deny-comments: Send back if you want a specific grain (e.g., daily vs order-level) or status filter spelled out before SQL generation.
reasons.deny-halt: Stop if Wish source access is restricted or the September window falls outside data retention — SQL won't help.
reasons.dryrun: Preview the SQL first if you want to verify the date math and table picks before saving a profile.

approved_cards.usage: Filter metric_time / dt first for partition pruning. Commerce GMV on dt uses payment-received day from fct_transaction_variations; finance gross_gmv / net_gmv align with order_approved_dt (LA). WishPost logistics in daily_finance_metrics groups by order_approved_dt, not dt. Use refund_data_mature = 1 for stable refund rates; wishpost_data_mature = 1 for stable logistics P&L. gmv ≠ gross_gmv — different definitions.
approved_cards.description: BI source-of-truth order fact at merchant-transaction grain (m_transaction_id). Each row is one merchant order enriched with fulfillment, flat-rate shipping flags, WishPost logistics P&L, refund reason labels, buyer lifecycle / marketing attribution, Wish Standards (WSS) tier, buyer geo, merchant BD mapping, finance GMV components, and Product Boost attribution. Deduplicated from variation-level commerce to one row per m_transaction_id within partition dt (payment-received day, America/Los_Angeles). Daily refresh overwrites last 100 calendar days. LTD products excluded upstream. gmv is variation commerce GMV; gross_gmv and net_gmv are finance-spine definitions from daily_rev_tahoe. Source: bi.order_level (Airflow DAG bi_order_level).
approved_cards.selection_notes: BI source-of-truth m_transaction_id grain; dt partition; net_gmv - refund_amount approximates paid GMV after refunds.

approved_cards.name: daily_rev_tahoe
approved_cards.cte:
{{ config(
    materialized='view'
) }}

{#
  Thin Semantic Layer wrapper over analytics.daily_rev_tahoe.
  Grain: one row per approved commerce line (transaction_id, order_id, variation_id).
  Business revenue day: order_approved_time in America/Los_Angeles (order_approved_day).
  Partition dt is the Hive load batch key — filter for pruning, not business dating alone.
#}

select
    concat(rev.transaction_id, '|', rev.order_id, '|', rev.variation_id) as daily_rev_line_id,

    rev.transaction_id,
    rev.order_id,
    rev.variation_id,
    rev.user_id,
    rev.product_id,
    rev.merchant_id,
    rev.payment_id,
    rev.refund_transaction_id,

    cast(
        date_format(from_unixtime(rev.order_approved_time, 'America/Los_Angeles'), '%Y-%m-%d')
        as date
    ) as order_approved_day,
    cast(rev.dt as date) as dt,
    cast(rev.confirmed_date as date) as confirmed_ship_day,
    cast(
        date_format(from_unixtime(rev.transaction_time, 'America/Los_Angeles'), '%Y-%m-%d')
        as date
    ) as transaction_day,

    cast(from_unixtime(rev.transaction_time) as timestamp) as transaction_ts,
    cast(from_unixtime(rev.shipped_date) as timestamp) as shipped_ts,
    cast(from_unixtime(rev.merchant_payment_time) as timestamp) as merchant_payment_ts,
    cast(from_unixtime(rev.refunded_time) as timestamp) as refunded_ts,
    rev.transaction_time,
    rev.order_approved_time,
    rev.shipped_date,
    rev.merchant_payment_time,
    rev.refunded_time,

    rev.country_code,
    rev.country_state,
    rev.shipping_country,
    rev.shipping_state,
    rev.merchant_country,
    rev.currency,
    rev.merchant_source_currency,
    rev.conversion_rate,

    rev.payment_method,
    rev.transaction_state,
    case rev.transaction_state
        when 0 then 'Pending'
        when 1 then 'Approved'
        when 2 then 'Acknowledged'
        when 3 then 'Shipped'
        when 4 then 'Declined'
        when 5 then 'Refunded'
        when 6 then 'C2C On Delivery'
        when 7 then 'C2C Delivered'
        when 8 then 'C2C Accepted'
        when 10 then 'Exception'
        when 11 then 'Gift Waiting For Accept'
        when 12 then 'Require Review'
        when 13 then 'Delaying'
        when 14 then 'Label Generated'
        when 15 then 'Label Downloaded'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as transaction_state_name,
    rev.order_state,
    case rev.order_state
        when 0 then 'Pending'
        when 1 then 'Approved'
        when 2 then 'Acknowledged'
        when 3 then 'Shipped'
        when 4 then 'Declined'
        when 5 then 'Refunded'
        when 6 then 'C2C On Delivery'
        when 7 then 'C2C Delivered'
        when 8 then 'C2C Accepted'
        when 10 then 'Exception'
        when 11 then 'Gift Waiting For Accept'
        when 12 then 'Require Review'
        when 13 then 'Delaying'
        when 14 then 'Label Generated'
        when 15 then 'Label Downloaded'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as order_state_name,

    rev.is_cancelled,
    rev.is_wish_owned,
    rev.is_wish_express,
    rev.is_free_gift,
    rev.is_bnpl,
    rev.original_category,
    rev.updated_category,
    rev.cancelretry_ind,
    rev.fbs_purchase,
    rev.fbs_sale,
    rev.shopify_none,
    rev.is_eea,
    rev.is_fusion_resale,
    rev.is_unity_order,
    rev.is_unity_order_and_payment_enabled,

    rev.quantity,
    rev.price_before_promotions,
    rev.shipping_before_promotions,
    rev.price_before_promotions + rev.shipping_before_promotions as gmv,
    rev.flat_rate_shipping,
    rev.giftcard_amount,
    rev.discount_amount,
    rev.tax_amount,
    rev.tax_fee,
    rev.net_amount,
    rev.wishcash_usage,
    rev.retail_delivery_fee_amount,

    rev.merchant_price,
    rev.merchant_shipping,
    rev.localized_paid_merchant,
    rev.paid_merchant_usd,
    rev.merchant_shipping_cost,
    rev.localized_merchant_shipping_cost,
    rev.merchant_cost,
    rev.localized_merchant_cost,
    rev.localized_merchant_eat_cost_amount,
    rev.merchant_eat_cost_amount_usd,
    rev.tax_cost,
    rev.merchant_tax_paid_usd,
    rev.merchant_tax_merch_eat_usd,
    rev.merchant_tax_amount_usd,
    rev.localized_merchant_tax_amount,
    rev.localized_merchant_tax_paid,
    rev.localized_merchant_tax_merch_eat,
    rev.tbd_remit_amount,

    rev.refund_amount,
    rev.localized_refund_amount,

    rev.original_full_cost_no_rebate_usd,
    rev.localized_original_full_cost_no_rebate,
    rev.localized_unity_wishpost_shipping,
    rev.unity_wishpost_shipping,
    rev.localized_initial_wishpost_shipping_amount,
    rev.initial_wishpost_shipping_amount,
    rev.localized_wishpost_shipping,
    rev.wishpost_shipping,
    rev.localized_wishpost_shipping_cost,
    rev.wishpost_shipping_cost,
    rev.localized_total_cost,
    rev.total_cost,
    rev.localized_full_cost_no_rebate_for_aplus,
    rev.full_cost_no_rebate_for_aplus_usd,
    rev.localized_full_cost_for_aplus,
    rev.full_cost_for_aplus,

    rev.original_rev_share,
    rev.updated_rev_share,

    rev.net_amount
        - rev.paid_merchant_usd
        - rev.merchant_eat_cost_amount_usd
        - rev.tax_cost
        - rev.merchant_tax_paid_usd
        - rev.merchant_tax_merch_eat_usd as commission_revenue
from {{ source('analytics', 'daily_rev_tahoe') }} as rev

approved_cards.usage: Filter metric_time / dt first for partition pruning. Use order_approved_day for LA revenue recognition; transaction_day for checkout analysis. GMV = price_before_promotions + shipping_before_promotions; net GMV = net_amount. Commission = net − paid_merchant − MEC − tax components. Dedupe on grain keys before summing when append duplicates are suspected.
approved_cards.description: Order-item (variation) grain daily revenue fact for approved Wish marketplace commerce lines. Grain is one row per (transaction_id, order_id, variation_id) sourced from wish.fact_trans_detail with USD-normalized financials and cart-level amounts prorated to merchant-order lines. Excludes PENDING, DECLINED, and EXCEPTION item states at load time. Business revenue day is America/Los_Angeles date from order_approved_time (order_approved_day); Hive partition dt is the load batch end date — filter dt for pruning and order_approved_day for reporting. Duplicate rows can exist across append loads; dedupe before aggregates when sums must reconcile. Source: analytics.daily_rev_tahoe (Airflow DAG DailyRevTahoeNew).
approved_cards.selection_notes: Order-item (transaction_id, order_id, variation_id) grain; dt partition; gmv / net_gmv / refund_amount available; supports site filter via client=4 and status filter via transaction_state / is_cancelled.

approved_sql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(net_gmv), 2) AS gmv_usd
FROM bi.order_level
WHERE dt >= date_format(date_trunc('month', current_date - interval '1' month), '%Y-%m-%d')
  AND dt <  date_format(date_trunc('month', current_date), '%Y-%m-%d')
  AND client = CAST(4 AS VARCHAR)

approved_cards.name: daily_rev_tahoe
approved_cards.cte:
{{ config(
    materialized='view'
) }}

{#
  Thin Semantic Layer wrapper over analytics.daily_rev_tahoe.
  Grain: one row per approved commerce line (transaction_id, order_id, variation_id).
  Business revenue day: order_approved_time in America/Los_Angeles (order_approved_day).
  Partition dt is the Hive load batch key — filter for pruning, not business dating alone.
#}

select
    concat(rev.transaction_id, '|', rev.order_id, '|', rev.variation_id) as daily_rev_line_id,

    rev.transaction_id,
    rev.order_id,
    rev.variation_id,
    rev.user_id,
    rev.product_id,
    rev.merchant_id,
    rev.payment_id,
    rev.refund_transaction_id,

    cast(
        date_format(from_unixtime(rev.order_approved_time, 'America/Los_Angeles'), '%Y-%m-%d')
        as date
    ) as order_approved_day,
    cast(rev.dt as date) as dt,
    cast(rev.confirmed_date as date) as confirmed_ship_day,
    cast(
        date_format(from_unixtime(rev.transaction_time, 'America/Los_Angeles'), '%Y-%m-%d')
        as date
    ) as transaction_day,

    cast(from_unixtime(rev.transaction_time) as timestamp) as transaction_ts,
    cast(from_unixtime(rev.shipped_date) as timestamp) as shipped_ts,
    cast(from_unixtime(rev.merchant_payment_time) as timestamp) as merchant_payment_ts,
    cast(from_unixtime(rev.refunded_time) as timestamp) as refunded_ts,
    rev.transaction_time,
    rev.order_approved_time,
    rev.shipped_date,
    rev.merchant_payment_time,
    rev.refunded_time,

    rev.country_code,
    rev.country_state,
    rev.shipping_country,
    rev.shipping_state,
    rev.merchant_country,
    rev.currency,
    rev.merchant_source_currency,
    rev.conversion_rate,

    rev.payment_method,
    rev.transaction_state,
    case rev.transaction_state
        when 0 then 'Pending'
        when 1 then 'Approved'
        when 2 then 'Acknowledged'
        when 3 then 'Shipped'
        when 4 then 'Declined'
        when 5 then 'Refunded'
        when 6 then 'C2C On Delivery'
        when 7 then 'C2C Delivered'
        when 8 then 'C2C Accepted'
        when 10 then 'Exception'
        when 11 then 'Gift Waiting For Accept'
        when 12 then 'Require Review'
        when 13 then 'Delaying'
        when 14 then 'Label Generated'
        when 15 then 'Label Downloaded'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as transaction_state_name,
    rev.order_state,
    case rev.order_state
        when 0 then 'Pending'
        when 1 then 'Approved'
        when 2 then 'Acknowledged'
        when 3 then 'Shipped'
        when 4 then 'Declined'
        when 5 then 'Refunded'
        when 6 then 'C2C On Delivery'
        when 7 then 'C2C Delivered'
        when 8 then 'C2C Accepted'
        when 10 then 'Exception'
        when 11 then 'Gift Waiting For Accept'
        when 12 then 'Require Review'
        when 13 then 'Delaying'
        when 14 then 'Label Generated'
        when 15 then 'Label Downloaded'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as order_state_name,

    rev.is_cancelled,
    rev.is_wish_owned,
    rev.is_wish_express,
    rev.is_free_gift,
    rev.is_bnpl,
    rev.original_category,
    rev.updated_category,
    rev.cancelretry_ind,
    rev.fbs_purchase,
    rev.fbs_sale,
    rev.shopify_none,
    rev.is_eea,
    rev.is_fusion_resale,
    rev.is_unity_order,
    rev.is_unity_order_and_payment_enabled,

    rev.quantity,
    rev.price_before_promotions,
    rev.shipping_before_promotions,
    rev.price_before_promotions + rev.shipping_before_promotions as gmv,
    rev.flat_rate_shipping,
    rev.giftcard_amount,
    rev.discount_amount,
    rev.tax_amount,
    rev.tax_fee,
    rev.net_amount,
    rev.wishcash_usage,
    rev.retail_delivery_fee_amount,

    rev.merchant_price,
    rev.merchant_shipping,
    rev.localized_paid_merchant,
    rev.paid_merchant_usd,
    rev.merchant_shipping_cost,
    rev.localized_merchant_shipping_cost,
    rev.merchant_cost,
    rev.localized_merchant_cost,
    rev.localized_merchant_eat_cost_amount,
    rev.merchant_eat_cost_amount_usd,
    rev.tax_cost,
    rev.merchant_tax_paid_usd,
    rev.merchant_tax_merch_eat_usd,
    rev.merchant_tax_amount_usd,
    rev.localized_merchant_tax_amount,
    rev.localized_merchant_tax_paid,
    rev.localized_merchant_tax_merch_eat,
    rev.tbd_remit_amount,

    rev.refund_amount,
    rev.localized_refund_amount,

    rev.original_full_cost_no_rebate_usd,
    rev.localized_original_full_cost_no_rebate,
    rev.localized_unity_wishpost_shipping,
    rev.unity_wishpost_shipping,
    rev.localized_initial_wishpost_shipping_amount,
    rev.initial_wishpost_shipping_amount,
    rev.localized_wishpost_shipping,
    rev.wishpost_shipping,
    rev.localized_wishpost_shipping_cost,
    rev.wishpost_shipping_cost,
    rev.localized_total_cost,
    rev.total_cost,
    rev.localized_full_cost_no_rebate_for_aplus,
    rev.full_cost_no_rebate_for_aplus_usd,
    rev.localized_full_cost_for_aplus,
    rev.full_cost_for_aplus,

    rev.original_rev_share,
    rev.updated_rev_share,

    rev.net_amount
        - rev.paid_merchant_usd
        - rev.merchant_eat_cost_amount_usd
        - rev.tax_cost
        - rev.merchant_tax_paid_usd
        - rev.merchant_tax_merch_eat_usd as commission_revenue
from {{ source('analytics', 'daily_rev_tahoe') }} as rev

{#
  Thin Semantic Layer wrapper over bi.order_level.
  Grain: one row per merchant order (m_transaction_id) within partition dt.
  Source: Airflow DAG bi_order_level (daily 06:00 America/Los_Angeles).

select
    concat(ol.m_transaction_id, '|', ol.dt) as order_level_id,

    ol.m_transaction_id,
    ol.transaction_id,
    ol.variation_id,
    ol.user_id,
    ol.merchant_id,
    ol.product_id,
    ol.tracking_id,

    ol.client,
    case ol.client
        when 'web' then 'Web'
        when 'iosapp' then 'iOS App'
        when 'androidapp' then 'Android App'
        when 'mobileweb' then 'Mobile Web'
        when 'Other' then 'Other'
        else ol.client
    end as client_name,

    ol.payment_method,

    ol.fulfilled,
    case ol.fulfilled
        when 1 then 'Confirmed shipped'
        when 0 then 'Not confirmed shipped'
        else cast(ol.fulfilled as varchar)
    end as fulfilled_name,

    ol.order_flat_rate_eligible,
    case ol.order_flat_rate_eligible
        when 1 then 'Eligible'
        when 0 then 'Not eligible'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as order_flat_rate_eligible_name,

    ol.order_flat_rate_qualified,
    case ol.order_flat_rate_qualified
        when 1 then 'Qualified'
        when 0 then 'Not qualified'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as order_flat_rate_qualified_name,

    ol.delivery_program,

    ol.wishpost_data_mature,
    case ol.wishpost_data_mature
        when 1 then 'Mature'
        when 0 then 'Immature'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as wishpost_data_mature_name,

    ol.refund_data_mature,
    case ol.refund_data_mature
        when 1 then 'Mature'
        when 0 then 'Immature'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as refund_data_mature_name,

    ol.is_pb,
    case ol.is_pb
        when 1 then 'Product Boost'
        when 0 then 'Not Product Boost'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as is_pb_name,

    ol.is_currently_bd_managed,
    case ol.is_currently_bd_managed
        when 1 then 'BD managed'
        when 0 then 'General support'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as is_currently_bd_managed_name,

    cast(ol.dt as date) as dt,
    cast(ol.transaction_dt as date) as transaction_dt,
    cast(ol.order_approved_dt as date) as order_approved_dt,
    cast(ol.refund_dt as date) as refund_dt,

    ol.buyer_lifecycle,
    ol.touch_event,
    ol.channel,
    ol.wss_tier,
    ol.shipping_country,
    ol.region,
    case upper(ol.region)
        when 'APAC' then 'Asia-Pacific'
        when 'LATAM' then 'Latin America'
        when 'MEA' then 'Middle East & Africa'
        when 'NWE' then 'Northern/Western Europe'
        when 'SEE' then 'Southern/Eastern Europe'
        when 'USCAN' then 'United States and Canada'
        else ol.region
    end as region_name,
    ol.country_name,
    ol.merchant_country,
    ol.merchant_country_group,
    ol.most_recent_bd_rep,

    ol.refund_reason_category,
    ol.md_refund_reason,
    ol.refund_type,

    ol.item_price,
    ol.gmv,
    ol.mkpl_revenue,
    ol.quantity,
    ol.discount_amount,
    ol.gross_gmv,
    ol.net_gmv,
    ol.total_shipping_paid_by_consumer,
    ol.refund_amount,
    ol.wishpost_sales_usd,
    ol.wishpost_costs_usd
from {{ source('bi', 'order_level') }} as ol

approved_cards.usage: Filter metric_time / dt first for partition pruning. Commerce GMV on dt uses payment-received day from fct_transaction_variations; finance gross_gmv / net_gmv align with order_approved_dt (LA). WishPost logistics in daily_finance_metrics groups by order_approved_dt, not dt. Use refund_data_mature = 1 for stable refund rates; wishpost_data_mature = 1 for stable logistics P&L. gmv ≠ gross_gmv — different definitions.
approved_cards.description: BI source-of-truth order fact at merchant-transaction grain (m_transaction_id). Each row is one merchant order enriched with fulfillment, flat-rate shipping flags, WishPost logistics P&L, refund reason labels, buyer lifecycle / marketing attribution, Wish Standards (WSS) tier, buyer geo, merchant BD mapping, finance GMV components, and Product Boost attribution. Deduplicated from variation-level commerce to one row per m_transaction_id within partition dt (payment-received day, America/Los_Angeles). Daily refresh overwrites last 100 calendar days. LTD products excluded upstream. gmv is variation commerce GMV; gross_gmv and net_gmv are finance-spine definitions from daily_rev_tahoe. Source: bi.order_level (Airflow DAG bi_order_level).
approved_cards.selection_notes: BI source-of-truth order fact at merchant-transaction grain with client/client_name (site/channel) and both gross and net GMV plus refund tracking — used to confirm wish filter values and 下单 vs 退款 caliber.

reasons.approve: 你应选择 approve：两模型无冲突，且覆盖下单/净额 GMV、取消退款、币种、日期分区及渠道字段，足以继续生成口径确认 SQL。
reasons.deny-comments: 你应选择 deny-comments：若仍缺 Wish 的确定映射、物理表全路径/分区表名或 USD 汇率字段，请让我们补选或修正模型。
reasons.deny-halt: 你应选择 deny-halt：仅当权限、治理或数据政策明确禁止本轮查询时，才应在不生成 SQL 的情况下停止。

approved_cards.name: daily_rev_tahoe
approved_cards.cte:
{{ config(
    materialized='view'
) }}

{#
  Thin Semantic Layer wrapper over analytics.daily_rev_tahoe.
  Grain: one row per approved commerce line (transaction_id, order_id, variation_id).
  Business revenue day: order_approved_time in America/Los_Angeles (order_approved_day).
  Partition dt is the Hive load batch key — filter for pruning, not business dating alone.
#}

select
    concat(rev.transaction_id, '|', rev.order_id, '|', rev.variation_id) as daily_rev_line_id,

    rev.transaction_id,
    rev.order_id,
    rev.variation_id,
    rev.user_id,
    rev.product_id,
    rev.merchant_id,
    rev.payment_id,
    rev.refund_transaction_id,

    cast(
        date_format(from_unixtime(rev.order_approved_time, 'America/Los_Angeles'), '%Y-%m-%d')
        as date
    ) as order_approved_day,
    cast(rev.dt as date) as dt,
    cast(rev.confirmed_date as date) as confirmed_ship_day,
    cast(
        date_format(from_unixtime(rev.transaction_time, 'America/Los_Angeles'), '%Y-%m-%d')
        as date
    ) as transaction_day,

    cast(from_unixtime(rev.transaction_time) as timestamp) as transaction_ts,
    cast(from_unixtime(rev.shipped_date) as timestamp) as shipped_ts,
    cast(from_unixtime(rev.merchant_payment_time) as timestamp) as merchant_payment_ts,
    cast(from_unixtime(rev.refunded_time) as timestamp) as refunded_ts,
    rev.transaction_time,
    rev.order_approved_time,
    rev.shipped_date,
    rev.merchant_payment_time,
    rev.refunded_time,

    rev.country_code,
    rev.country_state,
    rev.shipping_country,
    rev.shipping_state,
    rev.merchant_country,
    rev.currency,
    rev.merchant_source_currency,
    rev.conversion_rate,

    rev.payment_method,
    rev.transaction_state,
    case rev.transaction_state
        when 0 then 'Pending'
        when 1 then 'Approved'
        when 2 then 'Acknowledged'
        when 3 then 'Shipped'
        when 4 then 'Declined'
        when 5 then 'Refunded'
        when 6 then 'C2C On Delivery'
        when 7 then 'C2C Delivered'
        when 8 then 'C2C Accepted'
        when 10 then 'Exception'
        when 11 then 'Gift Waiting For Accept'
        when 12 then 'Require Review'
        when 13 then 'Delaying'
        when 14 then 'Label Generated'
        when 15 then 'Label Downloaded'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as transaction_state_name,
    rev.order_state,
    case rev.order_state
        when 0 then 'Pending'
        when 1 then 'Approved'
        when 2 then 'Acknowledged'
        when 3 then 'Shipped'
        when 4 then 'Declined'
        when 5 then 'Refunded'
        when 6 then 'C2C On Delivery'
        when 7 then 'C2C Delivered'
        when 8 then 'C2C Accepted'
        when 10 then 'Exception'
        when 11 then 'Gift Waiting For Accept'
        when 12 then 'Require Review'
        when 13 then 'Delaying'
        when 14 then 'Label Generated'
        when 15 then 'Label Downloaded'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as order_state_name,

    rev.is_cancelled,
    rev.is_wish_owned,
    rev.is_wish_express,
    rev.is_free_gift,
    rev.is_bnpl,
    rev.original_category,
    rev.updated_category,
    rev.cancelretry_ind,
    rev.fbs_purchase,
    rev.fbs_sale,
    rev.shopify_none,
    rev.is_eea,
    rev.is_fusion_resale,
    rev.is_unity_order,
    rev.is_unity_order_and_payment_enabled,

    rev.quantity,
    rev.price_before_promotions,
    rev.shipping_before_promotions,
    rev.price_before_promotions + rev.shipping_before_promotions as gmv,
    rev.flat_rate_shipping,
    rev.giftcard_amount,
    rev.discount_amount,
    rev.tax_amount,
    rev.tax_fee,
    rev.net_amount,
    rev.wishcash_usage,
    rev.retail_delivery_fee_amount,

    rev.merchant_price,
    rev.merchant_shipping,
    rev.localized_paid_merchant,
    rev.paid_merchant_usd,
    rev.merchant_shipping_cost,
    rev.localized_merchant_shipping_cost,
    rev.merchant_cost,
    rev.localized_merchant_cost,
    rev.localized_merchant_eat_cost_amount,
    rev.merchant_eat_cost_amount_usd,
    rev.tax_cost,
    rev.merchant_tax_paid_usd,
    rev.merchant_tax_merch_eat_usd,
    rev.merchant_tax_amount_usd,
    rev.localized_merchant_tax_amount,
    rev.localized_merchant_tax_paid,
    rev.localized_merchant_tax_merch_eat,
    rev.tbd_remit_amount,

    rev.refund_amount,
    rev.localized_refund_amount,

    rev.original_full_cost_no_rebate_usd,
    rev.localized_original_full_cost_no_rebate,
    rev.localized_unity_wishpost_shipping,
    rev.unity_wishpost_shipping,
    rev.localized_initial_wishpost_shipping_amount,
    rev.initial_wishpost_shipping_amount,
    rev.localized_wishpost_shipping,
    rev.wishpost_shipping,
    rev.localized_wishpost_shipping_cost,
    rev.wishpost_shipping_cost,
    rev.localized_total_cost,
    rev.total_cost,
    rev.localized_full_cost_no_rebate_for_aplus,
    rev.full_cost_no_rebate_for_aplus_usd,
    rev.localized_full_cost_for_aplus,
    rev.full_cost_for_aplus,

    rev.original_rev_share,
    rev.updated_rev_share,

    rev.net_amount
        - rev.paid_merchant_usd
        - rev.merchant_eat_cost_amount_usd
        - rev.tax_cost
        - rev.merchant_tax_paid_usd
        - rev.merchant_tax_merch_eat_usd as commission_revenue
from {{ source('analytics', 'daily_rev_tahoe') }} as rev

Grain is one row per (transaction_id, order_id, variation_id) sourced from wish.fact_trans_detail with USD-normalized financials and cart-level amounts prorated to merchant-order lines. {{ config(
    materialized='view'

{#
  Thin Semantic Layer wrapper over bi.order_level.
  Grain: one row per merchant order (m_transaction_id) within partition dt.
  Source: Airflow DAG bi_order_level (daily 06:00 America/Los_Angeles).
#}

select
    concat(ol.m_transaction_id, '|', ol.dt) as order_level_id,

    ol.m_transaction_id,
    ol.transaction_id,
    ol.variation_id,
    ol.user_id,
    ol.merchant_id,
    ol.product_id,
    ol.tracking_id,

    ol.client,
    case ol.client
        when 'web' then 'Web'
        when 'iosapp' then 'iOS App'
        when 'androidapp' then 'Android App'
        when 'mobileweb' then 'Mobile Web'
        when 'Other' then 'Other'
        else ol.client
    end as client_name,

    ol.payment_method,

    ol.fulfilled,
    case ol.fulfilled
        when 1 then 'Confirmed shipped'
        when 0 then 'Not confirmed shipped'
        else cast(ol.fulfilled as varchar)
    end as fulfilled_name,

    ol.order_flat_rate_eligible,
    case ol.order_flat_rate_eligible
        when 1 then 'Eligible'
        when 0 then 'Not eligible'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as order_flat_rate_eligible_name,

    ol.order_flat_rate_qualified,
    case ol.order_flat_rate_qualified
        when 1 then 'Qualified'
        when 0 then 'Not qualified'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as order_flat_rate_qualified_name,

    ol.delivery_program,

    ol.wishpost_data_mature,
    case ol.wishpost_data_mature
        when 1 then 'Mature'
        when 0 then 'Immature'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as wishpost_data_mature_name,

    ol.refund_data_mature,
    case ol.refund_data_mature
        when 1 then 'Mature'
        when 0 then 'Immature'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as refund_data_mature_name,

    ol.is_pb,
    case ol.is_pb
        when 1 then 'Product Boost'
        when 0 then 'Not Product Boost'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as is_pb_name,

    ol.is_currently_bd_managed,
    case ol.is_currently_bd_managed
        when 1 then 'BD managed'
        when 0 then 'General support'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as is_currently_bd_managed_name,

    cast(ol.dt as date) as dt,
    cast(ol.transaction_dt as date) as transaction_dt,
    cast(ol.order_approved_dt as date) as order_approved_dt,
    cast(ol.refund_dt as date) as refund_dt,

    ol.buyer_lifecycle,
    ol.touch_event,
    ol.channel,
    ol.wss_tier,
    ol.shipping_country,
    ol.region,
    case upper(ol.region)
        when 'APAC' then 'Asia-Pacific'
        when 'LATAM' then 'Latin America'
        when 'MEA' then 'Middle East & Africa'
        when 'NWE' then 'Northern/Western Europe'
        when 'SEE' then 'Southern/Eastern Europe'
        when 'USCAN' then 'United States and Canada'
        else ol.region
    end as region_name,
    ol.country_name,
    ol.merchant_country,
    ol.merchant_country_group,
    ol.most_recent_bd_rep,

    ol.refund_reason_category,
    ol.md_refund_reason,
    ol.refund_type,

    ol.item_price,
    ol.gmv,
    ol.mkpl_revenue,
    ol.quantity,
    ol.discount_amount,
    ol.gross_gmv,
    ol.net_gmv,
    ol.total_shipping_paid_by_consumer,
    ol.refund_amount,
    ol.wishpost_sales_usd,
    ol.wishpost_costs_usd
from {{ source('bi', 'order_level') }} as ol

approved_cards.usage: Filter metric_time / dt first for partition pruning. Commerce GMV on dt uses payment-received day from fct_transaction_variations; finance gross_gmv / net_gmv align with order_approved_dt (LA). WishPost logistics in daily_finance_metrics groups by order_approved_dt, not dt. Use refund_data_mature = 1 for stable refund rates; wishpost_data_mature = 1 for stable logistics P&L. gmv ≠ gross_gmv — different definitions.
approved_cards.description: BI source-of-truth order fact at merchant-transaction grain (m_transaction_id). Each row is one merchant order enriched with fulfillment, flat-rate shipping flags, WishPost logistics P&L, refund reason labels, buyer lifecycle / marketing attribution, Wish Standards (WSS) tier, buyer geo, merchant BD mapping, finance GMV components, and Product Boost attribution. Deduplicated from variation-level commerce to one row per m_transaction_id within partition dt (payment-received day, America/Los_Angeles). Daily refresh overwrites last 100 calendar days. LTD products excluded upstream. gmv is variation commerce GMV; gross_gmv and net_gmv are finance-spine definitions from daily_rev_tahoe. Source: bi.order_level (Airflow DAG bi_order_level).
approved_cards.selection_notes: BI source-of-truth order fact at merchant-transaction grain with client/client_name (site/channel) and both gross and net GMV plus refund tracking — used to confirm wish filter values and 下单 vs 退款 caliber.

SELECT
    MIN(dt)                                               AS min_partition_date,
    MAX(dt)                                               AS max_partition_date,
    COUNT(DISTINCT dt)                                    AS partitions_in_window,
    COUNT(*)                                              AS order_item_rows,
    COUNT(DISTINCT order_id)                              AS orders,
    COUNT(DISTINCT transaction_id)                        AS transactions,
    COUNT(DISTINCT variation_id)                          AS variation_rows,
    COUNT(DISTINCT currency)                              AS currency_count,
    ARRAY_JOIN(ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT currency), ',')         AS currency_values,
    ARRAY_JOIN(ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT is_cancelled), ',')      AS is_cancelled_values,
    ARRAY_JOIN(ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT merchant_source_currency), ',') AS merchant_source_currency_values,
    COUNT(DISTINCT order_state)                           AS distinct_order_states,
    COUNT(DISTINCT transaction_state)                     AS distinct_transaction_states,
    COUNT(DISTINCT shipping_country)                      AS distinct_shipping_countries,
    MIN(conversion_rate)                                  AS min_conversion_rate,
    MAX(conversion_rate)                                  AS max_conversion_rate,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE conversion_rate IS NULL)       AS rows_null_conversion_rate,
    SUM(price_before_promotions)                          AS price_amount_local,
    SUM(shipping_before_promotions)                       AS shipping_amount_local,
    SUM(price_before_promotions + shipping_before_promotions) AS gmv_local_currency,
    SUM((price_before_promotions + shipping_before_promotions) / NULLIF(conversion_rate, 0)) AS gmv_usd_div_conversion,
    SUM(net_amount)                                       AS net_amount_local,
    SUM(discount_amount)                                  AS discount_amount_local,
    SUM(refund_amount)                                    AS refund_amount_local,
    SUM(CASE WHEN is_cancelled = 'false' THEN price_before_promotions + shipping_before_promotions ELSE 0 END) AS gmv_local_excl_cancelled,
    SUM(CASE WHEN is_cancelled = 'false' AND order_state IS NOT NULL
             THEN (price_before_promotions + shipping_before_promotions) / NULLIF(conversion_rate, 0)
             ELSE 0 END)                                 AS gmv_usd_excl_cancelled
FROM hive.analytics.daily_rev_tahoe
WHERE dt >= '2025-07-01'
  AND dt <= '2025-07-03'

reasons.deny-comments: 你应选择 deny-comments：若仍缺 Wish 的确定映射、物理表全路径/分区表名或 USD 汇率字段，请让我们补选或修正模型。
reasons.deny-halt: 你应选择 deny-halt：仅当权限、治理或数据政策明确禁止本轮查询时，才应在不生成 SQL 的情况下停止。
reasons.dryrun: 你应选择 dryrun：若你只需预览模型生成的元数据查询与 SQL 骨架而不保存配置，本轮无需正式落库。

approved_cards.cte:
{{ config(
    materialized='view'
) }}

{#
  Thin Semantic Layer wrapper over analytics.daily_rev_tahoe.
  Grain: one row per approved commerce line (transaction_id, order_id, variation_id).
  Business revenue day: order_approved_time in America/Los_Angeles (order_approved_day).
  Partition dt is the Hive load batch key — filter for pruning, not business dating alone.
#}

select
    concat(rev.transaction_id, '|', rev.order_id, '|', rev.variation_id) as daily_rev_line_id,

    rev.transaction_id,
    rev.order_id,
    rev.variation_id,
    rev.user_id,
    rev.product_id,
    rev.merchant_id,
    rev.payment_id,
    rev.refund_transaction_id,

    cast(
        date_format(from_unixtime(rev.order_approved_time, 'America/Los_Angeles'), '%Y-%m-%d')
        as date
    ) as order_approved_day,
    cast(rev.dt as date) as dt,
    cast(rev.confirmed_date as date) as confirmed_ship_day,
    cast(
        date_format(from_unixtime(rev.transaction_time, 'America/Los_Angeles'), '%Y-%m-%d')
        as date
    ) as transaction_day,

    cast(from_unixtime(rev.transaction_time) as timestamp) as transaction_ts,
    cast(from_unixtime(rev.shipped_date) as timestamp) as shipped_ts,
    cast(from_unixtime(rev.merchant_payment_time) as timestamp) as merchant_payment_ts,
    cast(from_unixtime(rev.refunded_time) as timestamp) as refunded_ts,
    rev.transaction_time,
    rev.order_approved_time,
    rev.shipped_date,
    rev.merchant_payment_time,
    rev.refunded_time,

    rev.country_code,
    rev.country_state,
    rev.shipping_country,
    rev.shipping_state,
    rev.merchant_country,
    rev.currency,
    rev.merchant_source_currency,
    rev.conversion_rate,

    rev.payment_method,
    rev.transaction_state,
    case rev.transaction_state
        when 0 then 'Pending'
        when 1 then 'Approved'
        when 2 then 'Acknowledged'
        when 3 then 'Shipped'
        when 4 then 'Declined'
        when 5 then 'Refunded'
        when 6 then 'C2C On Delivery'
        when 7 then 'C2C Delivered'
        when 8 then 'C2C Accepted'
        when 10 then 'Exception'
        when 11 then 'Gift Waiting For Accept'
        when 12 then 'Require Review'
        when 13 then 'Delaying'
        when 14 then 'Label Generated'
        when 15 then 'Label Downloaded'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as transaction_state_name,
    rev.order_state,
    case rev.order_state
        when 0 then 'Pending'
        when 1 then 'Approved'
        when 2 then 'Acknowledged'
        when 3 then 'Shipped'
        when 4 then 'Declined'
        when 5 then 'Refunded'
        when 6 then 'C2C On Delivery'
        when 7 then 'C2C Delivered'
        when 8 then 'C2C Accepted'
        when 10 then 'Exception'
        when 11 then 'Gift Waiting For Accept'
        when 12 then 'Require Review'
        when 13 then 'Delaying'
        when 14 then 'Label Generated'
        when 15 then 'Label Downloaded'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as order_state_name,

    rev.is_cancelled,
    rev.is_wish_owned,
    rev.is_wish_express,
    rev.is_free_gift,
    rev.is_bnpl,
    rev.original_category,
    rev.updated_category,
    rev.cancelretry_ind,
    rev.fbs_purchase,
    rev.fbs_sale,
    rev.shopify_none,
    rev.is_eea,
    rev.is_fusion_resale,
    rev.is_unity_order,
    rev.is_unity_order_and_payment_enabled,

    rev.quantity,
    rev.price_before_promotions,
    rev.shipping_before_promotions,
    rev.price_before_promotions + rev.shipping_before_promotions as gmv,
    rev.flat_rate_shipping,
    rev.giftcard_amount,
    rev.discount_amount,
    rev.tax_amount,
    rev.tax_fee,
    rev.net_amount,
    rev.wishcash_usage,
    rev.retail_delivery_fee_amount,

    rev.merchant_price,
    rev.merchant_shipping,
    rev.localized_paid_merchant,
    rev.paid_merchant_usd,
    rev.merchant_shipping_cost,
    rev.localized_merchant_shipping_cost,
    rev.merchant_cost,
    rev.localized_merchant_cost,
    rev.localized_merchant_eat_cost_amount,
    rev.merchant_eat_cost_amount_usd,
    rev.tax_cost,
    rev.merchant_tax_paid_usd,
    rev.merchant_tax_merch_eat_usd,
    rev.merchant_tax_amount_usd,
    rev.localized_merchant_tax_amount,
    rev.localized_merchant_tax_paid,
    rev.localized_merchant_tax_merch_eat,
    rev.tbd_remit_amount,

    rev.refund_amount,
    rev.localized_refund_amount,

    rev.original_full_cost_no_rebate_usd,
    rev.localized_original_full_cost_no_rebate,
    rev.localized_unity_wishpost_shipping,
    rev.unity_wishpost_shipping,
    rev.localized_initial_wishpost_shipping_amount,
    rev.initial_wishpost_shipping_amount,
    rev.localized_wishpost_shipping,
    rev.wishpost_shipping,
    rev.localized_wishpost_shipping_cost,
    rev.wishpost_shipping_cost,
    rev.localized_total_cost,
    rev.total_cost,
    rev.localized_full_cost_no_rebate_for_aplus,
    rev.full_cost_no_rebate_for_aplus_usd,
    rev.localized_full_cost_for_aplus,
    rev.full_cost_for_aplus,

    rev.original_rev_share,
    rev.updated_rev_share,

    rev.net_amount
        - rev.paid_merchant_usd
        - rev.merchant_eat_cost_amount_usd
        - rev.tax_cost
        - rev.merchant_tax_paid_usd
        - rev.merchant_tax_merch_eat_usd as commission_revenue
from {{ source('analytics', 'daily_rev_tahoe') }} as rev

approved_cards.usage: Filter metric_time / dt first for partition pruning. Use order_approved_day for LA revenue recognition; transaction_day for checkout analysis. GMV = price_before_promotions + shipping_before_promotions; net GMV = net_amount. Commission = net − paid_merchant − MEC − tax components. Dedupe on grain keys before summing when append duplicates are suspected.
approved_cards.description: Order-item (variation) grain daily revenue fact for approved Wish marketplace commerce lines. Grain is one row per (transaction_id, order_id, variation_id) sourced from wish.fact_trans_detail with USD-normalized financials and cart-level amounts prorated to merchant-order lines. Excludes PENDING, DECLINED, and EXCEPTION item states at load time. Business revenue day is America/Los_Angeles date from order_approved_time (order_approved_day); Hive partition dt is the load batch end date — filter dt for pruning and order_approved_day for reporting. Duplicate rows can exist across append loads; dedupe before aggregates when sums must reconcile. Source: analytics.daily_rev_tahoe (Airflow DAG DailyRevTahoeNew).
approved_cards.selection_notes: Wish marketplace order-item daily fact, USD-normalized gmv with dt partition — primary GMV source, supports state/cancel filters.

reasons.deny-halt: 选择 deny-halt：若现有模型无法确认 Wish 或上月日期口径，应先停止生成 SQL。
reasons.dryrun: 选择 dryrun：若你只需预览所选模型生成的 SQL 而暂不保存画像，请选择此项。

    rev.quantity,
    rev.price_before_promotions,
    rev.shipping_before_promotions,
    rev.price_before_promotions + rev.shipping_before_promotions as gmv,
    rev.flat_rate_shipping,
    rev.giftcard_amount,
    rev.discount_amount,
    rev.tax_amount,
    rev.tax_fee,
    rev.net_amount,
    rev.wishcash_usage,
    rev.retail_delivery_fee_amount,

    rev.merchant_price,
    rev.merchant_shipping,
    rev.localized_paid_merchant,
    rev.paid_merchant_usd,
    rev.merchant_shipping_cost,
    rev.localized_merchant_shipping_cost,
    rev.merchant_cost,
    rev.localized_merchant_cost,
    rev.localized_merchant_eat_cost_amount,
    rev.merchant_eat_cost_amount_usd,
    rev.tax_cost,
    rev.merchant_tax_paid_usd,
    rev.merchant_tax_merch_eat_usd,
    rev.merchant_tax_amount_usd,
    rev.localized_merchant_tax_amount,
    rev.localized_merchant_tax_paid,
    rev.localized_merchant_tax_merch_eat,
    rev.tbd_remit_amount,

    rev.refund_amount,
    rev.localized_refund_amount,

    rev.original_full_cost_no_rebate_usd,
    rev.localized_original_full_cost_no_rebate,
    rev.localized_unity_wishpost_shipping,
    rev.unity_wishpost_shipping,
    rev.localized_initial_wishpost_shipping_amount,
    rev.initial_wishpost_shipping_amount,
    rev.localized_wishpost_shipping,
    rev.wishpost_shipping,
    rev.localized_wishpost_shipping_cost,
    rev.wishpost_shipping_cost,
    rev.localized_total_cost,
    rev.total_cost,
    rev.localized_full_cost_no_rebate_for_aplus,
    rev.full_cost_no_rebate_for_aplus_usd,
    rev.localized_full_cost_for_aplus,
    rev.full_cost_for_aplus,

    rev.original_rev_share,
    rev.updated_rev_share,

    rev.net_amount
        - rev.paid_merchant_usd
        - rev.merchant_eat_cost_amount_usd
        - rev.tax_cost
        - rev.merchant_tax_paid_usd
        - rev.merchant_tax_merch_eat_usd as commission_revenue

approved_cards.usage: Filter metric_time / dt first for partition pruning. Use order_approved_day for LA revenue recognition; transaction_day for checkout analysis. GMV = price_before_promotions + shipping_before_promotions; net GMV = net_amount. Commission = net − paid_merchant − MEC − tax components. Dedupe on grain keys before summing when append duplicates are suspected.
approved_cards.description: Order-item (variation) grain daily revenue fact for approved Wish marketplace commerce lines. Grain is one row per (transaction_id, order_id, variation_id) sourced from wish.fact_trans_detail with USD-normalized financials and cart-level amounts prorated to merchant-order lines. Excludes PENDING, DECLINED, and EXCEPTION item states at load time. Business revenue day is America/Los_Angeles date from order_approved_time (order_approved_day); Hive partition dt is the load batch end date — filter dt for pruning and order_approved_day for reporting. Duplicate rows can exist across append loads; dedupe before aggregates when sums must reconcile. Source: analytics.daily_rev_tahoe (Airflow DAG DailyRevTahoeNew).
approved_cards.selection_notes: Wish marketplace order-item daily fact, USD-normalized gmv with dt partition — primary GMV source, supports state/cancel filters.

approved_sql:
SELECT
    SUM(COALESCE("price_before_promotions", 0) + COALESCE("shipping_before_promotions", 0)) AS gmv_usd,
    SUM(COALESCE("net_amount", 0)) AS net_amount_usd,
    SUM(COALESCE("refund_amount", 0)) AS refund_usd
FROM hive.analytics.daily_rev_tahoe
WHERE "dt" >= date_format(date_add('month', -1, date_trunc('month', current_date)), '%Y-%m-%d')
  AND "dt" <  date_format(date_trunc('month', current_date), '%Y-%m-%d')

reasons.approve: 选择 approve：daily_rev_tahoe 已覆盖 Wish 的 GMV、退款和 dt 分区，足以继续生成上月 SQL。
reasons.deny-comments: 选择 deny-comments：若你还需要确认平台候选值、GMV 口径或币种字段，请让我补充这些信息。
reasons.deny-halt: 选择 deny-halt：若现有模型无法确认 Wish 或上月日期口径，应先停止生成 SQL。
reasons.dryrun: 选择 dryrun：若你只需预览所选模型生成的 SQL 而暂不保存画像，请选择此项。

reasons.approve: the query is read-only, scoped to the single approved daily GMV fact, and uses the partition column for last calendar month, so it answers your question cleanly.
reasons.deny-comments: if you want the GMV definition pinned down first — e.g. whether to drop cancelled/pending orders or switch to net of refunds — tell me now and I'll adjust the filters before it runs.
reasons.deny-halt: pausing is worth it only if you meant a different platform scope or currency; otherwise this is a straight aggregate over approved columns.
reasons.dryrun: choose this if you'd rather see the row volume and cost on a month of order-level data before committing to the full aggregation.

{{ config(
    materialized='view'
) }}

{#
  Thin Semantic Layer wrapper over core_data.fct_transaction_variations.
  Grain: one row per (transaction_id, variation_id) within partition dt.
#}

select
    concat(txn.transaction_id, '|', txn.variation_id) as transaction_variation_id,

    txn.transaction_id,
    txn.variation_id,
    txn.order_id,
    txn.user_id,
    txn.merchant_id,
    txn.product_id,
    txn.visitor_id,
    txn.seed_visitor_id,

    txn.payment_received_time,
    txn.transaction_time,
    cast(txn.dt as date) as dt,
    cast(from_unixtime(txn.transaction_timestamp) as timestamp) as transaction_ts,
    cast(from_unixtime(txn.time) as timestamp) as payment_received_ts,
    txn.transaction_timestamp,
    txn.time,
    datediff(txn.payment_received_time, txn.transaction_time) as payment_lag_days,

    txn.shipping_country,
    txn.client,
    case txn.client
        when 0 then 'Web'
        when 1 then 'iPhone'
        when 2 then 'iPad'
        when 3 then 'Android'
        when 4 then 'Mobile Web'
        when 5 then 'Windows Desktop'
        when 6 then 'Windows Phone'
        when 7 then 'Android Instant App'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as client_name,
    txn.payment_type,
    case txn.payment_type
        when -1 then 'None'

{#
  Thin Semantic Layer wrapper over core_data.fct_dau.
  Grain: one row per user_id × dt (daily active user engagement fact).
  Source: DailyCorePipelines / MRFDailyCore (sweeper_pt.requests).
#}

select
    concat(d.user_id, '|', d.dt) as user_day_id,

    d.user_id,
    d.time,
    cast(from_unixtime(d.time) as timestamp) as last_activity_ts,

    d.client,
    case d.client
        when 'web' then 'Desktop Web'
        when 'iosapp' then 'iOS App'
        when 'ipadapp' then 'iPad App'
        when 'androidapp' then 'Android App'
        when 'mobileweb' then 'Mobile Web'
        when 'windowsapp' then 'Windows App'
        when 'windowsphoneapp' then 'Windows Phone App'
        when 'androidinstantapp' then 'Android Instant App'
        when 'amazonapp' then 'Amazon App'
        when 'wishapp' then 'Wish App'
        else d.client
    end as client_name,

    d.country_code,
    d.locale,

    d.dau_date,
    cast(d.dau_date as date) as dau_activity_date,
    d.ds,
    cast(d.dt as date) as dt,

    d.num_impressions,
    d.num_clicks,
    d.num_wishlists,
    d.num_a2c_actions,
    d.num_cart_impressions,
    d.num_search_impressions,

    case when coalesce(d.num_clicks, 0) > 0 then 1 else 0 end as has_click,
    case when coalesce(d.num_impressions, 0) > 0 then 1 else 0 end as has_impression,
    case when coalesce(d.num_wishlists, 0) > 0 then 1 else 0 end as has_wishlist,
    case when coalesce(d.num_a2c_actions, 0) > 0 then 1 else 0 end as has_a2c,
    case when coalesce(d.num_cart_impressions, 0) > 0 then 1 else 0 end as has_cart_impression,
    case
        when coalesce(d.num_cart_impressions, 0) > 0
            and coalesce(d.num_a2c_actions, 0) > 0
        then 1
        else 0
    end as has_cart_visit_and_a2c

from {{ source('core_data', 'fct_dau') }} as d

Each row is one user on one day; count_distinct(user_id) over a date range counts user-days, not unique users across days. Join other user-day facts on user_id AND dt. Buyer / GMV / transaction metrics are not on this table — use dau_attribution or fct_transaction_variations.
approved_cards.description: Daily active user engagement fact at user × calendar-day grain. One row per registered user with activity on partition dt, aggregated from sweeper_pt.requests with bots, temporary users, and suspicious traffic filtered upstream. Captures last-seen client, country, locale, and same-day impression, click, wishlist, add-to-cart, cart-impression, and search-impression counts. Primary input for experiment DAU and funnel metrics. Source: core_data.fct_dau (DailyCorePipelines / MRFDailyCore).

{#
  Thin Semantic Layer wrapper over bi.order_level.
  Grain: one row per merchant order (m_transaction_id) within partition dt.
  Source: Airflow DAG bi_order_level (daily 06:00 America/Los_Angeles).
#}

select
    concat(ol.m_transaction_id, '|', ol.dt) as order_level_id,

    ol.m_transaction_id,
    ol.transaction_id,
    ol.variation_id,
    ol.user_id,
    ol.merchant_id,
    ol.product_id,
    ol.tracking_id,

    ol.client,
    case ol.client
        when 'web' then 'Web'
        when 'iosapp' then 'iOS App'
        when 'androidapp' then 'Android App'
        when 'mobileweb' then 'Mobile Web'
        when 'Other' then 'Other'
        else ol.client
    end as client_name,

    ol.payment_method,

    ol.fulfilled,
    case ol.fulfilled
        when 1 then 'Confirmed shipped'
        when 0 then 'Not confirmed shipped'
        else cast(ol.fulfilled as varchar)
    end as fulfilled_name,

    ol.order_flat_rate_eligible,
    case ol.order_flat_rate_eligible
        when 1 then 'Eligible'
        when 0 then 'Not eligible'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as order_flat_rate_eligible_name,

    ol.order_flat_rate_qualified,
    case ol.order_flat_rate_qualified
        when 1 then 'Qualified'
        when 0 then 'Not qualified'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as order_flat_rate_qualified_name,

    ol.delivery_program,

    ol.wishpost_data_mature,
    case ol.wishpost_data_mature
        when 1 then 'Mature'
        when 0 then 'Immature'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as wishpost_data_mature_name,

    ol.refund_data_mature,
    case ol.refund_data_mature
        when 1 then 'Mature'
        when 0 then 'Immature'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as refund_data_mature_name,

    ol.is_pb,
    case ol.is_pb
        when 1 then 'Product Boost'
        when 0 then 'Not Product Boost'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as is_pb_name,

    ol.is_currently_bd_managed,
    case ol.is_currently_bd_managed
        when 1 then 'BD managed'
        when 0 then 'General support'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as is_currently_bd_managed_name,

    cast(ol.dt as date) as dt,
    cast(ol.transaction_dt as date) as transaction_dt,
    cast(ol.order_approved_dt as date) as order_approved_dt,
    cast(ol.refund_dt as date) as refund_dt,

    ol.buyer_lifecycle,
    ol.touch_event,
    ol.channel,
    ol.wss_tier,
    ol.shipping_country,
    ol.region,
    case upper(ol.region)
        when 'APAC' then 'Asia-Pacific'
        when 'LATAM' then 'Latin America'
        when 'MEA' then 'Middle East & Africa'
        when 'NWE' then 'Northern/Western Europe'
        when 'SEE' then 'Southern/Eastern Europe'
        when 'USCAN' then 'United States and Canada'
        else ol.region
    end as region_name,
    ol.country_name,
    ol.merchant_country,
    ol.merchant_country_group,
    ol.most_recent_bd_rep,

    ol.refund_reason_category,
    ol.md_refund_reason,
    ol.refund_type,

    ol.item_price,
    ol.gmv,
    ol.mkpl_revenue,
    ol.quantity,
    ol.discount_amount,
    ol.gross_gmv,
    ol.net_gmv,
    ol.total_shipping_paid_by_consumer,
    ol.refund_amount,
    ol.wishpost_sales_usd,
    ol.wishpost_costs_usd

Commerce GMV on dt uses payment-received day from fct_transaction_variations; finance gross_gmv / net_gmv align with order_approved_dt (LA). WishPost logistics in daily_finance_metrics groups by order_approved_dt, not dt. approved_cards.description: BI source-of-truth order fact at merchant-transaction grain (m_transaction_id). Each row is one merchant order enriched with fulfillment, flat-rate shipping flags, WishPost logistics P&L, refund reason labels, buyer lifecycle / marketing attribution, Wish Standards (WSS) tier, buyer geo, merchant BD mapping, finance GMV components, and Product Boost attribution. Deduplicated from variation-level commerce to one row per m_transaction_id within partition dt (payment-received day, America/Los_Angeles). Daily refresh overwrites last 100 calendar days. LTD products excluded upstream. gmv is variation commerce GMV; gross_gmv and net_gmv are finance-spine definitions from daily_rev_tahoe. Source: bi.order_level (Airflow DAG bi_order_level).
approved_cards.selection_notes: BI order fact for GMV gross-vs-net and refund treatment (gross_gmv / net_gmv / refund_amount), order-approved-day and refund-day handling.

{#
  Thin Semantic Layer wrapper over core_data.fct_dau.
  Grain: one row per user_id × dt (daily active user engagement fact).
  Source: DailyCorePipelines / MRFDailyCore (sweeper_pt.requests).
#}

select
    concat(d.user_id, '|', d.dt) as user_day_id,

    d.user_id,
    d.time,
    cast(from_unixtime(d.time) as timestamp) as last_activity_ts,

    d.client,
    case d.client
        when 'web' then 'Desktop Web'
        when 'iosapp' then 'iOS App'
        when 'ipadapp' then 'iPad App'
        when 'androidapp' then 'Android App'
        when 'mobileweb' then 'Mobile Web'
        when 'windowsapp' then 'Windows App'
        when 'windowsphoneapp' then 'Windows Phone App'
        when 'androidinstantapp' then 'Android Instant App'
        when 'amazonapp' then 'Amazon App'
        when 'wishapp' then 'Wish App'
        else d.client
    end as client_name,

    d.country_code,
    d.locale,

    d.dau_date,
    cast(d.dau_date as date) as dau_activity_date,
    d.ds,
    cast(d.dt as date) as dt,

    d.num_impressions,
    d.num_clicks,
    d.num_wishlists,
    d.num_a2c_actions,
    d.num_cart_impressions,
    d.num_search_impressions,

    case when coalesce(d.num_clicks, 0) > 0 then 1 else 0 end as has_click,
    case when coalesce(d.num_impressions, 0) > 0 then 1 else 0 end as has_impression,
    case when coalesce(d.num_wishlists, 0) > 0 then 1 else 0 end as has_wishlist,
    case when coalesce(d.num_a2c_actions, 0) > 0 then 1 else 0 end as has_a2c,
    case when coalesce(d.num_cart_impressions, 0) > 0 then 1 else 0 end as has_cart_impression,
    case
        when coalesce(d.num_cart_impressions, 0) > 0
            and coalesce(d.num_a2c_actions, 0) > 0
        then 1
        else 0
    end as has_cart_visit_and_a2c

{#
  Thin Semantic Layer wrapper over bi.order_level.
  Grain: one row per merchant order (m_transaction_id) within partition dt.
  Source: Airflow DAG bi_order_level (daily 06:00 America/Los_Angeles).
#}

select
    concat(ol.m_transaction_id, '|', ol.dt) as order_level_id,

    ol.m_transaction_id,
    ol.transaction_id,
    ol.variation_id,
    ol.user_id,
    ol.merchant_id,
    ol.product_id,
    ol.tracking_id,

    ol.client,
    case ol.client
        when 'web' then 'Web'
        when 'iosapp' then 'iOS App'
        when 'androidapp' then 'Android App'
        when 'mobileweb' then 'Mobile Web'
        when 'Other' then 'Other'
        else ol.client
    end as client_name,

    ol.payment_method,

    ol.fulfilled,
    case ol.fulfilled
        when 1 then 'Confirmed shipped'
        when 0 then 'Not confirmed shipped'
        else cast(ol.fulfilled as varchar)
    end as fulfilled_name,

    ol.order_flat_rate_eligible,
    case ol.order_flat_rate_eligible
        when 1 then 'Eligible'
        when 0 then 'Not eligible'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as order_flat_rate_eligible_name,

    ol.order_flat_rate_qualified,
    case ol.order_flat_rate_qualified
        when 1 then 'Qualified'
        when 0 then 'Not qualified'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as order_flat_rate_qualified_name,

    ol.delivery_program,

    ol.wishpost_data_mature,
    case ol.wishpost_data_mature
        when 1 then 'Mature'
        when 0 then 'Immature'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as wishpost_data_mature_name,

    ol.refund_data_mature,
    case ol.refund_data_mature
        when 1 then 'Mature'
        when 0 then 'Immature'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as refund_data_mature_name,

    ol.is_pb,
    case ol.is_pb
        when 1 then 'Product Boost'
        when 0 then 'Not Product Boost'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as is_pb_name,

    ol.is_currently_bd_managed,
    case ol.is_currently_bd_managed
        when 1 then 'BD managed'
        when 0 then 'General support'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as is_currently_bd_managed_name,

    cast(ol.dt as date) as dt,
    cast(ol.transaction_dt as date) as transaction_dt,
    cast(ol.order_approved_dt as date) as order_approved_dt,
    cast(ol.refund_dt as date) as refund_dt,

    ol.buyer_lifecycle,
    ol.touch_event,
    ol.channel,
    ol.wss_tier,
    ol.shipping_country,
    ol.region,
    case upper(ol.region)
        when 'APAC' then 'Asia-Pacific'
        when 'LATAM' then 'Latin America'

approved_cards.usage: Filter metric_time / dt first for partition pruning. Commerce GMV on dt uses payment-received day from fct_transaction_variations; finance gross_gmv / net_gmv align with order_approved_dt (LA). WishPost logistics in daily_finance_metrics groups by order_approved_dt, not dt. Use refund_data_mature = 1 for stable refund rates; wishpost_data_mature = 1 for stable logistics P&L. gmv ≠ gross_gmv — different definitions.
approved_cards.description: BI source-of-truth order fact at merchant-transaction grain (m_transaction_id). Each row is one merchant order enriched with fulfillment, flat-rate shipping flags, WishPost logistics P&L, refund reason labels, buyer lifecycle / marketing attribution, Wish Standards (WSS) tier, buyer geo, merchant BD mapping, finance GMV components, and Product Boost attribution. Deduplicated from variation-level commerce to one row per m_transaction_id within partition dt (payment-received day, America/Los_Angeles). Daily refresh overwrites last 100 calendar days. LTD products excluded upstream. gmv is variation commerce GMV; gross_gmv and net_gmv are finance-spine definitions from daily_rev_tahoe. Source: bi.order_level (Airflow DAG bi_order_level).
approved_cards.selection_notes: BI order fact for GMV gross-vs-net and refund treatment (gross_gmv / net_gmv / refund_amount), order-approved-day and refund-day handling.

approved_sql:
WITH days AS (
    SELECT dt
    FROM hive.core_data.fct_transaction_variations
    GROUP BY dt
    ORDER BY dt DESC
    LIMIT 30
),
gmv_daily AS (
    SELECT
        t.dt AS dt,
        SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(t.is_ltd_product) = 'false' THEN t.gmv_variation ELSE 0 END) AS gmv_ex_ltd,
        SUM(t.gmv_variation) AS gmv_incl_ltd,
        SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(t.is_temporary_user) = 'true' THEN t.gmv_variation ELSE 0 END) AS gmv_from_temp_users,
        SUM(t.quantity) AS quantity,
        COUNT(DISTINCT t.transaction_id) AS transactions,
        COUNT(DISTINCT t.user_id) AS buyers
    FROM hive.core_data.fct_transaction_variations t
    JOIN days d ON t.dt = d.dt
    GROUP BY t.dt
),
dau_daily AS (
    SELECT
        d.dt AS dt,
        COUNT(DISTINCT d.user_id) AS dau,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.num_clicks > 0 THEN d.user_id END) AS click_dau,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.num_a2c_actions > 0 THEN d.user_id END) AS a2c_dau,
        SUM(d.num_impressions) AS impressions
    FROM hive.core_data.fct_dau d
    JOIN days y ON d.dt = y.dt
    GROUP BY d.dt
),
ord_daily AS (
    SELECT
        o.dt AS dt,
        SUM(o.gmv) AS gmv_field,
        SUM(o.gross_gmv) AS gross_gmv,
        SUM(o.net_gmv) AS net_gmv,
        SUM(o.refund_amount) AS refund_amount,
        SUM(o.discount_amount) AS discount_amount,
        SUM(o.total_shipping_paid_by_consumer) AS consumer_shipping_paid,
        SUM(o.mkpl_revenue) AS mkpl_revenue,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.m_transaction_id) AS orders
    FROM hive.bi.order_level o
    JOIN days y ON o.dt = y.dt
    GROUP BY o.dt
)
SELECT
    g.dt AS dt,
    g.gmv_ex_ltd,
    g.gmv_incl_ltd,
    g.gmv_from_temp_users,
    g.quantity,
    g.transactions,
    g.buyers,
    d.dau,
    d.click_dau,
    d.a2c_dau,
    d.impressions,
    o.gmv_field,
    o.gross_gmv,
    o.net_gmv,
    o.refund_amount,
    o.discount_amount,
    o.consumer_shipping_paid,
    o.mkpl_revenue,
    o.orders,
    g.gmv_ex_ltd / NULLIF(CAST(d.dau AS DOUBLE), 0) AS gmv_per_dau,
    (o.gross_gmv - o.net_gmv) AS gross_to_net_gap
FROM gmv_daily g
LEFT JOIN dau_daily d ON g.dt = d.dt
LEFT JOIN ord_daily o ON g.dt = o.dt
ORDER BY g.dt

reasons.deny-comments: 选择 deny-comments：若你仍需按 device_id/session 去重或确认运费与取消单规则，请要求补充相应模型或字段。

reasons.dryrun: 选择 dryrun：若你只想预览字段映射、粒度和过滤逻辑而暂不保存画像，先试运行即可满足需求。

reasons.approve: 这是唯一同时用术语库口径（exp.gmv 用 gmv_variation 且 is_ltd_product='false'、exp.dau 用 count_distinct user_id）和已批准订单表对账（gross_gmv/net_gmv/refund_amount）的查询，能直接回答 GMV 是否含运费与退款、DAU 去重口径这两个问题。

reasons.deny-halt: 该查询只做三张已批准表的只读聚合，不涉及写入或跨库改动，无需中止。
reasons.dryrun: 想先看最近 30 天的逐日 GMV/DAU 数值再决定是否对外引用，可以选择试运行以确认数据可用性与量级。

{#
  Thin Semantic Layer wrapper over core_data.fct_transaction_variations.
  Grain: one row per (transaction_id, variation_id) within partition dt.
#}

select
    concat(txn.transaction_id, '|', txn.variation_id) as transaction_variation_id,

    txn.transaction_id,
    txn.variation_id,
    txn.order_id,
    txn.user_id,
    txn.merchant_id,
    txn.product_id,
    txn.visitor_id,
    txn.seed_visitor_id,

    txn.payment_received_time,
    txn.transaction_time,
    cast(txn.dt as date) as dt,
    cast(from_unixtime(txn.transaction_timestamp) as timestamp) as transaction_ts,
    cast(from_unixtime(txn.time) as timestamp) as payment_received_ts,
    txn.transaction_timestamp,
    txn.time,
    datediff(txn.payment_received_time, txn.transaction_time) as payment_lag_days,

    txn.shipping_country,
    txn.client,
    case txn.client
        when 0 then 'Web'

        when 4 then 'Mobile Web'
        when 5 then 'Windows Desktop'
        when 6 then 'Windows Phone'

    end as client_name,
    txn.payment_type,
    case txn.payment_type

metrics.name: raw_revenue_999
metrics.label: Revenue (rows <= 40)

metrics.name: payment_lag_days

metrics.name: atv

metrics.name: aiv
metrics.label: Average item value

metrics.name: gmv_per_buyer
metrics.label: GMV per buyer

metrics.name: gmv_per_order

metrics.name: margin

approved_cards.usage: Filter metric_time / dt first for partition pruning. Use payment_received_time (same calendar date as dt) for revenue recognition; transaction_time for checkout / user-behavior analysis.
approved_cards.description: Variation-level transaction fact for Wish GMV, revenue, tax, and buyer analysis. Grain is one row per commerce transaction and product variation within payment-received partition dt (America/Los_Angeles). Financial metrics are proportionally allocated by (paid_price + paid_shipping) / (subtotal + total_shipping). Excludes Wish Cash and BNPL special variation IDs, pending/declined/exception states, and refunds that precede payment received. Source: core_data.fct_transaction_variations (Airflow DAG FctTransactionVariations).
approved_cards.selection_notes: Glossary source table for exp.gmv / exp.gmv_w_ltd (gmv_variation, is_ltd_product); dt is the payment-received partition, client/client_name is the platform (app) identifier to filter Wish.

approved_cards.name: daily_rev_tahoe
approved_cards.cte:
{{ config(
    materialized='view'
) }}

{#
  Thin Semantic Layer wrapper over analytics.daily_rev_tahoe.
  Grain: one row per approved commerce line (transaction_id, order_id, variation_id).
  Business revenue day: order_approved_time in America/Los_Angeles (order_approved_day).
  Partition dt is the Hive load batch key — filter for pruning, not business dating alone.
#}

select
    concat(rev.transaction_id, '|', rev.order_id, '|', rev.variation_id) as daily_rev_line_id,

    rev.transaction_id,
    rev.order_id,
    rev.variation_id,
    rev.user_id,
    rev.product_id,
    rev.merchant_id,
    rev.payment_id,
    rev.refund_transaction_id,

    cast(
        date_format(from_unixtime(rev.order_approved_time, 'America/Los_Angeles'), '%Y-%m-%d')
        as date
    ) as order_approved_day,
    cast(rev.dt as date) as dt,
    cast(rev.confirmed_date as date) as confirmed_ship_day,
    cast(
        date_format(from_unixtime(rev.transaction_time, 'America/Los_Angeles'), '%Y-%m-%d')
        as date
    ) as transaction_day,

    cast(from_unixtime(rev.transaction_time) as timestamp) as transaction_ts,
    cast(from_unixtime(rev.shipped_date) as timestamp) as shipped_ts,
    cast(from_unixtime(rev.merchant_payment_time) as timestamp) as merchant_payment_ts,
    cast(from_unixtime(rev.refunded_time) as timestamp) as refunded_ts,
    rev.transaction_time,
    rev.order_approved_time,
    rev.shipped_date,
    rev.merchant_payment_time,
    rev.refunded_time,

    rev.country_code,
    rev.country_state,
    rev.shipping_country,
    rev.shipping_state,
    rev.merchant_country,
    rev.currency,
    rev.merchant_source_currency,
    rev.conversion_rate,

    rev.payment_method,
    rev.transaction_state,
    case rev.transaction_state
        when 0 then 'Pending'
        when 1 then 'Approved'
        when 2 then 'Acknowledged'
        when 3 then 'Shipped'
        when 4 then 'Declined'
        when 5 then 'Refunded'
        when 6 then 'C2C On Delivery'
        when 7 then 'C2C Delivered'
        when 8 then 'C2C Accepted'
        when 10 then 'Exception'
        when 11 then 'Gift Waiting For Accept'
        when 12 then 'Require Review'
        when 13 then 'Delaying'
        when 14 then 'Label Generated'
        when 15 then 'Label Downloaded'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as transaction_state_name,
    rev.order_state,
    case rev.order_state
        when 0 then 'Pending'
        when 1 then 'Approved'
        when 2 then 'Acknowledged'
        when 3 then 'Shipped'
        when 4 then 'Declined'
        when 5 then 'Refunded'
        when 6 then 'C2C On Delivery'
        when 7 then 'C2C Delivered'
        when 8 then 'C2C Accepted'
        when 10 then 'Exception'
        when 11 then 'Gift Waiting For Accept'
        when 12 then 'Require Review'
        when 13 then 'Delaying'
        when 14 then 'Label Generated'
        when 15 then 'Label Downloaded'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as order_state_name,

    rev.is_cancelled,
    rev.is_wish_owned,
    rev.is_wish_express,
    rev.is_free_gift,
    rev.is_bnpl,
    rev.original_category,
    rev.updated_category,
    rev.cancelretry_ind,
    rev.fbs_purchase,
    rev.fbs_sale,
    rev.shopify_none,
    rev.is_eea,
    rev.is_fusion_resale,
    rev.is_unity_order,
    rev.is_unity_order_and_payment_enabled,

    rev.quantity,
    rev.price_before_promotions,
    rev.shipping_before_promotions,
    rev.price_before_promotions + rev.shipping_before_promotions as gmv,
    rev.flat_rate_shipping,
    rev.giftcard_amount,
    rev.discount_amount,
    rev.tax_amount,
    rev.tax_fee,
    rev.net_amount,
    rev.wishcash_usage,
    rev.retail_delivery_fee_amount,

    rev.merchant_price,
    rev.merchant_shipping,
    rev.localized_paid_merchant,
    rev.paid_merchant_usd,
    rev.merchant_shipping_cost,
    rev.localized_merchant_shipping_cost,
    rev.merchant_cost,
    rev.localized_merchant_cost,
    rev.localized_merchant_eat_cost_amount,
    rev.merchant_eat_cost_amount_usd,
    rev.tax_cost,
    rev.merchant_tax_paid_usd,
    rev.merchant_tax_merch_eat_usd,
    rev.merchant_tax_amount_usd,
    rev.localized_merchant_tax_amount,
    rev.localized_merchant_tax_paid,
    rev.localized_merchant_tax_merch_eat,
    rev.tbd_remit_amount,

    rev.refund_amount,
    rev.localized_refund_amount,

    rev.original_full_cost_no_rebate_usd,
    rev.localized_original_full_cost_no_rebate,
    rev.localized_unity_wishpost_shipping,
    rev.unity_wishpost_shipping,
    rev.localized_initial_wishpost_shipping_amount,
    rev.initial_wishpost_shipping_amount,
    rev.localized_wishpost_shipping,
    rev.wishpost_shipping,
    rev.localized_wishpost_shipping_cost,
    rev.wishpost_shipping_cost,
    rev.localized_total_cost,
    rev.total_cost,
    rev.localized_full_cost_no_rebate_for_aplus,
    rev.full_cost_no_rebate_for_aplus_usd,
    rev.localized_full_cost_for_aplus,
    rev.full_cost_for_aplus,

    rev.original_rev_share,
    rev.updated_rev_share,

    rev.net_amount
        - rev.paid_merchant_usd
        - rev.merchant_eat_cost_amount_usd
        - rev.tax_cost
        - rev.merchant_tax_paid_usd
        - rev.merchant_tax_merch_eat_usd as commission_revenue
from {{ source('analytics', 'daily_rev_tahoe') }} as rev

approved_cards.usage: Filter metric_time / dt first for partition pruning. Use order_approved_day for LA revenue recognition; transaction_day for checkout analysis. GMV = price_before_promotions + shipping_before_promotions; net GMV = net_amount. Commission = net − paid_merchant − MEC − tax components. Dedupe on grain keys before summing when append duplicates are suspected.
approved_cards.description: Order-item (variation) grain daily revenue fact for approved Wish marketplace commerce lines. Grain is one row per (transaction_id, order_id, variation_id) sourced from wish.fact_trans_detail with USD-normalized financials and cart-level amounts prorated to merchant-order lines. Excludes PENDING, DECLINED, and EXCEPTION item states at load time. Business revenue day is America/Los_Angeles date from order_approved_time (order_approved_day); Hive partition dt is the load batch end date — filter dt for pruning and order_approved_day for reporting. Duplicate rows can exist across append loads; dedupe before aggregates when sums must reconcile. Source: analytics.daily_rev_tahoe (Airflow DAG DailyRevTahoeNew).
approved_cards.selection_notes: Variation-grain daily revenue fact with gmv/net_gmv plus cancelled/order-state and refund columns; useful for cancel/refund handling checks.

approved_cards.name: order_level
approved_cards.cte:
{{ config(
    materialized='view'
) }}

{#
  Thin Semantic Layer wrapper over bi.order_level.
  Grain: one row per merchant order (m_transaction_id) within partition dt.
  Source: Airflow DAG bi_order_level (daily 06:00 America/Los_Angeles).
#}

select
    concat(ol.m_transaction_id, '|', ol.dt) as order_level_id,

    ol.m_transaction_id,
    ol.transaction_id,
    ol.variation_id,
    ol.user_id,
    ol.merchant_id,
    ol.product_id,
    ol.tracking_id,

    ol.client,
    case ol.client
        when 'web' then 'Web'
        when 'iosapp' then 'iOS App'
        when 'androidapp' then 'Android App'
        when 'mobileweb' then 'Mobile Web'
        when 'Other' then 'Other'
        else ol.client
    end as client_name,

    ol.payment_method,

    ol.fulfilled,
    case ol.fulfilled
        when 1 then 'Confirmed shipped'
        when 0 then 'Not confirmed shipped'
        else cast(ol.fulfilled as varchar)
    end as fulfilled_name,

    ol.order_flat_rate_eligible,
    case ol.order_flat_rate_eligible
        when 1 then 'Eligible'
        when 0 then 'Not eligible'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as order_flat_rate_eligible_name,

    ol.order_flat_rate_qualified,
    case ol.order_flat_rate_qualified
        when 1 then 'Qualified'
        when 0 then 'Not qualified'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as order_flat_rate_qualified_name,

    ol.delivery_program,

    ol.wishpost_data_mature,
    case ol.wishpost_data_mature
        when 1 then 'Mature'
        when 0 then 'Immature'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as wishpost_data_mature_name,

    ol.refund_data_mature,
    case ol.refund_data_mature
        when 1 then 'Mature'
        when 0 then 'Immature'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as refund_data_mature_name,

    ol.is_pb,
    case ol.is_pb
        when 1 then 'Product Boost'
        when 0 then 'Not Product Boost'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as is_pb_name,

    ol.is_currently_bd_managed,
    case ol.is_currently_bd_managed
        when 1 then 'BD managed'
        when 0 then 'General support'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as is_currently_bd_managed_name,

    cast(ol.dt as date) as dt,
    cast(ol.transaction_dt as date) as transaction_dt,
    cast(ol.order_approved_dt as date) as order_approved_dt,
    cast(ol.refund_dt as date) as refund_dt,

    ol.buyer_lifecycle,
    ol.touch_event,
    ol.channel,
    ol.wss_tier,
    ol.shipping_country,
    ol.region,
    case upper(ol.region)
        when 'APAC' then 'Asia-Pacific'
        when 'LATAM' then 'Latin America'
        when 'MEA' then 'Middle East & Africa'
        when 'NWE' then 'Northern/Western Europe'
        when 'SEE' then 'Southern/Eastern Europe'
        when 'USCAN' then 'United States and Canada'
        else ol.region
    end as region_name,
    ol.country_name,
    ol.merchant_country,
    ol.merchant_country_group,
    ol.most_recent_bd_rep,

    ol.refund_reason_category,
    ol.md_refund_reason,
    ol.refund_type,

    ol.item_price,
    ol.gmv,
    ol.mkpl_revenue,
    ol.quantity,
    ol.discount_amount,
    ol.gross_gmv,
    ol.net_gmv,
    ol.total_shipping_paid_by_consumer,
    ol.refund_amount,
    ol.wishpost_sales_usd,
    ol.wishpost_costs_usd
from {{ source('bi', 'order_level') }} as ol
