approved_cards.usage: Filter metric_time / dt first for partition pruning. Commerce GMV on dt uses payment-received day from fct_transaction_variations; finance gross_gmv / net_gmv align with order_approved_dt (LA). WishPost logistics in daily_finance_metrics groups by order_approved_dt, not dt. Use refund_data_mature = 1 for stable refund rates; wishpost_data_mature = 1 for stable logistics P&L. gmv ≠ gross_gmv — different definitions.
approved_cards.description: BI source-of-truth order fact at merchant-transaction grain (m_transaction_id). Each row is one merchant order enriched with fulfillment, flat-rate shipping flags, WishPost logistics P&L, refund reason labels, buyer lifecycle / marketing attribution, Wish Standards (WSS) tier, buyer geo, merchant BD mapping, finance GMV components, and Product Boost attribution. Deduplicated from variation-level commerce to one row per m_transaction_id within partition dt (payment-received day, America/Los_Angeles). Daily refresh overwrites last 100 calendar days. LTD products excluded upstream. gmv is variation commerce GMV; gross_gmv and net_gmv are finance-spine definitions from daily_rev_tahoe. Source: bi.order_level (Airflow DAG bi_order_level).
approved_cards.selection_notes: BI order-level fact carrying gross_gmv / net_gmv / refund_amount to test whether GMV includes refunds, with dt partition and client platform field.

approved_cards.cte:
{{ config(
    materialized='view'
) }}

{#
  Thin Semantic Layer wrapper over core_data.fct_refund.
  Grain: one aggregated refund event row per the pipeline GROUP BY keys within
  partition dt (user, transaction, variation, amount, reason, type, times, etc.).
  Source: DailyCorePipelines / MRFDailyCore / fct_refund.yaml.
#}

select
    concat(
        r.dt, '|',
        r.transaction_id, '|',
        r.variation_id, '|',
        cast(r.time as string), '|',
        cast(r.refunded_amount as string), '|',
        cast(r.refund_reason_category as string), '|',
        r.refunded_amount_type
    ) as refund_event_id,

    r.user_id,
    r.transaction_id,
    r.product_id,
    r.variation_id,
    r.merchant_id,

    r.refunded_amount,
    r.refund_reason_category,
    case r.refund_reason_category
        when -1 then 'OTHER'
        when 0 then 'INSUFFICIENT_INVENTORY'
        when 1 then 'UNABLE_TO_SHIP'
        when 2 then 'CUSTOMER_REQUEST'
        when 3 then 'ITEM_DAMAGED'
        when 4 then 'SUSPECTED_FRAUD'
        when 5 then 'EXPIRED_GIFT'
        when 6 then 'DECLINED_GIFT'
        when 7 then 'WRONG_ITEM'
        when 8 then 'DOES_NOT_FIT'
        when 9 then 'LATE_OR_MISSING'
        when 10 then 'FAKE_OR_COUNTERFEIT'
        when 11 then 'INVALID_ADDRESS'
        when 12 then 'POOR_QUALITY'
        when 13 then 'DOES_NOT_FIT_USERS_FAULT'
        when 14 then 'DOES_NOT_FIT_INCORRECT_SIZE'
        when 15 then 'DOES_NOT_FIT_WRONG_SIZE'
        when 16 then 'DOES_FIT_WRONG_SIZE'
        when 17 then 'FRAUDULENT_ACTIVITY'
        when 18 then 'USER_PLACED_ORDER_BY_MISTAKE'
        when 19 then 'USER_NO_LONGER_WANTS_ITEM'
        when 20 then 'SHIPPING_TAKING_TOO_LONG'
        when 21 then 'ITEM_NEVER_ARRIVED'
        when 22 then 'ITEM_DOES_NOT_FIT'
        when 23 then 'RECEIVED_WRONG_ITEM'
        when 24 then 'ITEM_IS_COUNTERFEIT'
        when 25 then 'ITEM_IS_DAMAGED'
        when 26 then 'ITEM_DOES_NOT_WORK_AS_DESCRIBED'
        when 27 then 'ITEM_DOES_NOT_MATCH_LISTING'
        when 28 then 'USER_CANCELLED_ORDER'
        when 29 then 'MERCHANT_FAILED_TO_FULFILL'
        when 30 then 'MERCHANT_SENT_TO_WRONG_ADDRESS'
        when 31 then 'USER_ENTERED_WRONG_ADDRESS'
        when 32 then 'ITEM_RETURNED_TO_SENDER'
        when 33 then 'INCOMPLETE_ORDER'
        when 34 then 'MERCHANT_OUT_OF_STOCK'
        when 35 then 'ITEM_MARKED_DELIVERED_BUT_DID_NOT_ARRIVE'
        when 36 then 'NOT_QUALIFIED_SHIPPING_PROVIDER'
        when 37 then 'EXPIRED_GROUP_BUY'
        when 38 then 'REPLACEMENT_NEVER_RECEIVED'
        when 39 then 'FBW_WAREHOUSE_FAILED_TO_FULFILL'
        when 40 then 'CONSUMER_FRAUD'
        when 41 then 'WISHBLUE_EPC_LATE_FULFILLMENT'
        when 42 then 'MISLEADING_LISTING'
        when 43 then 'ITEM_IS_DANGEROUS'
        when 44 then 'PICKUP_NOW_ITEM_NOT_PICKED_UP'
        when 45 then 'ONEOFF_WISH_ERROR'
        when 46 then 'CONFIRMED_FUSION_ITEM_NOT_PICKED_UP'
        when 47 then 'FBS_STORE_QUIT'
        when 48 then 'FBW_FAILED_TO_FULFILL_DUE_TO_CARRIER_RETURN'
        when 49 then 'STORE_UPLOADED_INVENTORY_RETURN'
        when 50 then 'PREORDER_NOT_FULFILLED'
        when 51 then 'ORDER_ROUTING'
        when 52 then 'SHOPIFY_MERCHANT_CANCELLED'
        when 53 then 'USER_CANCEL_CHANGE_PAYMENT'
        when 54 then 'MERCHANT_REPORTED_BUYER_FRAUD'
        when 55 then 'PRESALE_TIMELINE_CLOSED'
        when 56 then 'IN_GRACE_PERIOD_DELAY_CANCEL'
        when 57 then 'LIMBO_ORDER_UNFULFILLED'
        when 58 then 'CIRCULAR_ROUTED_UNFULFILLED'

        when 61 then 'CONTENT_POLICY_VIOLATION_CANCELLATION'

        when 101 then 'EPC_OVERWEIGHT'
        when 102 then 'EPC_OVERSIZE'
        when 103 then 'EPC_LAST_MILE_CARRIERS_UNABLE_TO_SHIP'
        when 104 then 'EPC_OVERVALUE'
        when 111 then 'CB_USER_CANCELLED_ORDER'
        when 200 then 'BLUE_ADMIN_REFUND'
        when 201 then 'BLUE_FUSION_SENT_TO_WRONG_STORE'

        when 203 then 'BLUE_STORE_OUT_OF_STOCK'
        when 204 then 'BLUE_DELIVERY_NOT_DELIVERED'
        when 205 then 'BLUE_STORE_QUIT'
        when 206 then 'BLUE_FUSION_IN_TRANSIT_LOST'
        when 207 then 'BLUE_FUSION_STORE_NOT_SCAN_IN'
        when 208 then 'BLUE_PROGRAM_DEPRECATION'
        when 1001 then 'WRONG_COLOR'
        when 1002 then 'ITEM_IS_POOR_QUALITY'
        when 1004 then 'PRODUCT_LISTING_MISSING_INFO'
        when 1005 then 'ITEM_DID_NOT_MEET_EXPECTATIONS'
        when 1006 then 'EMPTY_PACKAGE'
        when 1007 then 'INCORRECT_QUANTITY_OF_ITEMS'
        when 1008 then 'MISSING_ITEM_OR_PARTS'
        when 1009 then 'STORE_SENT_THE_WRONG_SIZE'
        when 1010 then 'ITEM_HELD_AT_CUSTOMS'
        when 1011 then 'ORDER_PLACED_BY_TECHNICAL_ERROR'
        when 1012 then 'PRODUCT_MALFUNCTION'
        when 1013 then 'CS_REFUND_FOR_USER_CANCEL'
        when 1014 then 'USER_ENTERED_INVALID_ADDRESS'
        when 1015 then 'RECEIVED_NOTE_FROM_MERCHANT'
        when 1100 then 'COMMERCEHUB_OTHER'
        when 1101 then 'COMMERCEHUB_OUT_OF_STOCK'
        when 1102 then 'COMMERCEHUB_CANCELLED_AT_MERCHANTS_REQUEST'
        when 1103 then 'COMMERCEHUB_BAD_ADDRESS'
        when 1104 then 'COMMERCEHUB_BAD_SKU'
        when 1105 then 'COMMERCEHUB_SUPPLIER_DETECTED_FRAUD'
        when 1110 then 'MISSING_ITEM_OR_PACKAGE'
        else concat('CODE_', cast(r.refund_reason_category as string))
    end as refund_reason_category_name,

    r.refunded_amount_type,

    r.eat_cost_ratio,
    case r.eat_cost_ratio
        when 0 then 'Wish eats cost'
        when 1 then 'Merchant eats cost'
        else 'Other'
    end as eat_cost_ratio_name,

    r.is_ltd_product,

    r.transaction_time,
    r.refunded_time,
    r.time,
    cast(from_unixtime(r.transaction_time) as timestamp) as transaction_ts,
    cast(from_unixtime(r.refunded_time) as timestamp) as refunded_ts,
    cast(from_unixtime(r.time) as timestamp) as event_ts,

    r.ds,
    cast(r.dt as date) as dt,
    (r.refunded_time - r.transaction_time) / 86400.0 as refund_lag_days

from {{ source('core_data', 'fct_refund') }} as r

approved_cards.name: daily_trans_attribution
approved_cards.cte:
{{ config(
    materialized='view'
) }}

{#
  Thin Semantic Layer wrapper over mde.daily_trans_attribution.
  Grain: one row per buyer_lifecycle × country_code × client × touch_event ×
  channel × campaign_id × dt (multi-touch normalized purchase attribution).
  Source: DailyAttribution_V7 TransAttributionInsertDataTask (partition lag ds-2).
#}

select
    concat(
        ta.buyer_lifecycle, '|',
        ta.country_code, '|',
        ta.client, '|',
        ta.touch_event, '|',
        ta.channel, '|',
        ta.campaign_id, '|',
        ta.dt
    ) as trans_attribution_id,

    ta.buyer_lifecycle,
    case ta.buyer_lifecycle
        when 'New' then 'New Buyer'
        when 'Retained' then 'Retained Buyer'
        when 'Resurrected' then 'Resurrected Buyer'
        when 'Unknown_lifecycle' then 'Unknown Lifecycle'
        else ta.buyer_lifecycle
    end as buyer_lifecycle_name,

    ta.country_code,

    ta.client,
    case ta.client
        when 'web' then 'Desktop Web'
        when 'iosapp' then 'iOS App'
        when 'ipadapp' then 'iPad App'
        when 'androidapp' then 'Android App'
        when 'mobileweb' then 'Mobile Web'
        when 'windowsapp' then 'Windows App'
        when 'windowsphoneapp' then 'Windows Phone App'
        when 'androidinstantapp' then 'Android Instant App'
        else ta.client
    end as client_name,

    ta.touch_event,
    case ta.touch_event
        when 'performance ads' then 'Performance Ads'
        when 'brand ads' then 'Brand Ads'
        when 'Push_Noti' then 'Push Notification'
        when 'Social_Event' then 'Social Event'
        else ta.touch_event
    end as touch_event_name,

    ta.channel,
    ta.campaign_id,

    ta.num_marketing_clickers,
    ta.num_marking_clicks,
    ta.num_buyers,
    ta.num_order,
    ta.num_txn,
    ta.gmv,
    ta.revenue,

    ta.dt as dt_str,
    cast(ta.dt as date) as dt

from {{ source('mde', 'daily_trans_attribution') }} as ta

approved_cards.usage: Always filter metric_time / dt first for partition pruning. Metrics are multi-touch fractional doubles — summing num_buyers / gmv / revenue across channels for a lifecycle×country×client×dt should approximate true totals. Use num_marking_clicks (schema typo, not num_marketing_clicks) for click volume. Organic rows inflate click metrics with fallback value 1. Expect dt <= current_date - 2 for settled partitions (attribution_day_pad = 2). Do not confuse with ads.daily_trans_attribution.
approved_cards.description: Daily multi-touch normalized transaction (purchase) attribution aggregate from MDE DailyAttribution_V7 Step 10. Attributes non-LTD commerce metrics — buyers, orders, transactions, GMV, and revenue — to marketing touch_event × channel × campaign_id at buyer_lifecycle × country × client × day grain using fractional multi-touch normalization so channel-level metrics sum back to true transaction totals. Grain is one row per buyer_lifecycle, country_code, client, touch_event, channel, campaign_id, and dt. Partition dt is the purchase reporting calendar day (America/Los Angeles fact partition); metrics are for non-LTD purchases on that day. Source: mde.daily_trans_attribution (DailyAttribution_V7).
approved_cards.selection_notes: Alternative GMV source that carries explicit channel dimension; useful if the platform/channel split must come from marketing channel values.

reasons.deny-halt: 若你确认本轮无需执行或保存查询、仅需人工说明口径，则应停止而不生成 SQL。
reasons.dryrun: 若你只想先预览 SQL 并核对平台过滤和分区字段，使用 dryrun 即可，无需保存画像。

{#
  Thin Semantic Layer wrapper over core_data.fct_transaction_variations.
  Grain: one row per (transaction_id, variation_id) within partition dt.
#}

select
    concat(txn.transaction_id, '|', txn.variation_id) as transaction_variation_id,

    txn.transaction_id,
    txn.variation_id,
    txn.order_id,
    txn.user_id,
    txn.merchant_id,
    txn.product_id,
    txn.visitor_id,
    txn.seed_visitor_id,

    txn.payment_received_time,
    txn.transaction_time,
    cast(txn.dt as date) as dt,
    cast(from_unixtime(txn.transaction_timestamp) as timestamp) as transaction_ts,
    cast(from_unixtime(txn.time) as timestamp) as payment_received_ts,
    txn.transaction_timestamp,
    txn.time,
    datediff(txn.payment_received_time, txn.transaction_time) as payment_lag_days,

    txn.shipping_country,
    txn.client,
    case txn.client
        when 0 then 'Web'
        when 1 then 'iPhone'
        when 2 then 'iPad'
        when 3 then 'Android'
        when 4 then 'Mobile Web'
        when 5 then 'Windows Desktop'
        when 6 then 'Windows Phone'
        when 7 then 'Android Instant App'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as client_name,
    txn.payment_type,
    case txn.payment_type
        when -1 then 'None'
        when 0 then 'PayPal'
        when 1 then 'Braintree'
        when 2 then 'Braintree Facebook Autofill'
        when 3 then 'Stripe'
        when 4 then 'Braintree Google Wallet'
        when 5 then 'Stripe Google Wallet'
        when 6 then 'Boleto'
        when 7 then 'Stripe Apple Pay'
        when 8 then 'Klarna'
        when 9 then 'Adyen'
        when 10 then 'Ebanx'
        when 11 then 'OXXO'
        when 12 then 'Unknown'
        when 13 then 'Twitter Buy Now'
        when 14 then 'Boku'
        when 15 then 'Affirm'
        when 16 then 'Braintree PayPal'
        when 17 then 'Stripe iDEAL'
        when 18 then 'PayNearMe'
        when 19 then 'Braintree Venmo'
        when 20 then 'Stripe Samsung Pay'
        when 21 then 'Buy Now Pay Later'
        when 22 then 'Paytm'
        when 23 then 'Xendit Invoice'
        when 24 then 'Facebook Checkout'
        when 25 then 'Adyen Banking'
        when 26 then 'Offline Cash'
        when 27 then 'Braintree ACH'
        when 28 then 'Shopify Checkout'
        when 29 then 'Pix'
        when 30 then 'Afterpay'
        when 31 then 'Klarna Paylater'
        when 32 then 'Cash App Pay'
        else 'Other'
    end as payment_type_name,
    txn.installments,
    coalesce(txn.installments, 1) > 1 as is_installment,
    txn.is_ltd_product,
    txn.is_temporary_user,

    txn.quantity,
    txn.total,
    txn.gmv_variation,
    txn.raw_revenue_variation,
    txn.raw_total_tax,
    txn.wish_cash_variation

approved_cards.usage: Filter metric_time / dt first for partition pruning. Use payment_received_time (same calendar date as dt) for revenue recognition; transaction_time for checkout / user-behavior analysis.
approved_cards.description: Variation-level transaction fact for Wish GMV, revenue, tax, and buyer analysis. Grain is one row per commerce transaction and product variation within payment-received partition dt (America/Los_Angeles). Financial metrics are proportionally allocated by (paid_price + paid_shipping) / (subtotal + total_shipping). Excludes Wish Cash and BNPL special variation IDs, pending/declined/exception states, and refunds that precede payment received. Source: core_data.fct_transaction_variations (Airflow DAG FctTransactionVariations).
approved_cards.selection_notes: Glossary-linked GMV source (exp.gmv -> core_data.fct_transaction_variations, calc IF(is_ltd_product='false', gmv_variation,0)); partition dt in America/Los_Angeles; client/client_name for platform value 'wish'.

{#
  Thin Semantic Layer wrapper over bi.order_level.
  Grain: one row per merchant order (m_transaction_id) within partition dt.
  Source: Airflow DAG bi_order_level (daily 06:00 America/Los_Angeles).
#}

select
    concat(ol.m_transaction_id, '|', ol.dt) as order_level_id,

    ol.m_transaction_id,
    ol.transaction_id,
    ol.variation_id,
    ol.user_id,
    ol.merchant_id,
    ol.product_id,
    ol.tracking_id,

    ol.client,
    case ol.client
        when 'web' then 'Web'
        when 'iosapp' then 'iOS App'
        when 'androidapp' then 'Android App'
        when 'mobileweb' then 'Mobile Web'
        when 'Other' then 'Other'
        else ol.client
    end as client_name,

    ol.payment_method,

    ol.fulfilled,
    case ol.fulfilled
        when 1 then 'Confirmed shipped'
        when 0 then 'Not confirmed shipped'
        else cast(ol.fulfilled as varchar)
    end as fulfilled_name,

    ol.order_flat_rate_eligible,
    case ol.order_flat_rate_eligible
        when 1 then 'Eligible'
        when 0 then 'Not eligible'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as order_flat_rate_eligible_name,

    ol.order_flat_rate_qualified,
    case ol.order_flat_rate_qualified
        when 1 then 'Qualified'
        when 0 then 'Not qualified'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as order_flat_rate_qualified_name,

    ol.delivery_program,

    ol.wishpost_data_mature,
    case ol.wishpost_data_mature
        when 1 then 'Mature'
        when 0 then 'Immature'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as wishpost_data_mature_name,

    ol.refund_data_mature,
    case ol.refund_data_mature
        when 1 then 'Mature'
        when 0 then 'Immature'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as refund_data_mature_name,

    ol.is_pb,
    case ol.is_pb
        when 1 then 'Product Boost'
        when 0 then 'Not Product Boost'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as is_pb_name,

    ol.is_currently_bd_managed,
    case ol.is_currently_bd_managed
        when 1 then 'BD managed'
        when 0 then 'General support'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as is_currently_bd_managed_name,

    cast(ol.dt as date) as dt,
    cast(ol.transaction_dt as date) as transaction_dt,
    cast(ol.order_approved_dt as date) as order_approved_dt,
    cast(ol.refund_dt as date) as refund_dt,

    ol.buyer_lifecycle,
    ol.touch_event,
    ol.channel,
    ol.wss_tier,
    ol.shipping_country,
    ol.region,
    case upper(ol.region)
        when 'APAC' then 'Asia-Pacific'
        when 'LATAM' then 'Latin America'
        when 'MEA' then 'Middle East & Africa'
        when 'NWE' then 'Northern/Western Europe'
        when 'SEE' then 'Southern/Eastern Europe'
        when 'USCAN' then 'United States and Canada'
        else ol.region
    end as region_name,
    ol.country_name,
    ol.merchant_country,
    ol.merchant_country_group,
    ol.most_recent_bd_rep,

    ol.refund_reason_category,
    ol.md_refund_reason,
    ol.refund_type,

    ol.item_price,
    ol.gmv,
    ol.mkpl_revenue,
    ol.quantity,
    ol.discount_amount,
    ol.gross_gmv,
    ol.net_gmv,
    ol.total_shipping_paid_by_consumer,
    ol.refund_amount,
    ol.wishpost_sales_usd,
    ol.wishpost_costs_usd
from {{ source('bi', 'order_level') }} as ol

approved_cards.usage: Filter metric_time / dt first for partition pruning. Commerce GMV on dt uses payment-received day from fct_transaction_variations; finance gross_gmv / net_gmv align with order_approved_dt (LA). WishPost logistics in daily_finance_metrics groups by order_approved_dt, not dt. Use refund_data_mature = 1 for stable refund rates; wishpost_data_mature = 1 for stable logistics P&L. gmv ≠ gross_gmv — different definitions.
approved_cards.description: BI source-of-truth order fact at merchant-transaction grain (m_transaction_id). Each row is one merchant order enriched with fulfillment, flat-rate shipping flags, WishPost logistics P&L, refund reason labels, buyer lifecycle / marketing attribution, Wish Standards (WSS) tier, buyer geo, merchant BD mapping, finance GMV components, and Product Boost attribution. Deduplicated from variation-level commerce to one row per m_transaction_id within partition dt (payment-received day, America/Los_Angeles). Daily refresh overwrites last 100 calendar days. LTD products excluded upstream. gmv is variation commerce GMV; gross_gmv and net_gmv are finance-spine definitions from daily_rev_tahoe. Source: bi.order_level (Airflow DAG bi_order_level).
approved_cards.selection_notes: BI source-of-truth order fact with gross vs net GMV and refund/shipping flags; candidate to confirm client dimension values and GMV definition incl. refunds/shipping.

approved_cards.name: daily_trans_attribution
approved_cards.cte:
{{ config(
    materialized='view'
) }}

{#
  Thin Semantic Layer wrapper over mde.daily_trans_attribution.
  Grain: one row per buyer_lifecycle × country_code × client × touch_event ×
  channel × campaign_id × dt (multi-touch normalized purchase attribution).
  Source: DailyAttribution_V7 TransAttributionInsertDataTask (partition lag ds-2).
#}

select
    concat(
        ta.buyer_lifecycle, '|',
        ta.country_code, '|',
        ta.client, '|',
        ta.touch_event, '|',
        ta.channel, '|',
        ta.campaign_id, '|',
        ta.dt
    ) as trans_attribution_id,

    ta.buyer_lifecycle,
    case ta.buyer_lifecycle
        when 'New' then 'New Buyer'
        when 'Retained' then 'Retained Buyer'
        when 'Resurrected' then 'Resurrected Buyer'
        when 'Unknown_lifecycle' then 'Unknown Lifecycle'
        else ta.buyer_lifecycle
    end as buyer_lifecycle_name,

    ta.country_code,

    ta.client,
    case ta.client
        when 'web' then 'Desktop Web'
        when 'iosapp' then 'iOS App'
        when 'ipadapp' then 'iPad App'
        when 'androidapp' then 'Android App'
        when 'mobileweb' then 'Mobile Web'
        when 'windowsapp' then 'Windows App'
        when 'windowsphoneapp' then 'Windows Phone App'
        when 'androidinstantapp' then 'Android Instant App'
        else ta.client
    end as client_name,

    ta.touch_event,
    case ta.touch_event
        when 'performance ads' then 'Performance Ads'
        when 'brand ads' then 'Brand Ads'
        when 'Push_Noti' then 'Push Notification'
        when 'Social_Event' then 'Social Event'
        else ta.touch_event
    end as touch_event_name,

    ta.channel,
    ta.campaign_id,

    ta.num_marketing_clickers,
    ta.num_marking_clicks,
    ta.num_buyers,
    ta.num_order,
    ta.num_txn,
    ta.gmv,
    ta.revenue,

    ta.dt as dt_str,
    cast(ta.dt as date) as dt

from {{ source('mde', 'daily_trans_attribution') }} as ta

approved_cards.usage: Always filter metric_time / dt first for partition pruning. Metrics are multi-touch fractional doubles — summing num_buyers / gmv / revenue across channels for a lifecycle×country×client×dt should approximate true totals. Use num_marking_clicks (schema typo, not num_marketing_clicks) for click volume. Organic rows inflate click metrics with fallback value 1. Expect dt <= current_date - 2 for settled partitions (attribution_day_pad = 2). Do not confuse with ads.daily_trans_attribution.
approved_cards.description: Daily multi-touch normalized transaction (purchase) attribution aggregate from MDE DailyAttribution_V7 Step 10. Attributes non-LTD commerce metrics — buyers, orders, transactions, GMV, and revenue — to marketing touch_event × channel × campaign_id at buyer_lifecycle × country × client × day grain using fractional multi-touch normalization so channel-level metrics sum back to true transaction totals. Grain is one row per buyer_lifecycle, country_code, client, touch_event, channel, campaign_id, and dt. Partition dt is the purchase reporting calendar day (America/Los Angeles fact partition); metrics are for non-LTD purchases on that day. Source: mde.daily_trans_attribution (DailyAttribution_V7).
approved_cards.selection_notes: Glossary channel_gmv source family (mde.daily_trans_attribution) with explicit channel dimension + gmv; used to enumerate actual channel/platform dimension values.

reasons.approve: 选择 approve：这三个模型覆盖词典 GMV 口径及 client/channel 的 wish 取值，足以继续生成 SQL。
reasons.deny-comments: 选择 deny-comments：若现有字段无法确认币种、运费或退款口径，请让我改选模型或补充字段。
reasons.deny-halt: 选择 deny-halt：若语义层已包含全部所需定义和 wish 取值，停止生成 SQL 更直接。

approved_cards.name: daily_rev_tahoe
approved_cards.cte:
{{ config(
    materialized='view'
) }}

{#
  Thin Semantic Layer wrapper over analytics.daily_rev_tahoe.
  Grain: one row per approved commerce line (transaction_id, order_id, variation_id).
  Business revenue day: order_approved_time in America/Los_Angeles (order_approved_day).
  Partition dt is the Hive load batch key — filter for pruning, not business dating alone.
#}

select
    concat(rev.transaction_id, '|', rev.order_id, '|', rev.variation_id) as daily_rev_line_id,

    rev.transaction_id,
    rev.order_id,
    rev.variation_id,
    rev.user_id,
    rev.product_id,
    rev.merchant_id,
    rev.payment_id,
    rev.refund_transaction_id,

    cast(
        date_format(from_unixtime(rev.order_approved_time, 'America/Los_Angeles'), '%Y-%m-%d')
        as date
    ) as order_approved_day,
    cast(rev.dt as date) as dt,
    cast(rev.confirmed_date as date) as confirmed_ship_day,
    cast(
        date_format(from_unixtime(rev.transaction_time, 'America/Los_Angeles'), '%Y-%m-%d')
        as date
    ) as transaction_day,

    cast(from_unixtime(rev.transaction_time) as timestamp) as transaction_ts,
    cast(from_unixtime(rev.shipped_date) as timestamp) as shipped_ts,
    cast(from_unixtime(rev.merchant_payment_time) as timestamp) as merchant_payment_ts,
    cast(from_unixtime(rev.refunded_time) as timestamp) as refunded_ts,
    rev.transaction_time,
    rev.order_approved_time,
    rev.shipped_date,
    rev.merchant_payment_time,
    rev.refunded_time,

    rev.country_code,
    rev.country_state,
    rev.shipping_country,
    rev.shipping_state,
    rev.merchant_country,
    rev.currency,
    rev.merchant_source_currency,
    rev.conversion_rate,

    rev.payment_method,
    rev.transaction_state,
    case rev.transaction_state
        when 0 then 'Pending'
        when 1 then 'Approved'
        when 2 then 'Acknowledged'
        when 3 then 'Shipped'
        when 4 then 'Declined'
        when 5 then 'Refunded'
        when 6 then 'C2C On Delivery'
        when 7 then 'C2C Delivered'
        when 8 then 'C2C Accepted'
        when 10 then 'Exception'
        when 11 then 'Gift Waiting For Accept'
        when 12 then 'Require Review'
        when 13 then 'Delaying'
        when 14 then 'Label Generated'
        when 15 then 'Label Downloaded'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as transaction_state_name,
    rev.order_state,
    case rev.order_state
        when 0 then 'Pending'
        when 1 then 'Approved'
        when 2 then 'Acknowledged'
        when 3 then 'Shipped'
        when 4 then 'Declined'
        when 5 then 'Refunded'
        when 6 then 'C2C On Delivery'
        when 7 then 'C2C Delivered'
        when 8 then 'C2C Accepted'
        when 10 then 'Exception'
        when 11 then 'Gift Waiting For Accept'
        when 12 then 'Require Review'
        when 13 then 'Delaying'
        when 14 then 'Label Generated'
        when 15 then 'Label Downloaded'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as order_state_name,

    rev.is_cancelled,
    rev.is_wish_owned,
    rev.is_wish_express,
    rev.is_free_gift,
    rev.is_bnpl,
    rev.original_category,
    rev.updated_category,
    rev.cancelretry_ind,
    rev.fbs_purchase,
    rev.fbs_sale,
    rev.shopify_none,
    rev.is_eea,
    rev.is_fusion_resale,
    rev.is_unity_order,
    rev.is_unity_order_and_payment_enabled,

    rev.quantity,
    rev.price_before_promotions,
    rev.shipping_before_promotions,
    rev.price_before_promotions + rev.shipping_before_promotions as gmv,
    rev.flat_rate_shipping,
    rev.giftcard_amount,
    rev.discount_amount,
    rev.tax_amount,
    rev.tax_fee,
    rev.net_amount,
    rev.wishcash_usage,
    rev.retail_delivery_fee_amount,

    rev.merchant_price,
    rev.merchant_shipping,
    rev.localized_paid_merchant,
    rev.paid_merchant_usd,
    rev.merchant_shipping_cost,
    rev.localized_merchant_shipping_cost,
    rev.merchant_cost,
    rev.localized_merchant_cost,
    rev.localized_merchant_eat_cost_amount,
    rev.merchant_eat_cost_amount_usd,
    rev.tax_cost,
    rev.merchant_tax_paid_usd,
    rev.merchant_tax_merch_eat_usd,
    rev.merchant_tax_amount_usd,
    rev.localized_merchant_tax_amount,
    rev.localized_merchant_tax_paid,
    rev.localized_merchant_tax_merch_eat,
    rev.tbd_remit_amount,

    rev.refund_amount,
    rev.localized_refund_amount,

    rev.original_full_cost_no_rebate_usd,
    rev.localized_original_full_cost_no_rebate,
    rev.localized_unity_wishpost_shipping,
    rev.unity_wishpost_shipping,
    rev.localized_initial_wishpost_shipping_amount,
    rev.initial_wishpost_shipping_amount,
    rev.localized_wishpost_shipping,
    rev.wishpost_shipping,
    rev.localized_wishpost_shipping_cost,
    rev.wishpost_shipping_cost,
    rev.localized_total_cost,
    rev.total_cost,
    rev.localized_full_cost_no_rebate_for_aplus,
    rev.full_cost_no_rebate_for_aplus_usd,
    rev.localized_full_cost_for_aplus,
    rev.full_cost_for_aplus,

    rev.original_rev_share,
    rev.updated_rev_share,

    rev.net_amount
        - rev.paid_merchant_usd
        - rev.merchant_eat_cost_amount_usd
        - rev.tax_cost
        - rev.merchant_tax_paid_usd
        - rev.merchant_tax_merch_eat_usd as commission_revenue
from {{ source('analytics', 'daily_rev_tahoe') }} as rev

Grain is one row per (transaction_id, order_id, variation_id) sourced from wish.fact_trans_detail with USD-normalized financials and cart-level amounts prorated to merchant-order lines. {#
  Thin Semantic Layer wrapper over bi.order_level.
  Grain: one row per merchant order (m_transaction_id) within partition dt.
  Source: Airflow DAG bi_order_level (daily 06:00 America/Los_Angeles).
#}

select
    concat(ol.m_transaction_id, '|', ol.dt) as order_level_id,

    ol.m_transaction_id,
    ol.transaction_id,
    ol.variation_id,
    ol.user_id,
    ol.merchant_id,
    ol.product_id,
    ol.tracking_id,

    ol.client,
    case ol.client
        when 'web' then 'Web'
        when 'iosapp' then 'iOS App'
        when 'androidapp' then 'Android App'
        when 'mobileweb' then 'Mobile Web'
        when 'Other' then 'Other'
        else ol.client
    end as client_name,

    ol.payment_method,

    ol.fulfilled,
    case ol.fulfilled
        when 1 then 'Confirmed shipped'
        when 0 then 'Not confirmed shipped'
        else cast(ol.fulfilled as varchar)
    end as fulfilled_name,

    ol.order_flat_rate_eligible,
    case ol.order_flat_rate_eligible
        when 1 then 'Eligible'
        when 0 then 'Not eligible'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as order_flat_rate_eligible_name,

    ol.order_flat_rate_qualified,
    case ol.order_flat_rate_qualified
        when 1 then 'Qualified'
        when 0 then 'Not qualified'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as order_flat_rate_qualified_name,

    ol.delivery_program,

    ol.wishpost_data_mature,
    case ol.wishpost_data_mature
        when 1 then 'Mature'
        when 0 then 'Immature'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as wishpost_data_mature_name,

    ol.refund_data_mature,
    case ol.refund_data_mature
        when 1 then 'Mature'
        when 0 then 'Immature'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as refund_data_mature_name,

    ol.is_pb,
    case ol.is_pb
        when 1 then 'Product Boost'
        when 0 then 'Not Product Boost'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as is_pb_name,

    ol.is_currently_bd_managed,
    case ol.is_currently_bd_managed
        when 1 then 'BD managed'
        when 0 then 'General support'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as is_currently_bd_managed_name,

    cast(ol.dt as date) as dt,
    cast(ol.transaction_dt as date) as transaction_dt,
    cast(ol.order_approved_dt as date) as order_approved_dt,
    cast(ol.refund_dt as date) as refund_dt,

    ol.buyer_lifecycle,
    ol.touch_event,
    ol.channel,
    ol.wss_tier,
    ol.shipping_country,
    ol.region,
    case upper(ol.region)
        when 'APAC' then 'Asia-Pacific'
        when 'LATAM' then 'Latin America'
        when 'MEA' then 'Middle East & Africa'
        when 'NWE' then 'Northern/Western Europe'
        when 'SEE' then 'Southern/Eastern Europe'
        when 'USCAN' then 'United States and Canada'
        else ol.region
    end as region_name,
    ol.country_name,
    ol.merchant_country,
    ol.merchant_country_group,
    ol.most_recent_bd_rep,

    ol.refund_reason_category,
    ol.md_refund_reason,
    ol.refund_type,

    ol.item_price,
    ol.gmv,
    ol.mkpl_revenue,
    ol.quantity,
    ol.discount_amount,
    ol.gross_gmv,
    ol.net_gmv,
    ol.total_shipping_paid_by_consumer,
    ol.refund_amount,
    ol.wishpost_sales_usd,
    ol.wishpost_costs_usd

approved_cards.usage: Filter metric_time / dt first for partition pruning. Commerce GMV on dt uses payment-received day from fct_transaction_variations; finance gross_gmv / net_gmv align with order_approved_dt (LA). WishPost logistics in daily_finance_metrics groups by order_approved_dt, not dt. Use refund_data_mature = 1 for stable refund rates; wishpost_data_mature = 1 for stable logistics P&L. gmv ≠ gross_gmv — different definitions.
approved_cards.description: BI source-of-truth order fact at merchant-transaction grain (m_transaction_id). Each row is one merchant order enriched with fulfillment, flat-rate shipping flags, WishPost logistics P&L, refund reason labels, buyer lifecycle / marketing attribution, Wish Standards (WSS) tier, buyer geo, merchant BD mapping, finance GMV components, and Product Boost attribution. Deduplicated from variation-level commerce to one row per m_transaction_id within partition dt (payment-received day, America/Los_Angeles). Daily refresh overwrites last 100 calendar days. LTD products excluded upstream. gmv is variation commerce GMV; gross_gmv and net_gmv are finance-spine definitions from daily_rev_tahoe. Source: bi.order_level (Airflow DAG bi_order_level).
approved_cards.selection_notes: 候选表：BI 订单粒度事实表（m_transaction_id 粒度），含 gmv / gross_gmv / net_gmv 与退款金额，分区 dt；作为 daily_rev_tahoe 的备选/交叉核对来源。

reasons.approve: 你应批准：daily_rev_tahoe 已覆盖 GMV、退款、币种、dt 与商户维度，足以继续生成 SQL。
reasons.deny-comments: 你应退回补充：现有模型未明确 shop/站点字段及退款口径，需先从术语表确认。
reasons.deny-halt: 你应停止：你的问题只需术语表和元数据结果，若已取得所需信息就无需生成 SQL。
reasons.dryrun: 你应选择 dryrun：只需预览 GMV 表与字段映射来核对元数据，无需保存画像或执行正式查询。

approved_cards.name: daily_rev_tahoe
approved_cards.cte:
{{ config(
    materialized='view'
) }}

{#
  Thin Semantic Layer wrapper over analytics.daily_rev_tahoe.
  Grain: one row per approved commerce line (transaction_id, order_id, variation_id).
  Business revenue day: order_approved_time in America/Los_Angeles (order_approved_day).
  Partition dt is the Hive load batch key — filter for pruning, not business dating alone.
#}

select
    concat(rev.transaction_id, '|', rev.order_id, '|', rev.variation_id) as daily_rev_line_id,

    rev.transaction_id,
    rev.order_id,
    rev.variation_id,
    rev.user_id,
    rev.product_id,
    rev.merchant_id,
    rev.payment_id,
    rev.refund_transaction_id,

    cast(
        date_format(from_unixtime(rev.order_approved_time, 'America/Los_Angeles'), '%Y-%m-%d')
        as date
    ) as order_approved_day,
    cast(rev.dt as date) as dt,
    cast(rev.confirmed_date as date) as confirmed_ship_day,
    cast(
        date_format(from_unixtime(rev.transaction_time, 'America/Los_Angeles'), '%Y-%m-%d')
        as date
    ) as transaction_day,

    cast(from_unixtime(rev.transaction_time) as timestamp) as transaction_ts,
    cast(from_unixtime(rev.shipped_date) as timestamp) as shipped_ts,
    cast(from_unixtime(rev.merchant_payment_time) as timestamp) as merchant_payment_ts,
    cast(from_unixtime(rev.refunded_time) as timestamp) as refunded_ts,
    rev.transaction_time,
    rev.order_approved_time,
    rev.shipped_date,
    rev.merchant_payment_time,
    rev.refunded_time,

    rev.country_code,
    rev.country_state,
    rev.shipping_country,
    rev.shipping_state,
    rev.merchant_country,
    rev.currency,
    rev.merchant_source_currency,
    rev.conversion_rate,

    rev.payment_method,
    rev.transaction_state,
    case rev.transaction_state
        when 0 then 'Pending'
        when 1 then 'Approved'
        when 2 then 'Acknowledged'
        when 3 then 'Shipped'
        when 4 then 'Declined'
        when 5 then 'Refunded'
        when 6 then 'C2C On Delivery'
        when 7 then 'C2C Delivered'
        when 8 then 'C2C Accepted'
        when 10 then 'Exception'
        when 11 then 'Gift Waiting For Accept'
        when 12 then 'Require Review'
        when 13 then 'Delaying'
        when 14 then 'Label Generated'
        when 15 then 'Label Downloaded'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as transaction_state_name,
    rev.order_state,
    case rev.order_state
        when 0 then 'Pending'
        when 1 then 'Approved'
        when 2 then 'Acknowledged'
        when 3 then 'Shipped'
        when 4 then 'Declined'
        when 5 then 'Refunded'
        when 6 then 'C2C On Delivery'
        when 7 then 'C2C Delivered'
        when 8 then 'C2C Accepted'
        when 10 then 'Exception'
        when 11 then 'Gift Waiting For Accept'
        when 12 then 'Require Review'
        when 13 then 'Delaying'
        when 14 then 'Label Generated'
        when 15 then 'Label Downloaded'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as order_state_name,

    rev.is_cancelled,
    rev.is_wish_owned,
    rev.is_wish_express,
    rev.is_free_gift,
    rev.is_bnpl,
    rev.original_category,
    rev.updated_category,
    rev.cancelretry_ind,
    rev.fbs_purchase,
    rev.fbs_sale,
    rev.shopify_none,
    rev.is_eea,
    rev.is_fusion_resale,
    rev.is_unity_order,
    rev.is_unity_order_and_payment_enabled,

    rev.quantity,
    rev.price_before_promotions,
    rev.shipping_before_promotions,
    rev.price_before_promotions + rev.shipping_before_promotions as gmv,
    rev.flat_rate_shipping,
    rev.giftcard_amount,
    rev.discount_amount,
    rev.tax_amount,
    rev.tax_fee,
    rev.net_amount,
    rev.wishcash_usage,
    rev.retail_delivery_fee_amount,

    rev.merchant_price,
    rev.merchant_shipping,
    rev.localized_paid_merchant,
    rev.paid_merchant_usd,
    rev.merchant_shipping_cost,
    rev.localized_merchant_shipping_cost,
    rev.merchant_cost,
    rev.localized_merchant_cost,
    rev.localized_merchant_eat_cost_amount,
    rev.merchant_eat_cost_amount_usd,
    rev.tax_cost,
    rev.merchant_tax_paid_usd,
    rev.merchant_tax_merch_eat_usd,
    rev.merchant_tax_amount_usd,
    rev.localized_merchant_tax_amount,
    rev.localized_merchant_tax_paid,
    rev.localized_merchant_tax_merch_eat,
    rev.tbd_remit_amount,

    rev.refund_amount,
    rev.localized_refund_amount,

    rev.original_full_cost_no_rebate_usd,
    rev.localized_original_full_cost_no_rebate,
    rev.localized_unity_wishpost_shipping,
    rev.unity_wishpost_shipping,
    rev.localized_initial_wishpost_shipping_amount,
    rev.initial_wishpost_shipping_amount,
    rev.localized_wishpost_shipping,
    rev.wishpost_shipping,
    rev.localized_wishpost_shipping_cost,
    rev.wishpost_shipping_cost,
    rev.localized_total_cost,
    rev.total_cost,
    rev.localized_full_cost_no_rebate_for_aplus,
    rev.full_cost_no_rebate_for_aplus_usd,
    rev.localized_full_cost_for_aplus,
    rev.full_cost_for_aplus,

    rev.original_rev_share,
    rev.updated_rev_share,

    rev.net_amount
        - rev.paid_merchant_usd

approved_cards.usage: Filter metric_time / dt first for partition pruning. Use order_approved_day for LA revenue recognition; transaction_day for checkout analysis. GMV = price_before_promotions + shipping_before_promotions; net GMV = net_amount. Commission = net − paid_merchant − MEC − tax components. Dedupe on grain keys before summing when append duplicates are suspected.
approved_cards.description: Order-item (variation) grain daily revenue fact for approved Wish marketplace commerce lines. Grain is one row per (transaction_id, order_id, variation_id) sourced from wish.fact_trans_detail with USD-normalized financials and cart-level amounts prorated to merchant-order lines. Excludes PENDING, DECLINED, and EXCEPTION item states at load time. Business revenue day is America/Los_Angeles date from order_approved_time (order_approved_day); Hive partition dt is the load batch end date — filter dt for pruning and order_approved_day for reporting. Duplicate rows can exist across append loads; dedupe before aggregates when sums must reconcile. Source: analytics.daily_rev_tahoe (Airflow DAG DailyRevTahoeNew).
approved_cards.selection_notes: Wish 业务线 GMV 主表：行粒度为 (transaction_id, order_id, variation_id) 的已审批订单行；GMV = price_before_promotions + shipping_before_promotions（USD 归一），net_amount 为净 GMV；分区字段 dt，业务日期用 order_approved_time（America/Los_Angeles）。

approved_cards.cte:
{{ config(
    materialized='view'

{#
  Thin Semantic Layer wrapper over bi.order_level.
  Grain: one row per merchant order (m_transaction_id) within partition dt.
  Source: Airflow DAG bi_order_level (daily 06:00 America/Los_Angeles).
#}

select
    concat(ol.m_transaction_id, '|', ol.dt) as order_level_id,

    ol.m_transaction_id,
    ol.transaction_id,
    ol.variation_id,
    ol.user_id,
    ol.merchant_id,
    ol.product_id,
    ol.tracking_id,

    ol.client,
    case ol.client
        when 'web' then 'Web'
        when 'iosapp' then 'iOS App'
        when 'androidapp' then 'Android App'
        when 'mobileweb' then 'Mobile Web'
        when 'Other' then 'Other'
        else ol.client
    end as client_name,

    ol.payment_method,

    ol.fulfilled,
    case ol.fulfilled
        when 1 then 'Confirmed shipped'
        when 0 then 'Not confirmed shipped'
        else cast(ol.fulfilled as varchar)
    end as fulfilled_name,

    ol.order_flat_rate_eligible,
    case ol.order_flat_rate_eligible
        when 1 then 'Eligible'
        when 0 then 'Not eligible'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as order_flat_rate_eligible_name,

    ol.order_flat_rate_qualified,
    case ol.order_flat_rate_qualified
        when 1 then 'Qualified'
        when 0 then 'Not qualified'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as order_flat_rate_qualified_name,

    ol.delivery_program,

    ol.wishpost_data_mature,
    case ol.wishpost_data_mature
        when 1 then 'Mature'
        when 0 then 'Immature'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as wishpost_data_mature_name,

    ol.refund_data_mature,
    case ol.refund_data_mature
        when 1 then 'Mature'
        when 0 then 'Immature'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as refund_data_mature_name,

    ol.is_pb,
    case ol.is_pb
        when 1 then 'Product Boost'
        when 0 then 'Not Product Boost'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as is_pb_name,

    ol.is_currently_bd_managed,
    case ol.is_currently_bd_managed
        when 1 then 'BD managed'
        when 0 then 'General support'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as is_currently_bd_managed_name,

    cast(ol.dt as date) as dt,
    cast(ol.transaction_dt as date) as transaction_dt,
    cast(ol.order_approved_dt as date) as order_approved_dt,
    cast(ol.refund_dt as date) as refund_dt,

    ol.buyer_lifecycle,
    ol.touch_event,
    ol.channel,
    ol.wss_tier,
    ol.shipping_country,
    ol.region,
    case upper(ol.region)
        when 'APAC' then 'Asia-Pacific'
        when 'LATAM' then 'Latin America'
        when 'MEA' then 'Middle East & Africa'
        when 'NWE' then 'Northern/Western Europe'
        when 'SEE' then 'Southern/Eastern Europe'
        when 'USCAN' then 'United States and Canada'
        else ol.region
    end as region_name,
    ol.country_name,
    ol.merchant_country,
    ol.merchant_country_group,
    ol.most_recent_bd_rep,

    ol.refund_reason_category,
    ol.md_refund_reason,
    ol.refund_type,

    ol.item_price,
    ol.gmv,
    ol.mkpl_revenue,
    ol.quantity,
    ol.discount_amount,
    ol.gross_gmv,
    ol.net_gmv,
    ol.total_shipping_paid_by_consumer,
    ol.refund_amount,
    ol.wishpost_sales_usd,
    ol.wishpost_costs_usd
from {{ source('bi', 'order_level') }} as ol

approved_cards.usage: Filter metric_time / dt first for partition pruning. Commerce GMV on dt uses payment-received day from fct_transaction_variations; finance gross_gmv / net_gmv align with order_approved_dt (LA). WishPost logistics in daily_finance_metrics groups by order_approved_dt, not dt. Use refund_data_mature = 1 for stable refund rates; wishpost_data_mature = 1 for stable logistics P&L. gmv ≠ gross_gmv — different definitions.
approved_cards.description: BI source-of-truth order fact at merchant-transaction grain (m_transaction_id). Each row is one merchant order enriched with fulfillment, flat-rate shipping flags, WishPost logistics P&L, refund reason labels, buyer lifecycle / marketing attribution, Wish Standards (WSS) tier, buyer geo, merchant BD mapping, finance GMV components, and Product Boost attribution. Deduplicated from variation-level commerce to one row per m_transaction_id within partition dt (payment-received day, America/Los_Angeles). Daily refresh overwrites last 100 calendar days. LTD products excluded upstream. gmv is variation commerce GMV; gross_gmv and net_gmv are finance-spine definitions from daily_rev_tahoe. Source: bi.order_level (Airflow DAG bi_order_level).
approved_cards.selection_notes: 候选表：BI 订单粒度事实表（m_transaction_id 粒度），含 gmv / gross_gmv / net_gmv 与退款金额，分区 dt；作为 daily_rev_tahoe 的备选/交叉核对来源。

approved_sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    "transaction_id",
    "order_id",
    "variation_id",
    MAX("currency") AS currency,
    MAX("merchant_source_currency") AS merchant_source_currency,
    MAX("shipping_country") AS shipping_country,
    MAX("merchant_id") AS merchant_id,
    MAX("price_before_promotions") AS price_before_promotions,
    MAX("shipping_before_promotions") AS shipping_before_promotions,
    MAX("net_amount") AS net_amount,
    MAX("discount_amount") AS discount_amount,
    MAX("giftcard_amount") AS giftcard_amount,
    MAX("flat_rate_shipping") AS flat_rate_shipping,
    MAX("retail_delivery_fee_amount") AS retail_delivery_fee_amount,
    MAX("tax_amount") AS tax_amount,
    MAX("refund_amount") AS refund_amount,
    MAX("wishcash_usage") AS wishcash_usage,
    MAX("quantity") AS quantity
  FROM hive.analytics.daily_rev_tahoe
  WHERE "dt" >= CAST(current_date - INTERVAL '8' DAY AS VARCHAR)
    AND "dt" <= CAST(current_date AS VARCHAR)
    AND "order_approved_time" >= to_unixtime(CAST(current_date - INTERVAL '8' DAY AS TIMESTAMP) AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles')
    AND "order_approved_time" <  to_unixtime(CAST(current_date AS TIMESTAMP) AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles')
  GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
)
SELECT
  currency,
  merchant_source_currency,
  COUNT(*) AS line_rows,
  COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT transaction_id) AS transaction_count,
  SUM(quantity) AS units,
  SUM(price_before_promotions + shipping_before_promotions) AS gmv_usd,
  SUM(net_amount) AS net_gmv_usd,
  SUM(discount_amount) AS discounts_usd,
  SUM(giftcard_amount) AS giftcard_usd,
  SUM(flat_rate_shipping) AS flat_rate_shipping_usd,
  SUM(retail_delivery_fee_amount) AS retail_delivery_fee_usd,
  SUM(tax_amount) AS tax_usd,
  SUM(refund_amount) AS refund_usd,
  SUM(wishcash_usage) AS wishcash_usd
FROM base
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY gmv_usd DESC

reasons.approve: 你应批准：daily_rev_tahoe 已覆盖 GMV、退款、币种、dt 与商户维度，足以继续生成 SQL。
reasons.deny-comments: 你应退回补充：现有模型未明确 shop/站点字段及退款口径，需先从术语表确认。
reasons.deny-halt: 你应停止：你的问题只需术语表和元数据结果，若已取得所需信息就无需生成 SQL。
reasons.dryrun: 你应选择 dryrun：只需预览 GMV 表与字段映射来核对元数据，无需保存画像或执行正式查询。

reasons.approve: 口径已对齐（GMV = price_before_promotions + shipping_before_promotions，按 order_approved_time 落业务日并按行粒度去重），时间范围、分区裁剪和币种字段都明确，可以直接跑。
reasons.deny-comments: 若你希望把退款/取消单在 GMV 口径上再明确（例如是否用 net_amount 替代毛 GMV、或对 is_cancelled='Cancelled' 单独剔除），在批准前留言说明即可。
reasons.deny-halt: 如果本轮你只想确认口径与字段、暂不需要任何取数结果，那么在这里停下是合理的。
reasons.dryrun: 建议先 dryrun 看下最近 8 天各币种的 GMV 量级与去重后行数是否合理，再决定是否正式执行。

{{ config(
    materialized='view'
) }}

{#
  Thin Semantic Layer wrapper over analytics.daily_rev_tahoe.
  Grain: one row per approved commerce line (transaction_id, order_id, variation_id).
  Business revenue day: order_approved_time in America/Los_Angeles (order_approved_day).
  Partition dt is the Hive load batch key — filter for pruning, not business dating alone.
#}

select
    concat(rev.transaction_id, '|', rev.order_id, '|', rev.variation_id) as daily_rev_line_id,

    rev.transaction_id,
    rev.order_id,
    rev.variation_id,
    rev.user_id,
    rev.product_id,
    rev.merchant_id,
    rev.payment_id,
    rev.refund_transaction_id,

    cast(
        date_format(from_unixtime(rev.order_approved_time, 'America/Los_Angeles'), '%Y-%m-%d')
        as date
    ) as order_approved_day,
    cast(rev.dt as date) as dt,
    cast(rev.confirmed_date as date) as confirmed_ship_day,
    cast(
        date_format(from_unixtime(rev.transaction_time, 'America/Los_Angeles'), '%Y-%m-%d')
        as date
    ) as transaction_day,

    cast(from_unixtime(rev.transaction_time) as timestamp) as transaction_ts,
    cast(from_unixtime(rev.shipped_date) as timestamp) as shipped_ts,
    cast(from_unixtime(rev.merchant_payment_time) as timestamp) as merchant_payment_ts,
    cast(from_unixtime(rev.refunded_time) as timestamp) as refunded_ts,
    rev.transaction_time,
    rev.order_approved_time,
    rev.shipped_date,
    rev.merchant_payment_time,
    rev.refunded_time,

    rev.country_code,
    rev.country_state,
    rev.shipping_country,
    rev.shipping_state,
    rev.merchant_country,
    rev.currency,
    rev.merchant_source_currency,
    rev.conversion_rate,

    rev.payment_method,
    rev.transaction_state,
    case rev.transaction_state
        when 0 then 'Pending'
        when 1 then 'Approved'
        when 2 then 'Acknowledged'
        when 3 then 'Shipped'
        when 4 then 'Declined'
        when 5 then 'Refunded'
        when 6 then 'C2C On Delivery'
        when 7 then 'C2C Delivered'
        when 8 then 'C2C Accepted'
        when 10 then 'Exception'
        when 11 then 'Gift Waiting For Accept'
        when 12 then 'Require Review'
        when 13 then 'Delaying'
        when 14 then 'Label Generated'
        when 15 then 'Label Downloaded'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as transaction_state_name,
    rev.order_state,
    case rev.order_state
        when 0 then 'Pending'
        when 1 then 'Approved'
        when 2 then 'Acknowledged'
        when 3 then 'Shipped'
        when 4 then 'Declined'
        when 5 then 'Refunded'
        when 6 then 'C2C On Delivery'
        when 7 then 'C2C Delivered'
        when 8 then 'C2C Accepted'
        when 10 then 'Exception'
        when 11 then 'Gift Waiting For Accept'
        when 12 then 'Require Review'
        when 13 then 'Delaying'
        when 14 then 'Label Generated'
        when 15 then 'Label Downloaded'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as order_state_name,

    rev.is_cancelled,
    rev.is_wish_owned,
    rev.is_wish_express,
    rev.is_free_gift,
    rev.is_bnpl,
    rev.original_category,
    rev.updated_category,
    rev.cancelretry_ind,
    rev.fbs_purchase,
    rev.fbs_sale,
    rev.shopify_none,
    rev.is_eea,
    rev.is_fusion_resale,
    rev.is_unity_order,
    rev.is_unity_order_and_payment_enabled,

    rev.quantity,
    rev.price_before_promotions,
    rev.shipping_before_promotions,
    rev.price_before_promotions + rev.shipping_before_promotions as gmv,
    rev.flat_rate_shipping,
    rev.giftcard_amount,
    rev.discount_amount,
    rev.tax_amount,
    rev.tax_fee,
    rev.net_amount,
    rev.wishcash_usage,
    rev.retail_delivery_fee_amount,

    rev.merchant_price,
    rev.merchant_shipping,
    rev.localized_paid_merchant,
    rev.paid_merchant_usd,
    rev.merchant_shipping_cost,
    rev.localized_merchant_shipping_cost,
    rev.merchant_cost,
    rev.localized_merchant_cost,
    rev.localized_merchant_eat_cost_amount,
    rev.merchant_eat_cost_amount_usd,
    rev.tax_cost,
    rev.merchant_tax_paid_usd,
    rev.merchant_tax_merch_eat_usd,
    rev.merchant_tax_amount_usd,
    rev.localized_merchant_tax_amount,
    rev.localized_merchant_tax_paid,
    rev.localized_merchant_tax_merch_eat,
    rev.tbd_remit_amount,

    rev.refund_amount,
    rev.localized_refund_amount,

    rev.original_full_cost_no_rebate_usd,
    rev.localized_original_full_cost_no_rebate,
    rev.localized_unity_wishpost_shipping,
    rev.unity_wishpost_shipping,
    rev.localized_initial_wishpost_shipping_amount,
    rev.initial_wishpost_shipping_amount,
    rev.localized_wishpost_shipping,
    rev.wishpost_shipping,
    rev.localized_wishpost_shipping_cost,
    rev.wishpost_shipping_cost,
    rev.localized_total_cost,
    rev.total_cost,
    rev.localized_full_cost_no_rebate_for_aplus,
    rev.full_cost_no_rebate_for_aplus_usd,
    rev.localized_full_cost_for_aplus,
    rev.full_cost_for_aplus,

    rev.original_rev_share,
    rev.updated_rev_share,

    rev.net_amount
        - rev.paid_merchant_usd
        - rev.merchant_eat_cost_amount_usd
        - rev.tax_cost
        - rev.merchant_tax_paid_usd
        - rev.merchant_tax_merch_eat_usd as commission_revenue
from {{ source('analytics', 'daily_rev_tahoe') }} as rev

GMV = price_before_promotions + shipping_before_promotions; net GMV = net_amount. Commission = net − paid_merchant − MEC − tax components. Dedupe on grain keys before summing when append duplicates are suspected.
approved_cards.description: Order-item (variation) grain daily revenue fact for approved Wish marketplace commerce lines. Grain is one row per (transaction_id, order_id, variation_id) sourced from wish.fact_trans_detail with USD-normalized financials and cart-level amounts prorated to merchant-order lines. Excludes PENDING, DECLINED, and EXCEPTION item states at load time. Business revenue day is America/Los_Angeles date from order_approved_time (order_approved_day); Hive partition dt is the load batch end date — filter dt for pruning and order_approved_day for reporting. Duplicate rows can exist across append loads; dedupe before aggregates when sums must reconcile. Source: analytics.daily_rev_tahoe (Airflow DAG DailyRevTahoeNew).

{{ config(
    materialized='view'
) }}

{#
  Thin Semantic Layer wrapper over bi.order_level.
  Grain: one row per merchant order (m_transaction_id) within partition dt.
  Source: Airflow DAG bi_order_level (daily 06:00 America/Los_Angeles).
#}

select
    concat(ol.m_transaction_id, '|', ol.dt) as order_level_id,

    ol.m_transaction_id,
    ol.transaction_id,
    ol.variation_id,
    ol.user_id,
    ol.merchant_id,
    ol.product_id,
    ol.tracking_id,

    ol.client,
    case ol.client
        when 'web' then 'Web'
        when 'iosapp' then 'iOS App'
        when 'androidapp' then 'Android App'
        when 'mobileweb' then 'Mobile Web'
        when 'Other' then 'Other'
        else ol.client
    end as client_name,

    ol.payment_method,

    ol.fulfilled,
    case ol.fulfilled
        when 1 then 'Confirmed shipped'
        when 0 then 'Not confirmed shipped'
        else cast(ol.fulfilled as varchar)
    end as fulfilled_name,

    ol.order_flat_rate_eligible,
    case ol.order_flat_rate_eligible
        when 1 then 'Eligible'
        when 0 then 'Not eligible'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as order_flat_rate_eligible_name,

    ol.order_flat_rate_qualified,
    case ol.order_flat_rate_qualified
        when 1 then 'Qualified'
        when 0 then 'Not qualified'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as order_flat_rate_qualified_name,

    ol.delivery_program,

    ol.wishpost_data_mature,
    case ol.wishpost_data_mature
        when 1 then 'Mature'
        when 0 then 'Immature'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as wishpost_data_mature_name,

    ol.refund_data_mature,
    case ol.refund_data_mature
        when 1 then 'Mature'
        when 0 then 'Immature'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as refund_data_mature_name,

    ol.is_pb,
    case ol.is_pb
        when 1 then 'Product Boost'
        when 0 then 'Not Product Boost'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as is_pb_name,

    ol.is_currently_bd_managed,
    case ol.is_currently_bd_managed
        when 1 then 'BD managed'
        when 0 then 'General support'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as is_currently_bd_managed_name,

    cast(ol.dt as date) as dt,
    cast(ol.transaction_dt as date) as transaction_dt,
    cast(ol.order_approved_dt as date) as order_approved_dt,
    cast(ol.refund_dt as date) as refund_dt,

    ol.buyer_lifecycle,
    ol.touch_event,
    ol.channel,
    ol.wss_tier,
    ol.shipping_country,
    ol.region,
    case upper(ol.region)
        when 'APAC' then 'Asia-Pacific'
        when 'LATAM' then 'Latin America'
        when 'MEA' then 'Middle East & Africa'
        when 'NWE' then 'Northern/Western Europe'
        when 'SEE' then 'Southern/Eastern Europe'
        when 'USCAN' then 'United States and Canada'
        else ol.region
    end as region_name,
    ol.country_name,
    ol.merchant_country,
    ol.merchant_country_group,
    ol.most_recent_bd_rep,

    ol.refund_reason_category,
    ol.md_refund_reason,
    ol.refund_type,

    ol.item_price,
    ol.gmv,
    ol.mkpl_revenue,
    ol.quantity,
    ol.discount_amount,
    ol.gross_gmv,
    ol.net_gmv,
    ol.total_shipping_paid_by_consumer,
    ol.refund_amount,
    ol.wishpost_sales_usd,
    ol.wishpost_costs_usd

approved_cards.usage: Filter metric_time / dt first for partition pruning. Commerce GMV on dt uses payment-received day from fct_transaction_variations; finance gross_gmv / net_gmv align with order_approved_dt (LA). WishPost logistics in daily_finance_metrics groups by order_approved_dt, not dt. Use refund_data_mature = 1 for stable refund rates; wishpost_data_mature = 1 for stable logistics P&L. gmv ≠ gross_gmv — different definitions.
approved_cards.description: BI source-of-truth order fact at merchant-transaction grain (m_transaction_id). Each row is one merchant order enriched with fulfillment, flat-rate shipping flags, WishPost logistics P&L, refund reason labels, buyer lifecycle / marketing attribution, Wish Standards (WSS) tier, buyer geo, merchant BD mapping, finance GMV components, and Product Boost attribution. Deduplicated from variation-level commerce to one row per m_transaction_id within partition dt (payment-received day, America/Los_Angeles). Daily refresh overwrites last 100 calendar days. LTD products excluded upstream. gmv is variation commerce GMV; gross_gmv and net_gmv are finance-spine definitions from daily_rev_tahoe. Source: bi.order_level (Airflow DAG bi_order_level).
approved_cards.selection_notes: 候选/交叉核对表：BI 订单粒度事实表，含 client / client_name（可用于确认业务线/站点取值）与 gmv、gross_gmv、net_gmv。

reasons.approve: 当前主表与 GMV 口径已明确，order_level 还可用于核验 Wish 标识，足以让你继续生成并执行 SQL。
reasons.deny-comments: 若字段核验发现缺少可靠的 Wish 标识，请退回以改选含站点或业务线维度的模型。
reasons.deny-halt: 若现有模型都无法可靠识别 Wish 且 GMV 口径无法验证，请停止执行，以免输出错误 SQL。
reasons.dryrun: 若你只需预览日期逻辑和 SQL 而暂不保存配置，选择试运行即可。

approved_cards.name: daily_rev_tahoe
approved_cards.cte:
{{ config(
    materialized='view'
) }}

{#
  Thin Semantic Layer wrapper over analytics.daily_rev_tahoe.
  Grain: one row per approved commerce line (transaction_id, order_id, variation_id).
  Business revenue day: order_approved_time in America/Los_Angeles (order_approved_day).
  Partition dt is the Hive load batch key — filter for pruning, not business dating alone.
#}

select
    concat(rev.transaction_id, '|', rev.order_id, '|', rev.variation_id) as daily_rev_line_id,

    rev.transaction_id,
    rev.order_id,
    rev.variation_id,
    rev.user_id,
    rev.product_id,
    rev.merchant_id,
    rev.payment_id,
    rev.refund_transaction_id,

    cast(
        date_format(from_unixtime(rev.order_approved_time, 'America/Los_Angeles'), '%Y-%m-%d')
        as date
    ) as order_approved_day,
    cast(rev.dt as date) as dt,
    cast(rev.confirmed_date as date) as confirmed_ship_day,
    cast(
        date_format(from_unixtime(rev.transaction_time, 'America/Los_Angeles'), '%Y-%m-%d')
        as date
    ) as transaction_day,

    cast(from_unixtime(rev.transaction_time) as timestamp) as transaction_ts,
    cast(from_unixtime(rev.shipped_date) as timestamp) as shipped_ts,
    cast(from_unixtime(rev.merchant_payment_time) as timestamp) as merchant_payment_ts,
    cast(from_unixtime(rev.refunded_time) as timestamp) as refunded_ts,
    rev.transaction_time,
    rev.order_approved_time,
    rev.shipped_date,
    rev.merchant_payment_time,
    rev.refunded_time,

    rev.country_code,
    rev.country_state,
    rev.shipping_country,
    rev.shipping_state,
    rev.merchant_country,
    rev.currency,
    rev.merchant_source_currency,
    rev.conversion_rate,

    rev.payment_method,
    rev.transaction_state,
    case rev.transaction_state
        when 0 then 'Pending'
        when 1 then 'Approved'
        when 2 then 'Acknowledged'
        when 3 then 'Shipped'
        when 4 then 'Declined'
        when 5 then 'Refunded'
        when 6 then 'C2C On Delivery'
        when 7 then 'C2C Delivered'
        when 8 then 'C2C Accepted'
        when 10 then 'Exception'
        when 11 then 'Gift Waiting For Accept'
        when 12 then 'Require Review'
        when 13 then 'Delaying'
        when 14 then 'Label Generated'
        when 15 then 'Label Downloaded'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as transaction_state_name,
    rev.order_state,
    case rev.order_state
        when 0 then 'Pending'
        when 1 then 'Approved'
        when 2 then 'Acknowledged'
        when 3 then 'Shipped'
        when 4 then 'Declined'
        when 5 then 'Refunded'
        when 6 then 'C2C On Delivery'
        when 7 then 'C2C Delivered'
        when 8 then 'C2C Accepted'
        when 10 then 'Exception'
        when 11 then 'Gift Waiting For Accept'
        when 12 then 'Require Review'
        when 13 then 'Delaying'
        when 14 then 'Label Generated'
        when 15 then 'Label Downloaded'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as order_state_name,

    rev.is_cancelled,
    rev.is_wish_owned,
    rev.is_wish_express,
    rev.is_free_gift,
    rev.is_bnpl,
    rev.original_category,
    rev.updated_category,
    rev.cancelretry_ind,
    rev.fbs_purchase,
    rev.fbs_sale,
    rev.shopify_none,
    rev.is_eea,
    rev.is_fusion_resale,
    rev.is_unity_order,
    rev.is_unity_order_and_payment_enabled,

    rev.quantity,
    rev.price_before_promotions,
    rev.shipping_before_promotions,
    rev.price_before_promotions + rev.shipping_before_promotions as gmv,
    rev.flat_rate_shipping,
    rev.giftcard_amount,
    rev.discount_amount,
    rev.tax_amount,
    rev.tax_fee,
    rev.net_amount,
    rev.wishcash_usage,
    rev.retail_delivery_fee_amount,

    rev.merchant_price,
    rev.merchant_shipping,
    rev.localized_paid_merchant,
    rev.paid_merchant_usd,
    rev.merchant_shipping_cost,
    rev.localized_merchant_shipping_cost,
    rev.merchant_cost,
    rev.localized_merchant_cost,
    rev.localized_merchant_eat_cost_amount,
    rev.merchant_eat_cost_amount_usd,
    rev.tax_cost,
    rev.merchant_tax_paid_usd,
    rev.merchant_tax_merch_eat_usd,
    rev.merchant_tax_amount_usd,
    rev.localized_merchant_tax_amount,
    rev.localized_merchant_tax_paid,
    rev.localized_merchant_tax_merch_eat,
    rev.tbd_remit_amount,

    rev.refund_amount,
    rev.localized_refund_amount,

    rev.original_full_cost_no_rebate_usd,
    rev.localized_original_full_cost_no_rebate,
    rev.localized_unity_wishpost_shipping,
    rev.unity_wishpost_shipping,
    rev.localized_initial_wishpost_shipping_amount,
    rev.initial_wishpost_shipping_amount,
    rev.localized_wishpost_shipping,
    rev.wishpost_shipping,
    rev.localized_wishpost_shipping_cost,
    rev.wishpost_shipping_cost,
    rev.localized_total_cost,
    rev.total_cost,
    rev.localized_full_cost_no_rebate_for_aplus,
    rev.full_cost_no_rebate_for_aplus_usd,
    rev.localized_full_cost_for_aplus,
    rev.full_cost_for_aplus,

    rev.original_rev_share,
    rev.updated_rev_share,

    rev.net_amount
        - rev.paid_merchant_usd
        - rev.merchant_eat_cost_amount_usd
        - rev.tax_cost
        - rev.merchant_tax_paid_usd
        - rev.merchant_tax_merch_eat_usd as commission_revenue
from {{ source('analytics', 'daily_rev_tahoe') }} as rev

{{ config(
    materialized='view'

{#
  Thin Semantic Layer wrapper over bi.order_level.
  Grain: one row per merchant order (m_transaction_id) within partition dt.
  Source: Airflow DAG bi_order_level (daily 06:00 America/Los_Angeles).
#}

select
    concat(ol.m_transaction_id, '|', ol.dt) as order_level_id,

    ol.m_transaction_id,
    ol.transaction_id,
    ol.variation_id,
    ol.user_id,
    ol.merchant_id,
    ol.product_id,
    ol.tracking_id,

    ol.client,
    case ol.client
        when 'web' then 'Web'
        when 'iosapp' then 'iOS App'
        when 'androidapp' then 'Android App'
        when 'mobileweb' then 'Mobile Web'
        when 'Other' then 'Other'
        else ol.client
    end as client_name,

    ol.payment_method,

    ol.fulfilled,
    case ol.fulfilled
        when 1 then 'Confirmed shipped'
        when 0 then 'Not confirmed shipped'
        else cast(ol.fulfilled as varchar)
    end as fulfilled_name,

    ol.order_flat_rate_eligible,
    case ol.order_flat_rate_eligible
        when 1 then 'Eligible'
        when 0 then 'Not eligible'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as order_flat_rate_eligible_name,

    ol.order_flat_rate_qualified,
    case ol.order_flat_rate_qualified
        when 1 then 'Qualified'
        when 0 then 'Not qualified'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as order_flat_rate_qualified_name,

    ol.delivery_program,

    ol.wishpost_data_mature,
    case ol.wishpost_data_mature
        when 1 then 'Mature'
        when 0 then 'Immature'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as wishpost_data_mature_name,

    ol.refund_data_mature,
    case ol.refund_data_mature
        when 1 then 'Mature'
        when 0 then 'Immature'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as refund_data_mature_name,

    ol.is_pb,
    case ol.is_pb
        when 1 then 'Product Boost'
        when 0 then 'Not Product Boost'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as is_pb_name,

    ol.is_currently_bd_managed,
    case ol.is_currently_bd_managed
        when 1 then 'BD managed'
        when 0 then 'General support'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as is_currently_bd_managed_name,

    cast(ol.dt as date) as dt,
    cast(ol.transaction_dt as date) as transaction_dt,
    cast(ol.order_approved_dt as date) as order_approved_dt,
    cast(ol.refund_dt as date) as refund_dt,

    ol.buyer_lifecycle,
    ol.touch_event,
    ol.channel,
    ol.wss_tier,
    ol.shipping_country,
    ol.region,
    case upper(ol.region)
        when 'APAC' then 'Asia-Pacific'
        when 'LATAM' then 'Latin America'
        when 'MEA' then 'Middle East & Africa'
        when 'NWE' then 'Northern/Western Europe'
        when 'SEE' then 'Southern/Eastern Europe'
        when 'USCAN' then 'United States and Canada'
        else ol.region
    end as region_name,
    ol.country_name,
    ol.merchant_country,
    ol.merchant_country_group,
    ol.most_recent_bd_rep,

    ol.refund_reason_category,
    ol.md_refund_reason,
    ol.refund_type,

    ol.item_price,
    ol.gmv,
    ol.mkpl_revenue,
    ol.quantity,
    ol.discount_amount,
    ol.gross_gmv,
    ol.net_gmv,
    ol.total_shipping_paid_by_consumer,
    ol.refund_amount,
    ol.wishpost_sales_usd,
    ol.wishpost_costs_usd
from {{ source('bi', 'order_level') }} as ol

Commerce GMV on dt uses payment-received day from fct_transaction_variations; finance gross_gmv / net_gmv align with order_approved_dt (LA). WishPost logistics in daily_finance_metrics groups by order_approved_dt, not dt. approved_cards.description: BI source-of-truth order fact at merchant-transaction grain (m_transaction_id). Each row is one merchant order enriched with fulfillment, flat-rate shipping flags, WishPost logistics P&L, refund reason labels, buyer lifecycle / marketing attribution, Wish Standards (WSS) tier, buyer geo, merchant BD mapping, finance GMV components, and Product Boost attribution. Deduplicated from variation-level commerce to one row per m_transaction_id within partition dt (payment-received day, America/Los_Angeles). Daily refresh overwrites last 100 calendar days. LTD products excluded upstream. gmv is variation commerce GMV; gross_gmv and net_gmv are finance-spine definitions from daily_rev_tahoe. Source: bi.order_level (Airflow DAG bi_order_level).

approved_sql:
WITH bounds AS (
  SELECT
    format_datetime(CAST(date_trunc('month', CAST(current_date - INTERVAL '1' MONTH AS DATE)) AS TIMESTAMP), 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS month_start,
    format_datetime(CAST(date_trunc('month', CAST(current_date AS DATE)) AS TIMESTAMP), 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS next_month_start,
    CAST(current_date AS VARCHAR) AS as_of_date
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    t."dt" AS dt,
    t."transaction_id" AS transaction_id,
    t."order_id" AS order_id,
    t."variation_id" AS variation_id,
    MAX(t."price_before_promotions") AS price_before_promotions,
    MAX(t."shipping_before_promotions") AS shipping_before_promotions,
    MAX(t."net_amount") AS net_amount,
    MAX(t."refund_amount") AS refund_amount,
    MAX(t."quantity") AS quantity,
    MAX(t."shipping_country") AS shipping_country,
    MAX(t."country_code") AS country_code,
    MAX(t."merchant_country") AS merchant_country,
    MAX(t."payment_method") AS payment_method,
    MAX(t."is_wish_owned") AS is_wish_owned,
    MAX(t."shopify_none") AS shopify_none,
    MAX(CASE WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(t."shipping_country", '')) LIKE '%wish%'
              OR LOWER(COALESCE(t."country_code", '')) LIKE '%wish%'
              OR LOWER(COALESCE(t."merchant_country", '')) LIKE '%wish%'
              OR LOWER(COALESCE(t."payment_method", '')) LIKE '%wish%'
              OR LOWER(COALESCE(t."shopify_none", '')) LIKE '%wish%'
              OR LOWER(COALESCE(t."is_wish_owned", '')) LIKE '%wish%'
             THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wish_labeled
  FROM hive.analytics.daily_rev_tahoe t
  CROSS JOIN bounds b
  WHERE t."dt" >= b.month_start
    AND t."dt" < b.next_month_start
    AND t."currency" = 'USD'
  GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4
)
SELECT
  CASE WHEN GROUPING(d.dt) = 1 THEN 'MONTH_TOTAL' ELSE d.dt END AS dt,
  SUM(d.price_before_promotions + d.shipping_before_promotions) AS gmv_usd,
  SUM(d.net_amount) AS net_gmv_usd,
  SUM(d.refund_amount) AS refund_usd,
  COUNT(DISTINCT d.order_id) AS order_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT d.transaction_id) AS transaction_count,
  COUNT(*) AS line_rows,
  SUM(d.quantity) AS units,
  SUM(d.wish_labeled) AS rows_with_wish_label,
  COUNT(DISTINCT d.shipping_country) AS n_shipping_country,
  COUNT(DISTINCT d.country_code) AS n_country_code,
  COUNT(DISTINCT d.merchant_country) AS n_merchant_country,
  COUNT(DISTINCT d.payment_method) AS n_payment_method,
  MAX(b.as_of_date) AS as_of_date
FROM base d
CROSS JOIN bounds b
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((d.dt), ())
ORDER BY 1 NULLS LAST

reasons.deny-halt: 若现有模型都无法可靠识别 Wish 且 GMV 口径无法验证，请停止执行，以免输出错误 SQL。
reasons.dryrun: 若你只需预览日期逻辑和 SQL 而暂不保存配置，选择试运行即可。

reasons.approve: SQL 用 current_date 推导上一个完整自然月、限定 currency='USD'、按 transaction_id+order_id+variation_id 去重后按 dt 出每日 GMV 并带 MONTH_TOTAL 汇总，同时把各候选维度列的取值基数一并返回用于确认口径，可直接执行。
reasons.deny-comments: 若你希望把口径改成按 order_approved_time 的太平洋业务日切分，或把退款/取消单也折算进 GMV，请在批准前留言指出，我再改写。
reasons.deny-halt: 如果这轮只需要确定日期区间和字段可用性、不打算出数，在这里中止是合理的。
reasons.dryrun: 建议先 dryrun 验证月度 GMV 量级与各维度基数（shipping_country / country_code / payment_method 等）是否符合预期，再正式跑数。

approved_cards.name: daily_rev_tahoe
approved_cards.cte:
{{ config(
    materialized='view'
) }}

{#
  Thin Semantic Layer wrapper over analytics.daily_rev_tahoe.
  Grain: one row per approved commerce line (transaction_id, order_id, variation_id).
  Business revenue day: order_approved_time in America/Los_Angeles (order_approved_day).
  Partition dt is the Hive load batch key — filter for pruning, not business dating alone.
#}

select
    concat(rev.transaction_id, '|', rev.order_id, '|', rev.variation_id) as daily_rev_line_id,

    rev.transaction_id,
    rev.order_id,
    rev.variation_id,
    rev.user_id,
    rev.product_id,
    rev.merchant_id,
    rev.payment_id,
    rev.refund_transaction_id,

    cast(
        date_format(from_unixtime(rev.order_approved_time, 'America/Los_Angeles'), '%Y-%m-%d')
        as date
    ) as order_approved_day,
    cast(rev.dt as date) as dt,
    cast(rev.confirmed_date as date) as confirmed_ship_day,
    cast(
        date_format(from_unixtime(rev.transaction_time, 'America/Los_Angeles'), '%Y-%m-%d')
        as date
    ) as transaction_day,

    cast(from_unixtime(rev.transaction_time) as timestamp) as transaction_ts,
    cast(from_unixtime(rev.shipped_date) as timestamp) as shipped_ts,
    cast(from_unixtime(rev.merchant_payment_time) as timestamp) as merchant_payment_ts,
    cast(from_unixtime(rev.refunded_time) as timestamp) as refunded_ts,
    rev.transaction_time,
    rev.order_approved_time,
    rev.shipped_date,
    rev.merchant_payment_time,
    rev.refunded_time,

    rev.country_code,
    rev.country_state,
    rev.shipping_country,
    rev.shipping_state,
    rev.merchant_country,
    rev.currency,
    rev.merchant_source_currency,
    rev.conversion_rate,

    rev.payment_method,
    rev.transaction_state,
    case rev.transaction_state
        when 0 then 'Pending'
        when 1 then 'Approved'
        when 2 then 'Acknowledged'
        when 3 then 'Shipped'
        when 4 then 'Declined'
        when 5 then 'Refunded'
        when 6 then 'C2C On Delivery'
        when 7 then 'C2C Delivered'
        when 8 then 'C2C Accepted'
        when 10 then 'Exception'
        when 11 then 'Gift Waiting For Accept'
        when 12 then 'Require Review'
        when 13 then 'Delaying'
        when 14 then 'Label Generated'
        when 15 then 'Label Downloaded'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as transaction_state_name,
    rev.order_state,
    case rev.order_state
        when 0 then 'Pending'
        when 1 then 'Approved'
        when 2 then 'Acknowledged'
        when 3 then 'Shipped'
        when 4 then 'Declined'
        when 5 then 'Refunded'
        when 6 then 'C2C On Delivery'
        when 7 then 'C2C Delivered'
        when 8 then 'C2C Accepted'
        when 10 then 'Exception'
        when 11 then 'Gift Waiting For Accept'
        when 12 then 'Require Review'
        when 13 then 'Delaying'
        when 14 then 'Label Generated'
        when 15 then 'Label Downloaded'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as order_state_name,

    rev.is_cancelled,
    rev.is_wish_owned,
    rev.is_wish_express,
    rev.is_free_gift,
    rev.is_bnpl,
    rev.original_category,
    rev.updated_category,
    rev.cancelretry_ind,
    rev.fbs_purchase,
    rev.fbs_sale,
    rev.shopify_none,
    rev.is_eea,
    rev.is_fusion_resale,
    rev.is_unity_order,
    rev.is_unity_order_and_payment_enabled,

    rev.quantity,
    rev.price_before_promotions,
    rev.shipping_before_promotions,
    rev.price_before_promotions + rev.shipping_before_promotions as gmv,
    rev.flat_rate_shipping,
    rev.giftcard_amount,
    rev.discount_amount,
    rev.tax_amount,
    rev.tax_fee,
    rev.net_amount,
    rev.wishcash_usage,
    rev.retail_delivery_fee_amount,

    rev.merchant_price,
    rev.merchant_shipping,
    rev.localized_paid_merchant,
    rev.paid_merchant_usd,
    rev.merchant_shipping_cost,
    rev.localized_merchant_shipping_cost,
    rev.merchant_cost,
    rev.localized_merchant_cost,
    rev.localized_merchant_eat_cost_amount,
    rev.merchant_eat_cost_amount_usd,
    rev.tax_cost,
    rev.merchant_tax_paid_usd,
    rev.merchant_tax_merch_eat_usd,
    rev.merchant_tax_amount_usd,
    rev.localized_merchant_tax_amount,
    rev.localized_merchant_tax_paid,
    rev.localized_merchant_tax_merch_eat,
    rev.tbd_remit_amount,

    rev.refund_amount,
    rev.localized_refund_amount,

    rev.original_full_cost_no_rebate_usd,
    rev.localized_original_full_cost_no_rebate,
    rev.localized_unity_wishpost_shipping,
    rev.unity_wishpost_shipping,
    rev.localized_initial_wishpost_shipping_amount,
    rev.initial_wishpost_shipping_amount,
    rev.localized_wishpost_shipping,
    rev.wishpost_shipping,
    rev.localized_wishpost_shipping_cost,
    rev.wishpost_shipping_cost,
    rev.localized_total_cost,
    rev.total_cost,
    rev.localized_full_cost_no_rebate_for_aplus,
    rev.full_cost_no_rebate_for_aplus_usd,
    rev.localized_full_cost_for_aplus,
    rev.full_cost_for_aplus,

    rev.original_rev_share,
    rev.updated_rev_share,

    rev.net_amount
        - rev.paid_merchant_usd
        - rev.merchant_eat_cost_amount_usd
        - rev.tax_cost
        - rev.merchant_tax_paid_usd
        - rev.merchant_tax_merch_eat_usd as commission_revenue
from {{ source('analytics', 'daily_rev_tahoe') }} as rev
