approved_cards.usage: Filter metric_time / dt first for partition pruning. Use order_approved_day for LA revenue recognition; transaction_day for checkout analysis. GMV = price_before_promotions + shipping_before_promotions; net GMV = net_amount. Commission = net − paid_merchant − MEC − tax components. Dedupe on grain keys before summing when append duplicates are suspected.
approved_cards.description: Order-item (variation) grain daily revenue fact for approved Wish marketplace commerce lines. Grain is one row per (transaction_id, order_id, variation_id) sourced from wish.fact_trans_detail with USD-normalized financials and cart-level amounts prorated to merchant-order lines. Excludes PENDING, DECLINED, and EXCEPTION item states at load time. Business revenue day is America/Los_Angeles date from order_approved_time (order_approved_day); Hive partition dt is the load batch end date — filter dt for pruning and order_approved_day for reporting. Duplicate rows can exist across append loads; dedupe before aggregates when sums must reconcile. Source: analytics.daily_rev_tahoe (Airflow DAG DailyRevTahoeNew).
approved_cards.selection_notes: Wish 上个月 GMV 主表：dt 分区，GMV = price_before_promotions + shipping_before_promotions（USD），按 transaction_id+order_id+variation_id 去重。

approved_cards.name: order_level
approved_cards.cte:
{{ config(
    materialized='view'
) }}

{#
  Thin Semantic Layer wrapper over bi.order_level.
  Grain: one row per merchant order (m_transaction_id) within partition dt.
  Source: Airflow DAG bi_order_level (daily 06:00 America/Los_Angeles).
#}

select
    concat(ol.m_transaction_id, '|', ol.dt) as order_level_id,

    ol.m_transaction_id,
    ol.transaction_id,
    ol.variation_id,
    ol.user_id,
    ol.merchant_id,
    ol.product_id,
    ol.tracking_id,

    ol.client,
    case ol.client
        when 'web' then 'Web'
        when 'iosapp' then 'iOS App'
        when 'androidapp' then 'Android App'
        when 'mobileweb' then 'Mobile Web'
        when 'Other' then 'Other'
        else ol.client
    end as client_name,

    ol.payment_method,

    ol.fulfilled,
    case ol.fulfilled
        when 1 then 'Confirmed shipped'
        when 0 then 'Not confirmed shipped'
        else cast(ol.fulfilled as varchar)
    end as fulfilled_name,

    ol.order_flat_rate_eligible,
    case ol.order_flat_rate_eligible
        when 1 then 'Eligible'
        when 0 then 'Not eligible'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as order_flat_rate_eligible_name,

    ol.order_flat_rate_qualified,
    case ol.order_flat_rate_qualified
        when 1 then 'Qualified'
        when 0 then 'Not qualified'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as order_flat_rate_qualified_name,

    ol.delivery_program,

    ol.wishpost_data_mature,
    case ol.wishpost_data_mature
        when 1 then 'Mature'
        when 0 then 'Immature'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as wishpost_data_mature_name,

    ol.refund_data_mature,
    case ol.refund_data_mature
        when 1 then 'Mature'
        when 0 then 'Immature'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as refund_data_mature_name,

    ol.is_pb,
    case ol.is_pb
        when 1 then 'Product Boost'
        when 0 then 'Not Product Boost'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as is_pb_name,

    ol.is_currently_bd_managed,
    case ol.is_currently_bd_managed
        when 1 then 'BD managed'
        when 0 then 'General support'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as is_currently_bd_managed_name,

    cast(ol.dt as date) as dt,
    cast(ol.transaction_dt as date) as transaction_dt,
    cast(ol.order_approved_dt as date) as order_approved_dt,
    cast(ol.refund_dt as date) as refund_dt,

    ol.buyer_lifecycle,
    ol.touch_event,
    ol.channel,
    ol.wss_tier,
    ol.shipping_country,
    ol.region,
    case upper(ol.region)
        when 'APAC' then 'Asia-Pacific'
        when 'LATAM' then 'Latin America'
        when 'MEA' then 'Middle East & Africa'
        when 'NWE' then 'Northern/Western Europe'
        when 'SEE' then 'Southern/Eastern Europe'
        when 'USCAN' then 'United States and Canada'
        else ol.region
    end as region_name,
    ol.country_name,
    ol.merchant_country,
    ol.merchant_country_group,
    ol.most_recent_bd_rep,

    ol.refund_reason_category,
    ol.md_refund_reason,
    ol.refund_type,

    ol.item_price,
    ol.gmv,
    ol.mkpl_revenue,
    ol.quantity,
    ol.discount_amount,
    ol.gross_gmv,
    ol.net_gmv,
    ol.total_shipping_paid_by_consumer,
    ol.refund_amount,
    ol.wishpost_sales_usd,
    ol.wishpost_costs_usd
from {{ source('bi', 'order_level') }} as ol

approved_cards.usage: Filter metric_time / dt first for partition pruning. Commerce GMV on dt uses payment-received day from fct_transaction_variations; finance gross_gmv / net_gmv align with order_approved_dt (LA). WishPost logistics in daily_finance_metrics groups by order_approved_dt, not dt. Use refund_data_mature = 1 for stable refund rates; wishpost_data_mature = 1 for stable logistics P&L. gmv ≠ gross_gmv — different definitions.
approved_cards.description: BI source-of-truth order fact at merchant-transaction grain (m_transaction_id). Each row is one merchant order enriched with fulfillment, flat-rate shipping flags, WishPost logistics P&L, refund reason labels, buyer lifecycle / marketing attribution, Wish Standards (WSS) tier, buyer geo, merchant BD mapping, finance GMV components, and Product Boost attribution. Deduplicated from variation-level commerce to one row per m_transaction_id within partition dt (payment-received day, America/Los_Angeles). Daily refresh overwrites last 100 calendar days. LTD products excluded upstream. gmv is variation commerce GMV; gross_gmv and net_gmv are finance-spine definitions from daily_rev_tahoe. Source: bi.order_level (Airflow DAG bi_order_level).
approved_cards.selection_notes: 候选/交叉核对：BI 订单粒度事实表，含 client/client_name 与 gmv 口径。

reasons.approve: 你可以选择 approve，因为 daily_rev_tahoe 已覆盖 dt、Wish、USD、GMV 组成字段及去重键，足以生成并执行所需汇总 SQL。
reasons.deny-comments: 若当前字段清单未明确包含 order_id、transaction_id 或 Wish 字段，应选择 deny-comments 以便补齐字段或改选模型。
reasons.deny-halt: 只有在你认为无需生成或执行 SQL、仅停止本轮即可满足需求时，才应选择 deny-halt。
reasons.dryrun: 若你只想预览完整纯文本结果与 SQL 而不保存配置，可选择 dryrun；否则应正式执行并批准。

approved_cards.name: daily_rev_tahoe
approved_cards.cte:
{{ config(
    materialized='view'
) }}

{#
  Thin Semantic Layer wrapper over analytics.daily_rev_tahoe.
  Grain: one row per approved commerce line (transaction_id, order_id, variation_id).
  Business revenue day: order_approved_time in America/Los_Angeles (order_approved_day).
  Partition dt is the Hive load batch key — filter for pruning, not business dating alone.
#}

select
    concat(rev.transaction_id, '|', rev.order_id, '|', rev.variation_id) as daily_rev_line_id,

    rev.transaction_id,
    rev.order_id,
    rev.variation_id,
    rev.user_id,
    rev.product_id,
    rev.merchant_id,
    rev.payment_id,
    rev.refund_transaction_id,

    cast(
        date_format(from_unixtime(rev.order_approved_time, 'America/Los_Angeles'), '%Y-%m-%d')
        as date
    ) as order_approved_day,
    cast(rev.dt as date) as dt,
    cast(rev.confirmed_date as date) as confirmed_ship_day,
    cast(
        date_format(from_unixtime(rev.transaction_time, 'America/Los_Angeles'), '%Y-%m-%d')
        as date
    ) as transaction_day,

    cast(from_unixtime(rev.transaction_time) as timestamp) as transaction_ts,
    cast(from_unixtime(rev.shipped_date) as timestamp) as shipped_ts,
    cast(from_unixtime(rev.merchant_payment_time) as timestamp) as merchant_payment_ts,
    cast(from_unixtime(rev.refunded_time) as timestamp) as refunded_ts,
    rev.transaction_time,
    rev.order_approved_time,
    rev.shipped_date,
    rev.merchant_payment_time,
    rev.refunded_time,

    rev.country_code,
    rev.country_state,
    rev.shipping_country,
    rev.shipping_state,
    rev.merchant_country,
    rev.currency,
    rev.merchant_source_currency,
    rev.conversion_rate,

    rev.payment_method,
    rev.transaction_state,
    case rev.transaction_state
        when 0 then 'Pending'
        when 1 then 'Approved'
        when 2 then 'Acknowledged'
        when 3 then 'Shipped'
        when 4 then 'Declined'
        when 5 then 'Refunded'
        when 6 then 'C2C On Delivery'
        when 7 then 'C2C Delivered'
        when 8 then 'C2C Accepted'
        when 10 then 'Exception'
        when 11 then 'Gift Waiting For Accept'
        when 12 then 'Require Review'
        when 13 then 'Delaying'
        when 14 then 'Label Generated'
        when 15 then 'Label Downloaded'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as transaction_state_name,
    rev.order_state,
    case rev.order_state
        when 0 then 'Pending'
        when 1 then 'Approved'
        when 2 then 'Acknowledged'
        when 3 then 'Shipped'
        when 4 then 'Declined'
        when 5 then 'Refunded'
        when 6 then 'C2C On Delivery'
        when 7 then 'C2C Delivered'
        when 8 then 'C2C Accepted'
        when 10 then 'Exception'
        when 11 then 'Gift Waiting For Accept'
        when 12 then 'Require Review'
        when 13 then 'Delaying'
        when 14 then 'Label Generated'
        when 15 then 'Label Downloaded'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as order_state_name,

    rev.is_cancelled,
    rev.is_wish_owned,
    rev.is_wish_express,
    rev.is_free_gift,
    rev.is_bnpl,
    rev.original_category,
    rev.updated_category,
    rev.cancelretry_ind,
    rev.fbs_purchase,
    rev.fbs_sale,
    rev.shopify_none,
    rev.is_eea,
    rev.is_fusion_resale,
    rev.is_unity_order,
    rev.is_unity_order_and_payment_enabled,

    rev.quantity,
    rev.price_before_promotions,
    rev.shipping_before_promotions,
    rev.price_before_promotions + rev.shipping_before_promotions as gmv,
    rev.flat_rate_shipping,
    rev.giftcard_amount,
    rev.discount_amount,
    rev.tax_amount,
    rev.tax_fee,
    rev.net_amount,
    rev.wishcash_usage,
    rev.retail_delivery_fee_amount,

    rev.merchant_price,
    rev.merchant_shipping,
    rev.localized_paid_merchant,
    rev.paid_merchant_usd,
    rev.merchant_shipping_cost,
    rev.localized_merchant_shipping_cost,
    rev.merchant_cost,
    rev.localized_merchant_cost,
    rev.localized_merchant_eat_cost_amount,
    rev.merchant_eat_cost_amount_usd,
    rev.tax_cost,
    rev.merchant_tax_paid_usd,
    rev.merchant_tax_merch_eat_usd,
    rev.merchant_tax_amount_usd,
    rev.localized_merchant_tax_amount,
    rev.localized_merchant_tax_paid,
    rev.localized_merchant_tax_merch_eat,
    rev.tbd_remit_amount,

    rev.refund_amount,
    rev.localized_refund_amount,

    rev.original_full_cost_no_rebate_usd,
    rev.localized_original_full_cost_no_rebate,
    rev.localized_unity_wishpost_shipping,
    rev.unity_wishpost_shipping,
    rev.localized_initial_wishpost_shipping_amount,
    rev.initial_wishpost_shipping_amount,
    rev.localized_wishpost_shipping,
    rev.wishpost_shipping,
    rev.localized_wishpost_shipping_cost,
    rev.wishpost_shipping_cost,
    rev.localized_total_cost,
    rev.total_cost,
    rev.localized_full_cost_no_rebate_for_aplus,
    rev.full_cost_no_rebate_for_aplus_usd,
    rev.localized_full_cost_for_aplus,
    rev.full_cost_for_aplus,

    rev.original_rev_share,
    rev.updated_rev_share,

    rev.net_amount
        - rev.paid_merchant_usd
        - rev.merchant_eat_cost_amount_usd
        - rev.tax_cost
        - rev.merchant_tax_paid_usd
        - rev.merchant_tax_merch_eat_usd as commission_revenue
from {{ source('analytics', 'daily_rev_tahoe') }} as rev

approved_cards.usage: Filter metric_time / dt first for partition pruning. Use order_approved_day for LA revenue recognition; transaction_day for checkout analysis. GMV = price_before_promotions + shipping_before_promotions; net GMV = net_amount. Commission = net − paid_merchant − MEC − tax components. Dedupe on grain keys before summing when append duplicates are suspected.
approved_cards.description: Order-item (variation) grain daily revenue fact for approved Wish marketplace commerce lines. Grain is one row per (transaction_id, order_id, variation_id) sourced from wish.fact_trans_detail with USD-normalized financials and cart-level amounts prorated to merchant-order lines. Excludes PENDING, DECLINED, and EXCEPTION item states at load time. Business revenue day is America/Los_Angeles date from order_approved_time (order_approved_day); Hive partition dt is the load batch end date — filter dt for pruning and order_approved_day for reporting. Duplicate rows can exist across append loads; dedupe before aggregates when sums must reconcile. Source: analytics.daily_rev_tahoe (Airflow DAG DailyRevTahoeNew).
approved_cards.selection_notes: Wish 上个月 GMV 主表：dt 分区，GMV = price_before_promotions + shipping_before_promotions（USD），按 transaction_id+order_id+variation_id 去重。

{#
  Thin Semantic Layer wrapper over bi.order_level.
  Grain: one row per merchant order (m_transaction_id) within partition dt.
  Source: Airflow DAG bi_order_level (daily 06:00 America/Los_Angeles).
#}

select
    concat(ol.m_transaction_id, '|', ol.dt) as order_level_id,

    ol.m_transaction_id,
    ol.transaction_id,
    ol.variation_id,
    ol.user_id,
    ol.merchant_id,
    ol.product_id,
    ol.tracking_id,

    ol.client,
    case ol.client
        when 'web' then 'Web'
        when 'iosapp' then 'iOS App'
        when 'androidapp' then 'Android App'
        when 'mobileweb' then 'Mobile Web'
        when 'Other' then 'Other'
        else ol.client
    end as client_name,

    ol.payment_method,

    ol.fulfilled,
    case ol.fulfilled
        when 1 then 'Confirmed shipped'
        when 0 then 'Not confirmed shipped'
        else cast(ol.fulfilled as varchar)
    end as fulfilled_name,

    ol.order_flat_rate_eligible,
    case ol.order_flat_rate_eligible
        when 1 then 'Eligible'
        when 0 then 'Not eligible'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as order_flat_rate_eligible_name,

    ol.order_flat_rate_qualified,
    case ol.order_flat_rate_qualified
        when 1 then 'Qualified'
        when 0 then 'Not qualified'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as order_flat_rate_qualified_name,

    ol.delivery_program,

    ol.wishpost_data_mature,
    case ol.wishpost_data_mature
        when 1 then 'Mature'
        when 0 then 'Immature'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as wishpost_data_mature_name,

    ol.refund_data_mature,
    case ol.refund_data_mature
        when 1 then 'Mature'
        when 0 then 'Immature'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as refund_data_mature_name,

    ol.is_pb,
    case ol.is_pb
        when 1 then 'Product Boost'
        when 0 then 'Not Product Boost'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as is_pb_name,

    ol.is_currently_bd_managed,
    case ol.is_currently_bd_managed
        when 1 then 'BD managed'
        when 0 then 'General support'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as is_currently_bd_managed_name,

    cast(ol.dt as date) as dt,
    cast(ol.transaction_dt as date) as transaction_dt,
    cast(ol.order_approved_dt as date) as order_approved_dt,
    cast(ol.refund_dt as date) as refund_dt,

    ol.buyer_lifecycle,
    ol.touch_event,
    ol.channel,
    ol.wss_tier,
    ol.shipping_country,
    ol.region,
    case upper(ol.region)
        when 'APAC' then 'Asia-Pacific'
        when 'LATAM' then 'Latin America'
        when 'MEA' then 'Middle East & Africa'
        when 'NWE' then 'Northern/Western Europe'
        when 'SEE' then 'Southern/Eastern Europe'
        when 'USCAN' then 'United States and Canada'
        else ol.region
    end as region_name,
    ol.country_name,
    ol.merchant_country,
    ol.merchant_country_group,
    ol.most_recent_bd_rep,

    ol.refund_reason_category,
    ol.md_refund_reason,
    ol.refund_type,

    ol.item_price,
    ol.gmv,
    ol.mkpl_revenue,
    ol.quantity,
    ol.discount_amount,
    ol.gross_gmv,
    ol.net_gmv,
    ol.total_shipping_paid_by_consumer,
    ol.refund_amount,
    ol.wishpost_sales_usd,
    ol.wishpost_costs_usd
from {{ source('bi', 'order_level') }} as ol

approved_cards.usage: Filter metric_time / dt first for partition pruning. Commerce GMV on dt uses payment-received day from fct_transaction_variations; finance gross_gmv / net_gmv align with order_approved_dt (LA). WishPost logistics in daily_finance_metrics groups by order_approved_dt, not dt. Use refund_data_mature = 1 for stable refund rates; wishpost_data_mature = 1 for stable logistics P&L. gmv ≠ gross_gmv — different definitions.
approved_cards.description: BI source-of-truth order fact at merchant-transaction grain (m_transaction_id). Each row is one merchant order enriched with fulfillment, flat-rate shipping flags, WishPost logistics P&L, refund reason labels, buyer lifecycle / marketing attribution, Wish Standards (WSS) tier, buyer geo, merchant BD mapping, finance GMV components, and Product Boost attribution. Deduplicated from variation-level commerce to one row per m_transaction_id within partition dt (payment-received day, America/Los_Angeles). Daily refresh overwrites last 100 calendar days. LTD products excluded upstream. gmv is variation commerce GMV; gross_gmv and net_gmv are finance-spine definitions from daily_rev_tahoe. Source: bi.order_level (Airflow DAG bi_order_level).
approved_cards.selection_notes: 候选/交叉核对：BI 订单粒度事实表，含 client/client_name 与 gmv 口径。

approved_sql:
WITH bounds AS (
  SELECT
    format_datetime(CAST(date_trunc('month', CAST(current_date - INTERVAL '1' MONTH AS DATE)) AS TIMESTAMP), 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS month_start,
    format_datetime(CAST(date_trunc('month', CAST(current_date AS DATE)) AS TIMESTAMP), 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS next_month_start,
    CAST(current_date AS VARCHAR) AS as_of_date
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    t."dt" AS dt,
    t."currency" AS currency,
    t."merchant_source_currency" AS merchant_source_currency,
    t."transaction_id" AS transaction_id,
    t."order_id" AS order_id,
    t."variation_id" AS variation_id,
    MAX(t."price_before_promotions") AS price_before_promotions,
    MAX(t."shipping_before_promotions") AS shipping_before_promotions,
    MAX(t."net_amount") AS net_amount,
    MAX(t."refund_amount") AS refund_amount,
    MAX(t."quantity") AS quantity
  FROM hive.analytics.daily_rev_tahoe t
  CROSS JOIN bounds b
  WHERE t."dt" >= b.month_start
    AND t."dt" < b.next_month_start
  GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6
)
SELECT
  'DAILY' AS row_type,
  dt AS period,
  currency,
  merchant_source_currency,
  SUM(price_before_promotions + shipping_before_promotions) AS gmv,
  SUM(net_amount) AS net_gmv,
  SUM(refund_amount) AS refund_amount,
  COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS distinct_order_id,
  COUNT(DISTINCT transaction_id) AS distinct_transaction_id,
  COUNT(*) AS line_rows,
  SUM(quantity) AS units
FROM base
GROUP BY dt, currency, merchant_source_currency

UNION ALL

SELECT
  'MONTH_BY_CURRENCY_COMBO',
  MAX(b.month_start),
  currency,
  merchant_source_currency,
  SUM(price_before_promotions + shipping_before_promotions),
  SUM(net_amount),
  SUM(refund_amount),
  COUNT(DISTINCT order_id),
  COUNT(DISTINCT transaction_id),
  COUNT(*),
  SUM(quantity)
FROM base
CROSS JOIN bounds b
GROUP BY currency, merchant_source_currency

UNION ALL

SELECT
  'MONTH_TOTAL_ALL',
  MAX(b.month_start),
  'ALL',
  'ALL',
  SUM(price_before_promotions + shipping_before_promotions),
  SUM(net_amount),
  SUM(refund_amount),
  COUNT(DISTINCT order_id),
  COUNT(DISTINCT transaction_id),
  COUNT(*),
  SUM(quantity)
FROM base
CROSS JOIN bounds b

UNION ALL

SELECT
  'MONTH_TOTAL_USD',
  MAX(b.month_start),
  'USD',
  'USD',
  SUM(price_before_promotions + shipping_before_promotions),
  SUM(net_amount),
  SUM(refund_amount),
  COUNT(DISTINCT order_id),
  COUNT(DISTINCT transaction_id),
  COUNT(*),
  SUM(quantity)
FROM base
CROSS JOIN bounds b
WHERE currency = 'USD'

ORDER BY 1, 2, 3, 4

approved_cards.name: daily_rev_tahoe
approved_cards.cte:
{{ config(
    materialized='view'
) }}

{#
  Thin Semantic Layer wrapper over analytics.daily_rev_tahoe.
  Grain: one row per approved commerce line (transaction_id, order_id, variation_id).
  Business revenue day: order_approved_time in America/Los_Angeles (order_approved_day).
  Partition dt is the Hive load batch key — filter for pruning, not business dating alone.
#}

select
    concat(rev.transaction_id, '|', rev.order_id, '|', rev.variation_id) as daily_rev_line_id,

    rev.transaction_id,
    rev.order_id,
    rev.variation_id,
    rev.user_id,
    rev.product_id,
    rev.merchant_id,
    rev.payment_id,
    rev.refund_transaction_id,

    cast(
        date_format(from_unixtime(rev.order_approved_time, 'America/Los_Angeles'), '%Y-%m-%d')
        as date
    ) as order_approved_day,
    cast(rev.dt as date) as dt,
    cast(rev.confirmed_date as date) as confirmed_ship_day,
    cast(
        date_format(from_unixtime(rev.transaction_time, 'America/Los_Angeles'), '%Y-%m-%d')
        as date
    ) as transaction_day,

    cast(from_unixtime(rev.transaction_time) as timestamp) as transaction_ts,
    cast(from_unixtime(rev.shipped_date) as timestamp) as shipped_ts,
    cast(from_unixtime(rev.merchant_payment_time) as timestamp) as merchant_payment_ts,
    cast(from_unixtime(rev.refunded_time) as timestamp) as refunded_ts,
    rev.transaction_time,
    rev.order_approved_time,
    rev.shipped_date,
    rev.merchant_payment_time,
    rev.refunded_time,

    rev.country_code,
    rev.country_state,
    rev.shipping_country,
    rev.shipping_state,
    rev.merchant_country,
    rev.currency,
    rev.merchant_source_currency,
    rev.conversion_rate,

    rev.payment_method,
    rev.transaction_state,
    case rev.transaction_state
        when 0 then 'Pending'
        when 1 then 'Approved'
        when 2 then 'Acknowledged'
        when 3 then 'Shipped'
        when 4 then 'Declined'
        when 5 then 'Refunded'
        when 6 then 'C2C On Delivery'
        when 7 then 'C2C Delivered'
        when 8 then 'C2C Accepted'
        when 10 then 'Exception'
        when 11 then 'Gift Waiting For Accept'
        when 12 then 'Require Review'
        when 13 then 'Delaying'
        when 14 then 'Label Generated'
        when 15 then 'Label Downloaded'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as transaction_state_name,
    rev.order_state,
    case rev.order_state
        when 0 then 'Pending'
        when 1 then 'Approved'
        when 2 then 'Acknowledged'
        when 3 then 'Shipped'
        when 4 then 'Declined'
        when 5 then 'Refunded'
        when 6 then 'C2C On Delivery'
        when 7 then 'C2C Delivered'
        when 8 then 'C2C Accepted'
        when 10 then 'Exception'
        when 11 then 'Gift Waiting For Accept'
        when 12 then 'Require Review'
        when 13 then 'Delaying'
        when 14 then 'Label Generated'
        when 15 then 'Label Downloaded'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as order_state_name,

    rev.is_cancelled,
    rev.is_wish_owned,
    rev.is_wish_express,
    rev.is_free_gift,
    rev.is_bnpl,
    rev.original_category,
    rev.updated_category,
    rev.cancelretry_ind,
    rev.fbs_purchase,
    rev.fbs_sale,

approved_cards.usage: Filter metric_time / dt first for partition pruning. Use order_approved_day for LA revenue recognition; transaction_day for checkout analysis. GMV = price_before_promotions + shipping_before_promotions; net GMV = net_amount. Commission = net − paid_merchant − MEC − tax components. Dedupe on grain keys before summing when append duplicates are suspected.
approved_cards.description: Order-item (variation) grain daily revenue fact for approved Wish marketplace commerce lines. Grain is one row per (transaction_id, order_id, variation_id) sourced from wish.fact_trans_detail with USD-normalized financials and cart-level amounts prorated to merchant-order lines. Excludes PENDING, DECLINED, and EXCEPTION item states at load time. Business revenue day is America/Los_Angeles date from order_approved_time (order_approved_day); Hive partition dt is the load batch end date — filter dt for pruning and order_approved_day for reporting. Duplicate rows can exist across append loads; dedupe before aggregates when sums must reconcile. Source: analytics.daily_rev_tahoe (Airflow DAG DailyRevTahoeNew).
approved_cards.selection_notes: Wish 上个月 GMV 主表：dt 分区，GMV = price_before_promotions + shipping_before_promotions（currency='USD'），按 transaction_id+order_id+variation_id 去重；渠道/业务线候选字段在表内逐个验证取值清单。

approved_cards.cte:
{{ config(
    materialized='view'

{#
  Thin Semantic Layer wrapper over bi.order_level.
  Grain: one row per merchant order (m_transaction_id) within partition dt.
  Source: Airflow DAG bi_order_level (daily 06:00 America/Los_Angeles).
#}

select
    concat(ol.m_transaction_id, '|', ol.dt) as order_level_id,

    ol.m_transaction_id,
    ol.transaction_id,
    ol.variation_id,
    ol.user_id,
    ol.merchant_id,
    ol.product_id,
    ol.tracking_id,

    ol.client,
    case ol.client
        when 'web' then 'Web'
        when 'iosapp' then 'iOS App'
        when 'androidapp' then 'Android App'
        when 'mobileweb' then 'Mobile Web'
        when 'Other' then 'Other'
        else ol.client
    end as client_name,

    ol.payment_method,

    ol.fulfilled,
    case ol.fulfilled
        when 1 then 'Confirmed shipped'
        when 0 then 'Not confirmed shipped'
        else cast(ol.fulfilled as varchar)
    end as fulfilled_name,

    ol.order_flat_rate_eligible,
    case ol.order_flat_rate_eligible
        when 1 then 'Eligible'
        when 0 then 'Not eligible'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as order_flat_rate_eligible_name,

    ol.order_flat_rate_qualified,
    case ol.order_flat_rate_qualified
        when 1 then 'Qualified'
        when 0 then 'Not qualified'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as order_flat_rate_qualified_name,

    ol.delivery_program,

    ol.wishpost_data_mature,
    case ol.wishpost_data_mature
        when 1 then 'Mature'
        when 0 then 'Immature'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as wishpost_data_mature_name,

    ol.refund_data_mature,
    case ol.refund_data_mature
        when 1 then 'Mature'
        when 0 then 'Immature'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as refund_data_mature_name,

    ol.is_pb,
    case ol.is_pb
        when 1 then 'Product Boost'
        when 0 then 'Not Product Boost'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as is_pb_name,

    ol.is_currently_bd_managed,
    case ol.is_currently_bd_managed
        when 1 then 'BD managed'
        when 0 then 'General support'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as is_currently_bd_managed_name,

    cast(ol.dt as date) as dt,
    cast(ol.transaction_dt as date) as transaction_dt,
    cast(ol.order_approved_dt as date) as order_approved_dt,
    cast(ol.refund_dt as date) as refund_dt,

    ol.buyer_lifecycle,
    ol.touch_event,
    ol.channel,
    ol.wss_tier,
    ol.shipping_country,
    ol.region,
    case upper(ol.region)
        when 'APAC' then 'Asia-Pacific'
        when 'LATAM' then 'Latin America'
        when 'MEA' then 'Middle East & Africa'
        when 'NWE' then 'Northern/Western Europe'
        when 'SEE' then 'Southern/Eastern Europe'
        when 'USCAN' then 'United States and Canada'
        else ol.region
    end as region_name,
    ol.country_name,
    ol.merchant_country,
    ol.merchant_country_group,
    ol.most_recent_bd_rep,

    ol.refund_reason_category,
    ol.md_refund_reason,
    ol.refund_type,

    ol.item_price,
    ol.gmv,
    ol.mkpl_revenue,
    ol.quantity,
    ol.discount_amount,
    ol.gross_gmv,
    ol.net_gmv,
    ol.total_shipping_paid_by_consumer,
    ol.refund_amount,
    ol.wishpost_sales_usd,
    ol.wishpost_costs_usd
from {{ source('bi', 'order_level') }} as ol

approved_cards.usage: Filter metric_time / dt first for partition pruning. Commerce GMV on dt uses payment-received day from fct_transaction_variations; finance gross_gmv / net_gmv align with order_approved_dt (LA). WishPost logistics in daily_finance_metrics groups by order_approved_dt, not dt. Use refund_data_mature = 1 for stable refund rates; wishpost_data_mature = 1 for stable logistics P&L. gmv ≠ gross_gmv — different definitions.
approved_cards.description: BI source-of-truth order fact at merchant-transaction grain (m_transaction_id). Each row is one merchant order enriched with fulfillment, flat-rate shipping flags, WishPost logistics P&L, refund reason labels, buyer lifecycle / marketing attribution, Wish Standards (WSS) tier, buyer geo, merchant BD mapping, finance GMV components, and Product Boost attribution. Deduplicated from variation-level commerce to one row per m_transaction_id within partition dt (payment-received day, America/Los_Angeles). Daily refresh overwrites last 100 calendar days. LTD products excluded upstream. gmv is variation commerce GMV; gross_gmv and net_gmv are finance-spine definitions from daily_rev_tahoe. Source: bi.order_level (Airflow DAG bi_order_level).

reasons.deny-comments: 若你认为应改用其他模型或明确指定 Wish 渠道字段，请退回评论以调整选择后再执行。
reasons.deny-halt: 若你认定当前无法可靠识别 Wish 渠道且不应产出 SQL，停止并先澄清才合适。

approved_cards.name: daily_rev_tahoe
approved_cards.cte:
{{ config(
    materialized='view'
) }}

{#
  Thin Semantic Layer wrapper over analytics.daily_rev_tahoe.
  Grain: one row per approved commerce line (transaction_id, order_id, variation_id).
  Business revenue day: order_approved_time in America/Los_Angeles (order_approved_day).
  Partition dt is the Hive load batch key — filter for pruning, not business dating alone.
#}

select
    concat(rev.transaction_id, '|', rev.order_id, '|', rev.variation_id) as daily_rev_line_id,

    rev.transaction_id,
    rev.order_id,
    rev.variation_id,
    rev.user_id,
    rev.product_id,
    rev.merchant_id,
    rev.payment_id,
    rev.refund_transaction_id,

    cast(
        date_format(from_unixtime(rev.order_approved_time, 'America/Los_Angeles'), '%Y-%m-%d')
        as date
    ) as order_approved_day,
    cast(rev.dt as date) as dt,
    cast(rev.confirmed_date as date) as confirmed_ship_day,
    cast(
        date_format(from_unixtime(rev.transaction_time, 'America/Los_Angeles'), '%Y-%m-%d')
        as date
    ) as transaction_day,

    cast(from_unixtime(rev.transaction_time) as timestamp) as transaction_ts,
    cast(from_unixtime(rev.shipped_date) as timestamp) as shipped_ts,
    cast(from_unixtime(rev.merchant_payment_time) as timestamp) as merchant_payment_ts,
    cast(from_unixtime(rev.refunded_time) as timestamp) as refunded_ts,
    rev.transaction_time,
    rev.order_approved_time,
    rev.shipped_date,
    rev.merchant_payment_time,
    rev.refunded_time,

    rev.country_code,
    rev.country_state,
    rev.shipping_country,
    rev.shipping_state,
    rev.merchant_country,
    rev.currency,
    rev.merchant_source_currency,
    rev.conversion_rate,

    rev.payment_method,
    rev.transaction_state,
    case rev.transaction_state
        when 0 then 'Pending'
        when 1 then 'Approved'
        when 2 then 'Acknowledged'
        when 3 then 'Shipped'
        when 4 then 'Declined'
        when 5 then 'Refunded'
        when 6 then 'C2C On Delivery'
        when 7 then 'C2C Delivered'
        when 8 then 'C2C Accepted'
        when 10 then 'Exception'
        when 11 then 'Gift Waiting For Accept'
        when 12 then 'Require Review'
        when 13 then 'Delaying'
        when 14 then 'Label Generated'
        when 15 then 'Label Downloaded'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as transaction_state_name,
    rev.order_state,
    case rev.order_state
        when 0 then 'Pending'
        when 1 then 'Approved'
        when 2 then 'Acknowledged'
        when 3 then 'Shipped'
        when 4 then 'Declined'
        when 5 then 'Refunded'
        when 6 then 'C2C On Delivery'
        when 7 then 'C2C Delivered'
        when 8 then 'C2C Accepted'
        when 10 then 'Exception'
        when 11 then 'Gift Waiting For Accept'
        when 12 then 'Require Review'
        when 13 then 'Delaying'
        when 14 then 'Label Generated'
        when 15 then 'Label Downloaded'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as order_state_name,

    rev.is_cancelled,
    rev.is_wish_owned,
    rev.is_wish_express,
    rev.is_free_gift,
    rev.is_bnpl,
    rev.original_category,
    rev.updated_category,
    rev.cancelretry_ind,
    rev.fbs_purchase,
    rev.fbs_sale,
    rev.shopify_none,
    rev.is_eea,
    rev.is_fusion_resale,
    rev.is_unity_order,
    rev.is_unity_order_and_payment_enabled,

    rev.quantity,
    rev.price_before_promotions,
    rev.shipping_before_promotions,
    rev.price_before_promotions + rev.shipping_before_promotions as gmv,
    rev.flat_rate_shipping,
    rev.giftcard_amount,
    rev.discount_amount,
    rev.tax_amount,
    rev.tax_fee,
    rev.net_amount,
    rev.wishcash_usage,
    rev.retail_delivery_fee_amount,

    rev.merchant_price,
    rev.merchant_shipping,
    rev.localized_paid_merchant,
    rev.paid_merchant_usd,
    rev.merchant_shipping_cost,
    rev.localized_merchant_shipping_cost,
    rev.merchant_cost,
    rev.localized_merchant_cost,
    rev.localized_merchant_eat_cost_amount,
    rev.merchant_eat_cost_amount_usd,
    rev.tax_cost,
    rev.merchant_tax_paid_usd,
    rev.merchant_tax_merch_eat_usd,
    rev.merchant_tax_amount_usd,
    rev.localized_merchant_tax_amount,
    rev.localized_merchant_tax_paid,
    rev.localized_merchant_tax_merch_eat,
    rev.tbd_remit_amount,

    rev.refund_amount,
    rev.localized_refund_amount,

    rev.original_full_cost_no_rebate_usd,
    rev.localized_original_full_cost_no_rebate,
    rev.localized_unity_wishpost_shipping,
    rev.unity_wishpost_shipping,
    rev.localized_initial_wishpost_shipping_amount,
    rev.initial_wishpost_shipping_amount,
    rev.localized_wishpost_shipping,
    rev.wishpost_shipping,
    rev.localized_wishpost_shipping_cost,
    rev.wishpost_shipping_cost,
    rev.localized_total_cost,
    rev.total_cost,
    rev.localized_full_cost_no_rebate_for_aplus,
    rev.full_cost_no_rebate_for_aplus_usd,
    rev.localized_full_cost_for_aplus,
    rev.full_cost_for_aplus,

    rev.original_rev_share,
    rev.updated_rev_share,

    rev.net_amount
        - rev.paid_merchant_usd
        - rev.merchant_eat_cost_amount_usd
        - rev.tax_cost
        - rev.merchant_tax_paid_usd
        - rev.merchant_tax_merch_eat_usd as commission_revenue
from {{ source('analytics', 'daily_rev_tahoe') }} as rev

approved_cards.usage: Filter metric_time / dt first for partition pruning. Use order_approved_day for LA revenue recognition; transaction_day for checkout analysis. GMV = price_before_promotions + shipping_before_promotions; net GMV = net_amount. Commission = net − paid_merchant − MEC − tax components. Dedupe on grain keys before summing when append duplicates are suspected.
approved_cards.description: Order-item (variation) grain daily revenue fact for approved Wish marketplace commerce lines. Grain is one row per (transaction_id, order_id, variation_id) sourced from wish.fact_trans_detail with USD-normalized financials and cart-level amounts prorated to merchant-order lines. Excludes PENDING, DECLINED, and EXCEPTION item states at load time. Business revenue day is America/Los_Angeles date from order_approved_time (order_approved_day); Hive partition dt is the load batch end date — filter dt for pruning and order_approved_day for reporting. Duplicate rows can exist across append loads; dedupe before aggregates when sums must reconcile. Source: analytics.daily_rev_tahoe (Airflow DAG DailyRevTahoeNew).
approved_cards.selection_notes: Wish 上个月 GMV 主表：dt 分区，GMV = price_before_promotions + shipping_before_promotions（currency='USD'），按 transaction_id+order_id+variation_id 去重；渠道/业务线候选字段在表内逐个验证取值清单。

approved_cards.name: order_level
approved_cards.cte:
{{ config(
    materialized='view'
) }}

{#
  Thin Semantic Layer wrapper over bi.order_level.
  Grain: one row per merchant order (m_transaction_id) within partition dt.
  Source: Airflow DAG bi_order_level (daily 06:00 America/Los_Angeles).
#}

select
    concat(ol.m_transaction_id, '|', ol.dt) as order_level_id,

    ol.m_transaction_id,
    ol.transaction_id,
    ol.variation_id,
    ol.user_id,
    ol.merchant_id,
    ol.product_id,
    ol.tracking_id,

    ol.client,
    case ol.client
        when 'web' then 'Web'
        when 'iosapp' then 'iOS App'
        when 'androidapp' then 'Android App'
        when 'mobileweb' then 'Mobile Web'
        when 'Other' then 'Other'
        else ol.client
    end as client_name,

    ol.payment_method,

    ol.fulfilled,
    case ol.fulfilled
        when 1 then 'Confirmed shipped'
        when 0 then 'Not confirmed shipped'
        else cast(ol.fulfilled as varchar)
    end as fulfilled_name,

    ol.order_flat_rate_eligible,
    case ol.order_flat_rate_eligible
        when 1 then 'Eligible'
        when 0 then 'Not eligible'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as order_flat_rate_eligible_name,

    ol.order_flat_rate_qualified,
    case ol.order_flat_rate_qualified
        when 1 then 'Qualified'
        when 0 then 'Not qualified'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as order_flat_rate_qualified_name,

    ol.delivery_program,

    ol.wishpost_data_mature,
    case ol.wishpost_data_mature
        when 1 then 'Mature'
        when 0 then 'Immature'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as wishpost_data_mature_name,

    ol.refund_data_mature,
    case ol.refund_data_mature
        when 1 then 'Mature'
        when 0 then 'Immature'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as refund_data_mature_name,

    ol.is_pb,
    case ol.is_pb
        when 1 then 'Product Boost'
        when 0 then 'Not Product Boost'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as is_pb_name,

    ol.is_currently_bd_managed,
    case ol.is_currently_bd_managed
        when 1 then 'BD managed'
        when 0 then 'General support'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as is_currently_bd_managed_name,

    cast(ol.dt as date) as dt,
    cast(ol.transaction_dt as date) as transaction_dt,
    cast(ol.order_approved_dt as date) as order_approved_dt,
    cast(ol.refund_dt as date) as refund_dt,

    ol.buyer_lifecycle,

approved_cards.usage: Filter metric_time / dt first for partition pruning. Commerce GMV on dt uses payment-received day from fct_transaction_variations; finance gross_gmv / net_gmv align with order_approved_dt (LA). WishPost logistics in daily_finance_metrics groups by order_approved_dt, not dt. Use refund_data_mature = 1 for stable refund rates; wishpost_data_mature = 1 for stable logistics P&L. gmv ≠ gross_gmv — different definitions.
approved_cards.description: BI source-of-truth order fact at merchant-transaction grain (m_transaction_id). Each row is one merchant order enriched with fulfillment, flat-rate shipping flags, WishPost logistics P&L, refund reason labels, buyer lifecycle / marketing attribution, Wish Standards (WSS) tier, buyer geo, merchant BD mapping, finance GMV components, and Product Boost attribution. Deduplicated from variation-level commerce to one row per m_transaction_id within partition dt (payment-received day, America/Los_Angeles). Daily refresh overwrites last 100 calendar days. LTD products excluded upstream. gmv is variation commerce GMV; gross_gmv and net_gmv are finance-spine definitions from daily_rev_tahoe. Source: bi.order_level (Airflow DAG bi_order_level).

approved_sql:
WITH bounds AS (
  SELECT
    format_datetime(CAST(date_trunc('month', CAST(current_date - INTERVAL '1' MONTH AS DATE)) AS TIMESTAMP), 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS month_start,
    format_datetime(CAST(date_trunc('month', CAST(current_date AS DATE)) AS TIMESTAMP), 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS next_month_start,
    CAST(current_date AS VARCHAR) AS as_of_date
),
raw AS (
  SELECT
    t."dt" AS dt,
    t."transaction_id" AS transaction_id,
    t."order_id" AS order_id,
    t."variation_id" AS variation_id,
    MAX(t."payment_method") AS payment_method,
    MAX(t."is_wish_express") AS is_wish_express,
    MAX(t."is_wish_owned") AS is_wish_owned,
    MAX(t."is_bnpl") AS is_bnpl,
    MAX(t."is_fusion_resale") AS is_fusion_resale,
    MAX(t."shopify_none") AS shopify_none,
    MAX(t."original_category") AS original_category,
    MAX(t."price_before_promotions") AS price_before_promotions,
    MAX(t."shipping_before_promotions") AS shipping_before_promotions,
    MAX(t."net_amount") AS net_amount,
    MAX(t."refund_amount") AS refund_amount,
    MAX(t."quantity") AS quantity
  FROM hive.analytics.daily_rev_tahoe t
  CROSS JOIN bounds b
  WHERE t."dt" >= b.month_start
    AND t."dt" < b.next_month_start
    AND t."currency" = 'USD'
  GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4
),
daily AS (
  SELECT
    dt,
    SUM(price_before_promotions + shipping_before_promotions) AS gmv_usd,
    SUM(net_amount) AS net_gmv_usd,
    SUM(refund_amount) AS refund_usd,
    COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_cnt,
    COUNT(DISTINCT transaction_id) AS txn_cnt,
    COUNT(*) AS line_rows
  FROM raw
  GROUP BY dt
),
totals AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(price_before_promotions + shipping_before_promotions) AS gmv_usd,
    SUM(net_amount) AS net_gmv_usd,
    SUM(refund_amount) AS refund_usd,
    COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_cnt,
    COUNT(DISTINCT transaction_id) AS txn_cnt,
    COUNT(*) AS line_rows
  FROM raw
),
chan AS (
  SELECT 'payment_method' AS field_name, payment_method AS field_value, COUNT(*) AS n FROM raw GROUP BY 2
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'is_wish_express', is_wish_express, COUNT(*) FROM raw GROUP BY 2
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'is_wish_owned', is_wish_owned, COUNT(*) FROM raw GROUP BY 2
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'is_bnpl', is_bnpl, COUNT(*) FROM raw GROUP BY 2
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'is_fusion_resale', is_fusion_resale, COUNT(*) FROM raw GROUP BY 2
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'shopify_none', shopify_none, COUNT(*) FROM raw GROUP BY 2
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'original_category', original_category, COUNT(*) FROM raw GROUP BY 2
)
SELECT
  '1_CHANNEL_VALUES' AS section,
  c.field_name AS field_name,
  c.field_value AS field_value,
  CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS gmv_usd,
  CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS order_cnt,
  CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS txn_cnt,
  c.n AS row_cnt,
  1 AS sort_key
FROM chan c

UNION ALL

SELECT
  '2_DAILY_GMV',
  'DAILY_GMV_USD',
  d.dt,
  d.gmv_usd,
  d.order_cnt,
  d.txn_cnt,
  d.line_rows,
  2
FROM daily d

UNION ALL

SELECT
  '3_MONTH_TOTAL',
  'MONTH_TOTAL_USD',
  (SELECT month_start FROM bounds),
  t.gmv_usd,
  t.order_cnt,
  t.txn_cnt,
  t.line_rows,
  3
FROM totals t

ORDER BY sort_key, field_value
